title: On Site Technician
description:
About the Role

As our Onsite Technician, you’ll play a key role in delivering a high‑quality, people‑first technology experience across our Wellington Head Office and wider Wellington region.

Sitting within our Digital Service Experience team, this is a highly visible, hands‑on role where you’ll provide frontline technology support through our Tech Bar and onsite services. You’ll be the go‑to person for day‑to‑day workplace technology needs, ensuring our people are supported, connected and productive.

Working closely with the Service Desk, Digital teams, business stakeholders and external partners, you’ll support everything from new starter setups and meeting room technology through to village go‑lives and office fit‑outs.

Your Day‑to‑Day Will Include:

  • Providing walk‑up and onsite support across Head Office and regional sites
  • Logging, managing and resolving incidents and service requests through the IT Service Desk platform, including triage and escalation where required
  • Supporting workplace technology including laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, AV and meeting room technology
  • Monitoring and proactively maintaining meeting room and collaboration technology, including Microsoft Teams Rooms
  • Preparing, provisioning and deploying devices for new starters and managing technology offboarding
  • Maintaining accurate asset registers, inventories and device records
  • Supporting technology readiness for new villages, care centres and offices, including on‑site support during go‑lives
  • Working with project teams to ensure technology solutions are implemented smoothly and reliably
  • Creating and contributing to knowledge articles, self‑service resources and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Providing friendly, professional and solutions‑focused customer service at all times

About You

You’re a customer‑focused technology support professional who enjoys being hands‑on and visible. You’re comfortable juggling multiple priorities, communicating clearly with a wide range of stakeholders, and resolving issues with a calm, practical approach.

You understand the importance of reliability and service in a care‑focused environment and take pride in delivering a great user experience.

You’ll Also Bring:

  • Experience in a Service Desk, onsite IT support or similar customer‑facing technology role
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure AD and Group Policy
  • Experience supporting mobile devices (iOS and Android) and MDM solutions
  • Exposure to AV, meeting room technology and collaboration tools
  • A good understanding of IT security best practices
  • Strong communication, organisation and prioritisation skills
  • A positive attitude with a genuine desire to help others
  • Competency with hand and power tools
  • A full New Zealand driver’s licence

Why Summerset

At Summerset, we believe diversity strengthens our organisation and enriches the experience we deliver to residents. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, industries and experiences—even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where people feel supported, valued and empowered to do their best work.

Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy include:

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Free Southern Cross health insurance
  • Ongoing professional development and tailored career progression
  • Birthday leave

Applications for this role will close on the 30/09/2026. Please note, this role may close early due to high application volume—apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment!

title: 22226 - Community Payback Supervisor - Colchester
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other lice applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Community Engagement Specialist
description:
Job Title: Community Engagement /CSRT

Reports to: Center Manager

Position Classification: Non-exempt

Office Location: Milwaukee, WI

Has potential to go hybrid!

Primary Objectives of Position: Serve as a liaison between businesses/employers and participants. Conduct outreach through in-person engagement, community partnerships, and online/social media platforms to cultivate relationships with participants, employers, and community agencies, supporting project awareness and enrollment goals. Ensure employer and participant success by developing and facilitating individual, group, and workshop-based training opportunities that align with employer workforce needs and participant career objectives. Utilize digital communication and social media strategies to promote services, share resources, engage target audiences, and strengthen community connections.

Essential Job Functions:

· Develop relationships with community organizations, educational facilities and social service agencies to encourage enrollment in workforce center programs.

· Conduct outreach presentations as needed with a wide range of audiences including high school students, parents, educators, older adults, transitioning job seekers at halfway houses, etc. Organize training venues, logistics and accommodations as needed.

· Identify, develop, and implement outreach, recruitment, and digital marketing strategies, including social media campaigns, to ensure proper quantity and quality of talent is available to meet employer needs.

· Assist in all aspects of talent acquisition for local businesses and participants including screening and assessing candidates for technical and soft skills to assess suitability and fit for assigned positions. Deliver training in various classroom formats, using relevant training materials and a variety of media to address the individual needs of learners.

· Appropriately connect career seekers to open positions, resulting in employment.

· Assist customers in accessing resources to secure employment, training or other supportive services to attain self-sufficiency by providing relevant information and directing customers to services in an appropriate, timely and efficient manner.

· Use computers and printed materials, assist customers in accessing websites and state systems for labor market information, relevant job search information and other resource for developing job leads. Select or develop teaching aides, such as training handbooks, demonstrations models, multimedia visual aids, computer tutorials and reference works.

· Assist individuals with understanding and completing program enrollment processes.

· Conduct eligibility assessment

· Contact participants and/or employers on a regular basis to verify and document placement/retention in employment.

· Establish and maintain knowledge of community and participate in community events and other activities including collaborative recruitment strategies with community partners. This may require a weekend and evening work schedule.

· Acquire and maintain knowledge of market research tools and the trends in the industry or sector to appropriately guide and direct career seekers to placement or education. Also be able to immediately respond to the needs of customers with support options within or outside the scope of our programs.

· Ensure that customer files and records are maintained in accordance with legal requirements and Company policies and procedures. Maintain process to measure outcomes and customer satisfaction and utilize the information to make recommendations on continuous improvement opportunities.

Other Job Duties: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may be requested to perform other reasonable related duties as assigned by the immediate supervisor and other management as required. The company reserves the right to revise or change job duties as business requirements dictate. It is also understood that the company reserves the right to change work schedules as required, including requiring overtime.

Physical Demands/Work Environment: Physical requirements include carrying/lifting up to 5 pounds, frequently; up to 10 pounds, regularly; and up to 25 pounds, occasionally. Visual acuity, speech and hearing; hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to drive an automobile and operate computer keyboard and basic office equipment; subject to carrying, lifting, twisting and reaching to perform essential job functions. Working conditions are primarily in an office environment with occasional travel to other locations.

Required Competencies: Extreme Customer Service focus, learning orientation, communication proficiency, teamwork orientation, technical capacity. Demonstrated ability to thrive in a hybrid work environment through self-motivation, accountability, and effective time management.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's Degree in related field or equivalent experience required.

Experience: Significant demonstrable experience in business-to-business marketing or work in a community-based organization.

Minimum of 2 years' customer service experience and two years' experience in training and public speaking for a diverse audience required. Ability to create or modify training material and develop practical application exercise related to required training material strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Workforce Service programs required. Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as proficient computer skills. Workforce Service experience or demonstrated ability to serve diverse populations required. Prefer working knowledge of all applicable local Workforce Service programs. Familiarity with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations preferred.

Skills/Abilities:

Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment with proven competency in handling stressful situations required. Ability to clearly and concisely communicate with staff and leadership via presentations, in person, telephone, written and oral. Excellent verbal and written communication skills including ability to do public speaking and conduct training sessions. Bilingual (Spanish/English) required. The ability to maintain confidentiality is a must.

Demonstrated ability to use various software programs (Microsoft Office) for correspondence, reports, statistical compilation, analysis and data base access.

Must be accustomed to working in a complex, fast-paced and confidential work environment. Ability to follow complex instructions, prioritize tasks, and effectively utilize resources to complete projects in a timely and accurate manner. Superior attention to detail is a must.

Additional Requirements: Must have valid driver's license and adequate vehicle insurance coverage.

Benefits:

Insurance: Health, Life, Dental and Disability, PTO, Paid Holidays, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Tuition Assistance

title: Systems and Network Engineer
description:
Diraq is looking for a practical and helpful Systems and Network Engineer to support the day-to-day technology needs of the US office. The role covers user support, computers, networks, servers, Microsoft 365, security tools, and IT equipment.

This role suits someone with couple of years' experience who can handle Level 1-2 support, solve common technical issues, and work with the wider IT team in Australia. The person will be the main local IT contact mainly for Chicago, Palo Alto, and LA offices

Responsibilities

User Support and IT Services
  • Provide Level 1-2 support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, meeting rooms, and other IT equipment.
  • Help users with Windows, Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, software, passwords, access, and connectivity issues.
  • Set up equipment and accounts for new starters, and complete IT tasks for leavers.
  • Record, update, and resolve support tickets. Escalate more complex issues to the appropriate team or vendor.
  • Keep the IT asset register and equipment records up to date.
  • Provide clear, friendly, and professional support to users.

Networks
  • Help maintain LAN, WAN, wireless, Internet, and VPN services.
  • Support switches, routers, wireless access points, firewalls, and SD-WAN technologies.
  • Troubleshoot common TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, NAT, routing, switching, and VPN issues.
  • Check network health, availability, capacity, and performance, and report or escalate problems.
  • Keep network diagrams, IP address records, and technical documentation up to date.

Systems and Cloud Services
  • Support Windows and Linux systems, including basic maintenance, patching, updates, and health checks.
  • Assist with Windows Server, Microsoft 365, identity management, Microsoft Azure, and/or AWS.
  • Support virtual environments such as VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox, or KVM.
  • Help with backups, recovery checks, storage monitoring, and business continuity tasks.

Security and Compliance
  • Support firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protection, security updates, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Follow Diraq security policies and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Help investigate security alerts and incidents, and escalate them to the appropriate team.
  • Make sure systems and user access are handled in line with company policies and standards.

Documentation and Improvement
  • Create and update knowledge articles, support guides, network diagrams, and operating procedures.
  • Work with vendors and service providers to resolve technical issues.
  • Support monitoring, alerting, and logging platforms.
  • Take part in infrastructure improvements, technology upgrades, automation, and process improvements.

Requirements

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in IT Support, Network Support, Systems Administration, or a similar role.
  • Experience providing Level 1-2 support in a business environment.
  • Good troubleshooting skills across computers, software, user access, networks, and common IT systems.
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching, VPNs, NAT, and firewall fundamentals.
  • Experience supporting Windows desktops and basic Windows Server tasks.
  • Some experience with Linux operating systems and virtualization technologies.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 services.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues in plain English.
  • Good documentation, organisation, and customer service skills.

Preferred Skills and Experience
  • Experience with Fortinet technologies, including FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, or FortiAnalyzer.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune or another endpoint management platform.
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity operations and security best practices.
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, ticketing, or IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms.
  • Basic scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.

Preferred Certifications
  • CCNA
  • Fortinet FCA or FCP
  • Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA, or cloud certification

Benefits

Compensation
Target base salary for this role is $130,000 - $170,000 per year + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, experience, and location

We are an equal opportunity employer. We value a range of perspectives and experiences and make employment decisions based on merit and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of legally protected characteristics.

title: Hardware Validation Engineer (Mechanical)
description:
About Origin

Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver faster execution, stronger project economics, and meaningful cost savings. Join India’s talent-dense robotics team, with colleagues from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, and other leading institutions.

About the role

As Hardware QA Engineer - Mechanical, you will own verification and validation of mechanical subsystems and complete robot assemblies from prototype through production. You will translate design intent, field requirements, and safety expectations into practical test plans, fixtures, inspection methods, and release criteria. You will work closely with mechanical design, manufacturing, embedded, deployment, and supplier teams to find issues early and ensure every robot can survive demanding construction-site use.

Key responsibilities

- Build and maintain mechanical DVP&R plans covering structural, environmental, endurance, ingress, vibration, shock, thermal, dimensional, and abuse testing.

- Design test fixtures, measurement setups, and repeatable inspection procedures for components, assemblies, and full robots.

- Execute prototype and production validation, document results, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

- Define incoming, in-process, and end-of-line quality checks with manufacturing and suppliers.

- Review drawings, GD&T, tolerances, materials, fasteners, welds, and critical-to-quality characteristics.

- Track defects, reliability trends, and field failures; translate lessons into design and process improvements.

- Support design reviews, supplier qualification, pilot builds, and production-release decisions.

Required qualifications and skills

- Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Automotive, or Aerospace Engineering.

- 2+ years of hands-on mechanical testing or validation experience.

- Strong understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, metrology, and mechanical inspection tools.

- Experience creating test plans, executing experiments, analysing failures, and writing clear test reports.

- Proven experience automating repetitive test cases to improve testing efficiency.

- Working knowledge of root-cause methods such as 5 Why, fishbone, fault-tree analysis, and 8D.

- Hands-on experience conducting DFMEA, PFMEA, or similar risk analysis processes.

- Ability to work safely around heavy electromechanical systems and field equipment.

- Strong ownership, attention to detail, and cross-functional communication.

Preferred experience

- Robotics, automotive, off-highway equipment, aerospace, industrial machinery, or other rugged physical products.

- Environmental and durability testing, supplier quality, NPI, or end-of-line test development.

- Familiarity with ISO 9001, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, or functional-safety-oriented validation.

title: Creative Video Producer
description:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: .

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

About the role

AppLovin is one of the largest and fastest-growing ad platforms in the world. The brands growing on it span from the majority of major mobile game studios, to ecommerce brands that went from $4M to $80M in revenue in the span of a year - with most of their media spend on AppLovin.

We want to tell those stories, and others like them: a single parent whose side-hustle ecommerce business is finally taking off, a pet brand with a quirky founder who found their niche.

You'll work within the growth marketing team to identify which client stories are worth telling, build the narrative, plan and execute the shoot (this role involves real travel), and edit the footage into something human, artful, and authentic. You’ll also partner closely with the Design team to translate our brand identity and values into a distinctive visual language across your productions, helping shape the art direction, look and feel, and overall visual execution of the final work.

What you’ll do

  • Find the story and bring it to life. Research clients, brands, and results — not just the performance numbers, but whether there's something worth watching
  • Make real people compelling on camera. Plan and conduct (or direct) interviews that feel like conversations, not Q&As, and find the moment inside a result or a founder's story that builds an emotional connection.
  • Own production end to end — pre-production, shoot, edit, delivery. Run the shoot yourself on smaller projects; brief and direct a production crew when the scale calls for it.
  • Build the system, not just the videos. Create a repeatable production cadence that keeps client stories moving from intake to final cut without the process becoming the bottleneck.

What we’re looking for

  • You think in stories, not just shots. Your first instinct is the narrative - you know what makes a person or brand’s story worth telling and what people will actually want to watch.
  • The edit is where you do your best work. You know how to take raw footage and build a story - pacing, structure, music, b-roll what gets cut.
  • You have a high bar and strong point of view on what good looks like. You can watch a video and say exactly why it works or doesn't - and you apply that standard to your own work.
  • You don’t let a shoot that’s going sideways stay bad. You instinctively read a room and adjust your approach mid-shoot if an interview isn't working.
  • Self-directed - doesn't need to be managed toward the next project.
  • 5+ years of experience in video content creation with a proven track record of producing standout and original work, as evidenced by portfolio.
  • Hands-on experience shooting and editing high-quality video content using tools like Premiere Pro.

Nice to have

  • You get subjects comfortable on camera and pull out a real answer, not a rehearsed one
  • Being able to produce stories also outside of the video production domain
  • Understanding of post-production workflows with tools like After Effects
  • Awareness of the latest GenAI tools and workflows for video and static content

title: DERMS Intermediate Solutions Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DERMS Intermediate Solutions Specialist based in Canada.

This role combines energy-sector expertise, software engineering, and client-focused solution delivery to support the growing adoption of distributed energy resources.
You will help utility clients understand emerging DER challenges and translate their business needs into practical technical solutions.
The position spans requirements management, solution design, configuration, custom development, testing, deployment, and implementation.
You will work with technologies including APIs, microservices, scripting, enterprise software, cloud platforms, and full-stack development.
The role also involves analyzing distribution network data, automating workflows, supporting acceptance testing, and troubleshooting complex technical issues.
You will collaborate closely with clients, project managers, technical leads, development teams, and other stakeholders throughout project delivery.
This is an opportunity to become a trusted technical advisor while contributing to innovative solutions shaping the future of energy and utility operations.

Accountabilities:

  • Engage directly with utility clients to understand the impact of distributed energy resources on distribution systems and translate business needs into effective DER management and planning solutions.
  • Lead requirements management activities by eliciting, documenting, validating, and maintaining complete requirements that can be traced through solution designs, acceptance criteria, and QA test cases.
  • Define project goals, objectives, technical functionality, success criteria, solution diagrams, and client-specific requirements while mapping business needs to available product capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Technical Leads, Solution Specialists, Project Managers, development teams, and other stakeholders to design and implement solutions that meet client use cases and technical requirements.
  • Deploy solutions into client environments and prepare, modify, and validate input data such as network models, load and generation forecasts, planning scenarios, and generation cost information.
  • Develop scripts and automation to process solution data, validate CIM distribution network models, support power-flow validation, and streamline recurring solution processes.
  • Lead the design and development of custom adapters, connectors, APIs, and microservices required to integrate the DERMS solution with client environments and existing systems.
  • Apply full-stack development capabilities across backend services, middleware, and presentation layers, incorporating appropriate UI/UX considerations when delivering custom integrated solutions.
  • Collaborate with development and service engineering teams throughout delivery to ensure custom solutions meet defined requirements, quality standards, timelines, and budget expectations.
  • Lead project simulations and client-specific testing activities, including use-case validation, factory acceptance testing, and site acceptance testing, while documenting and troubleshooting software defects.
  • Respond to client inquiries, bugs, and product ideas, coordinating issues with product teams and ensuring appropriate tickets, documentation, and follow-up actions are maintained.
  • Analyze project data and results, automate workflows using available APIs, report outcomes, and present findings and recommendations to clients, project partners, and stakeholders.
  • Support AWS cloud deployments for client or internal environments, leveraging hands-on cloud implementation experience to help deliver reliable solutions.
  • Define user acceptance testing processes, test cases, progress metrics, training materials, and user documentation, and train utility clients and end users on solution capabilities.
  • Work with Project Managers to standardize internal and external processes, identify project delivery risks, recommend mitigation strategies, and contribute to continuous improvement across the solutions practice.
  • Support sales activities when required by providing technical demonstrations and identifying potential future opportunities based on client needs and project interactions.

    • Requirements

    • Hold a bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline, ideally with a focus on power systems, or possess equivalent relevant professional experience.
    • Have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience and strong knowledge of the electricity industry, with an understanding of the challenges and opportunities created by distributed energy resources.
    • Demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, particularly in requirements elicitation, requirements management, solution analysis, and translating business needs into technical specifications.
    • Understand how to trace requirements through solution design, specifications, acceptance criteria, and testing plans or cases.
    • Have experience automating processes and using or developing scripts to support software solutions, data processing, workflows, and operational efficiency.
    • Bring software development experience and a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, including integrating custom solutions into enterprise products.
    • Be familiar with emerging energy-industry trends and utility technologies, particularly DER management, distribution planning, IT, SCADA, and asset management.
    • Have experience with enterprise software development, backend development, scripting, Java or Python, and database connectivity, with the ability to understand and work across integrated technical environments.
    • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate multiple approaches, configure solutions using existing product functionality, investigate technical details, and creatively resolve complex client challenges.
    • Be highly collaborative, demonstrating a team-oriented mindset and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, project managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
    • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of technical expertise.
    • Be strongly client-focused, comfortable engaging directly with utility customers, understanding their needs, and developing clear user stories and technical solutions that support their success.
    • Demonstrate strong execution skills, consistently delivering high-quality work within project timelines while managing multiple priorities.
    • Bring a growth mindset, genuine curiosity, and willingness to learn new technologies and software quickly with limited documentation or guidance.
    • Demonstrate an interest in emerging tools and technologies and the ability to adapt technical approaches as client and industry needs evolve.

      • Benefits

      • Annual base salary range of CAD $73,600–$110,400, with the specific offer influenced by experience, education, skills, and other relevant factors.
      • Eligibility for a 10% Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) bonus.
      • Fully remote position.
      • Opportunity to work on innovative energy and utility technology supporting the integration and management of distributed energy resources.
      • Exposure to cloud technologies, enterprise software, APIs, microservices, automation, full-stack development, and advanced DERMS solutions.
      • Opportunity to work directly with utility clients and develop trusted-advisor expertise across technical solution delivery.
      • Professional growth through collaboration with multidisciplinary technical, engineering, project management, and solutions teams.
      • No relocation assistance is provided for this position.

Maddock Films is an Indian film production company founded by producer and director Dinesh Vijan in 2005. company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Furniture Designer - CET
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a driven, design-focused professional to join the team of a top-tier U.S.-based commercial furniture dealer representing some of the world’s leading brands, including Haworth, Steelcase, Kimball, Teknion etc. In this role, you will be a key contributor on a close-knit team, supporting the development of creative workspace solutions through CET and related tools. You will play a vital role in delivering fast-turnaround, high-quality design presentations and visual materials that support both sales and marketing efforts. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and possesses a keen eye for detail, space planning, and visual storytelling.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and present creative, visually compelling workspace solutions using CET Designer and AutoCAD, aligned with client needs and project goals.
  • Create accurate project drawings, specifications, renderings, and presentations that support sales and marketing initiatives.
  • Select and present finishes, furniture options, and material palettes, ensuring design continuity and alignment with client expectations.
  • Review architectural plans, conduct code analyses, and incorporate building/site conditions into workspace designs.
  • Conduct field verifications, furniture inventories, and measurements to ensure design accuracy.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and project teams throughout the design process—providing timely updates, incorporating feedback, and ensuring deliverables align with established timelines.
  • Self-review and quality check all project deliverables prior to distribution to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare and transmit final documentation for order entry and installation; assist with as-built drawings as required.
  • Provide technical drawings and coordination details to external partners (e.g., A&D firms, contractors, IT, electrical).
  • Participate in training, industry events, and internal initiatives to remain current on design trends, tools, and standards.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of product lines, codes (ADA, LEED, WELL), and ergonomic and technology integration principles.


Qualifications:

  • Strong English communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to collaborate effectively in a U.S.-based, client-facing environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in CET (Configura) Designer software, along with supporting skills in AutoCAD, Project Spec, and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design or a related field.
  • A minimum of 4 years’ experience in commercial furniture, workspace design, or a similar industry and CET Design software experience.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple fast-paced projects with competing deadlines.
  • A fast learner with a proactive attitude toward new software, platforms, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with ADA codes, ergonomics, LEED, WELL Building standards, and technology integration in commercial interiors.
  • In-depth knowledge of product lines, applications, and technical specifications in commercial furniture.
  • A collaborative team player with a problem-solving mindset and a desire to grow in a supportive, remote work environment.
  • Must have a reliable home office setup, including a personal PC/laptop and an internet speed of at least 50 Mbps (download and upload).


What We Offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge design technology.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, supportive team that values work-life balance.
  • Play a key role in design operations—your impact on company growth will be evident.
  • Join a culture that values your contributions and equips you with the tools to succeed.
  • Be part of an innovative team that continuously learns and adapts.

title: High Care Senior Motor Claims Consultant
description:
The role:

As our new High Care Senior Motor Claims Consultant, you will be managing a portfolio of end-to-end motor claims for customers experiencing vulnerability and/or a traumatic claim event that present in varying levels of complexity. You will be responsible for delivering an exceptional customer claim experience balanced with the accurate application of policy interpretation and claims decisioning.

This role is based on-site at Kawana Waters.

You will:

  • Be responsible for end to end management of a portfolio of complex, high value and sensitive claims
  • Review each referred claim for acceptance in line with the ICA, PDS and prior to internal dispute resolution or Ombudsman determination
  • Manage existing claims to provide support to customers within policy entitlements, organisation of repairs & management throughout the claims life
  • Identify & raise potential risks or compliance issues to Management
  • Seek additional information to validate events by reviewing, verifying, and issuing documentation to customer
  • Accurately underwrite claims and make determinations on cover
  • Review duty of care application by customer and apply reasonable care assessment as a key part of decision making
  • Liaising with internal and external stakeholders across underwriting, assessing, suppliers, complaint and hire car teams to coordinate claim finalisation
  • Identify vulnerability experience by the customer and ensure support services offered
  • Be pro-active in supporting your team whilst also working independently
  • Take ownership of their learning and be open to feedback, be solution focused and enjoy new challenges

What experience you’ll bring:

  • Motor Claims experience essential
  • Excellent customer service experience essential
  • Experience in insurance with a demonstrated knowledge and application of technical claim management desirable
  • Exceptional communication and conflict resolution skills required with the ability to develop strong relationships with stakeholders
  • High level of emotional intelligence, able to drive for results, focus on outcomes and well-developed negotiation skills

Our Perks

  • Location - This role will be based in our Kawana Office office.
  • Extra leave - Enjoy additional leave days on us! You’ll receive a paid ‘ME’ day and one paid volunteer leave day annually. Team members can also purchase up to two additional weeks of leave per year.

  • Development opportunities - We’re championing your development with internal programs and access to a wide range of online courses.
  • Employee discounts - You’ll receive discounts on Budget Direct insurance products.
  • Reward and recognition - We reward high performance with employee recognition, reward and incentive schemes.
  • Onsite facilities - There’s excellent end-of-trip facilities on offer and private spaces for nursing mothers.
  • Get social - Join our vibrant social and community activities including annual celebrations, family fun days and regular events across each of our sites.

About us

Auto & General (A&G) is the fastest-growing major Motor and Home insurer in Australia, providing insurance products and solutions to safeguard a brighter future for our customers and community.

Our range of general insurance products including Car, Motorcycle, Home, Contents Pet and Travel products are delivered through our multi-award-winning brand Budget Direct and partnerships with leading brands - ING, Qantas and Coles Insurance.

We’re excited about the future and we’re always on the lookout for talented, passionate individuals who can help us achieve our goal of being Australia’s best insurer! If this sounds like you, apply today.

Auto & General values individual differences and believes in fostering an inclusive culture that creates a great place to work for all.

title: IT Operations & Service Delivery Manager
description:

The IT Operations & Service Delivery Manager is responsible for coordinating and improving the daily delivery of IT services across Kuros' global operations. The role serves as the operational focal point for service performance, MSP coordination, ITSM processes, asset management, operational reporting, and compliance follow-up activities. Working closely with the VP Information Technology, CISO, Data Officer, MSP partners, and internal IT specialists, the position helps ensure that IT services are delivered consistently, efficiently, and in accordance with company policies and service expectations. The role supports operational governance, ensuring organizational standards and service expectations are consistently met. This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Alpharetta, GA.

Key Responsibilities:

IT Service Delivery Management

description:
The XTIUM global team is made up of a group of diverse and talented professionals who are all driven by the same goal: excellence and continuous improvement. If you’re passionate, driven, and eager to grow, XTIUM is where your potential meets opportunity. title: Goods-In Quality Inspector
description:
The Opportunity


We're looking for a Goods-In Quality Inspector who is interested in developing a career in Quality and wants the opportunity to learn and grow within a hands-on engineering environment. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys practical work, has a good eye for detail and wants to develop new skills while playing an important role in ensuring the materials and components we use meet the high standards expected at OpenWorks.

We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, energy and motivation to learn, alongside a reliable and methodical approach to their work. You might come from a manufacturing, engineering, production, warehouse or other hands-on environment, or simply have an interest in Quality and a desire to learn more.

Who We Are
OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.

Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.

We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.

The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.

Security Vetting Information
OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us
Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.

Here’s what our benefits have to offer:
Rewarding Success - Competitive pay rate, from £13.20 per hours, overtime at 1.5x your hourly rate, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.
Enhanced Pension – Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.
More Time to Recharge – 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.
Breakfast & Lunch on Us – Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.
Health & Wellbeing – Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.
Sustainable Travel – Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.
Team Socials – Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.
Learning & Growth – A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Inspect incoming materials: Check machined parts, fabricated components, electrical assemblies, PCBs and other purchased items against the required quality standards.
  • Carry out inspections: Complete dimensional and visual inspections using hand tools and measuring equipment, including vernier callipers and plug gauges.
  • Check against requirements: Inspect materials and components against drawings, specifications and relevant quality requirements.
  • Identify quality issues: Recognise defects, damage and non-conformances, including supplier quality issues, and escalate them appropriately.
  • Record inspection results: Accurately record inspection and quality information within the ERP/QMS system.
  • Manage rejected items: Prepare rejected materials and supplier returns, ensuring they are correctly identified and packed.
  • Maintain traceability: Ensure materials and inspection records are correctly identified and traceable.
  • Support the wider Quality team: Assist with Factory Acceptance Testing, supplier documentation and quality investigations, working closely with Quality, Engineering, Procurement and Production.

What we’re looking for:

  • Hands-on experience: Experience in a practical environment such as manufacturing, engineering, production, warehouse or a similar setting.
  • Attention to detail: A naturally thorough and methodical approach, with pride in getting things right.
  • Quality mindset: Able to spot defects or potential issues and understand when something needs to be escalated.
  • Motivated to learn: A genuine interest in developing a career in Quality, with the energy and attitude to learn new skills.
  • Organised and reliable: Able to maintain accurate records, follow processes and manage tasks effectively in a busy environment.
  • Team player: Good communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues across the business.
  • Measuring experience: Experience using vernier callipers, plug gauges or similar measuring equipment would be beneficial.
  • Engineering environment: Experience working with engineering drawings, product specifications, ERP systems or within an engineering/manufacturing environment would be advantageous.

More about us:

Vision
Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.

Mission
Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence

Values
Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest
Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done
Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility
We are one team: Look out for each other and the team
Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on
Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people
We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

title: Engineer 2 - Plant Commissioning Engineering
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Engineer 2 - Plant Commissioning Engineering based in India.

Join a specialized engineering team working on advanced FACTS technologies, including STATCOM and related power-system solutions.
You will contribute to high-profile international projects designed to improve grid stability, voltage control, transmission efficiency, and reliable electricity distribution.
The role combines detailed control and protection hardware engineering with hands-on pre-commissioning and site support.
You will develop critical engineering documentation, interfaces, schematics, panel designs, and protection systems for complex grid infrastructure.
You will collaborate with global engineering teams, clients, consultants, and project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
The position offers exposure to cutting-edge power technologies and the opportunity to work on varied international projects with significant engineering responsibility.
Based in Noida with hybrid working flexibility, you will play an important role in delivering reliable and high-quality solutions for modern power networks.

Accountabilities:

  • Control and Protection Hardware Engineering: Develop detailed hardware specifications and bills of materials for substation and STATCOM projects, including control and protection panels, automation panels, relay lists, bay control units, marshalling kiosks, and associated engineering documentation.
  • Engineering Drawings and Documentation: Prepare and review protection single-line diagrams, control schematics, interconnection diagrams, general arrangement drawings, cable schedules, terminal plans, panel layouts, rack layouts, and other project documentation using tools such as EPLAN, E3, or EBASE.
  • Auxiliary and Interface Engineering: Design AC/DC auxiliary supply distribution schemes and develop I/O allocation and interface engineering for protection relays, RTUs, BCUs, SCADA systems, STATCOM controllers, Ethernet switches, and other control equipment.
  • STATCOM Engineering: Develop hardware engineering for STATCOM control and protection systems, valve cooling interfaces, transformer protection, line-bay protection, MSC/MSR bay protection, and harmonic filter protection systems.
  • Control and Communication Systems: Coordinate interfaces between unit and station controllers, PPC, HMI, and grid automation systems, while preparing communication architecture drawings and interface documentation.
  • Protection Systems: Apply knowledge of protection schemes for transmission lines, power transformers, busbars, reactors, capacitor banks, harmonic filters, and STATCOM branches.
  • Commissioning Support: Support pre-commissioning activities for control and protection systems at site, review and apply design-stage documents and settings, assess site modifications, perform engineering updates, and conduct primary and secondary injection testing of protection relays.
  • Testing and Energization: Participate in FAT and SAT activities when required and provide technical support during energization and performance testing to help ensure safe, reliable, and successful project delivery.
  • Standards and Quality: Apply relevant standards and requirements, including IEC 61850, IEC 60255, IEC 62271, IEC 61000, utility technical specifications, and grid-code requirements, while maintaining documentation in accordance with project quality plans.
  • Project Collaboration: Work effectively with global teams, clients, consultants, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, resolve technical challenges, manage priorities, and deliver engineering activities on schedule.

    • Requirements

    • Education and Experience: Hold a BTech or MTech degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with a specialization in Power Systems, and bring 6–8 years of relevant experience in Substation, FACTS, or HVDC projects.
    • STATCOM/FACTS/HVDC Expertise: Have at least 2 years of specific experience working on STATCOM, FACTS, or HVDC projects, with utility-scale grid integration and EHV substation experience considered an advantage.
    • Engineering Design: Demonstrate strong hands-on expertise in single-line diagrams, protection and metering SLDs, control and protection panel design, automation panels, BOM preparation, interconnection diagrams, cable schedules, terminal plans, GA drawings, hardware lists, and related engineering deliverables.
    • Commissioning Knowledge: Experience with plant commissioning, pre-commissioning, protection testing, site modifications, energization, or performance testing is highly relevant, while experience commissioning 1–2 STATCOM/HVDC projects is preferred.
    • Protection and Power Systems: Possess a solid understanding of electrical protection schemes and relevant IEC standards, utility specifications, and grid-code requirements for complex power transmission and grid-integration environments.
    • Technical Problem-Solving: Demonstrate excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to investigate complex engineering issues and develop practical solutions.
    • Communication: Have fluent written and spoken English and the ability to communicate technical information effectively with global teams, customers, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
    • Project Management Skills: Be highly organized, capable of prioritizing and managing multiple project activities simultaneously, and comfortable working in a fast-paced international engineering environment.
    • Ownership and Collaboration: Bring a team-oriented mindset, strong ownership and accountability, proactive working habits, and a willingness to identify and implement improvements.
    • International Exposure: Experience handling global utility or customer requirements and a genuine interest in working across international projects and multicultural engineering teams are highly valued.
    • Industry Background: Experience in FACTS/STATCOM, power transmission and distribution, renewable energy integration, or HVDC is preferred.

      • Benefits

      • Hybrid Work: Hybrid working flexibility from the Noida, India location.
      • International Projects: Opportunity to contribute to high-profile projects involving advanced power-system technologies and global customers.
      • Technical Exposure: Hands-on experience with STATCOM, FACTS, HVDC, control and protection systems, grid integration, and modern power transmission technologies.
      • Professional Development: Opportunity to strengthen expertise across engineering design, commissioning, protection systems, international standards, and complex project delivery.
      • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with global engineering professionals, clients, consultants, and project teams in an international environment.
      • Career Impact: Take on a critical engineering discipline with direct influence on the quality, reliability, and successful commissioning of major power infrastructure projects.
      • Relocation: Relocation assistance is provided.
      • Compensation and Additional Benefits: Specific salary, healthcare, and other benefits were not provided in the source job description.

title: Dygtig truckfører søges til fast daghold
description:
Vores samarbejdspartner nær Ebeltoft, søger en erfaren truckfører til deres daghold. Denne virksomhed producerer forskellige produkter og det er derfor vigtigt du er klar på en alsidig dag med mange omstillinger. Du vil komme til at plukke på hylderne i lageret samt klargøre til forsendelse. Derudover vil du også komme til at læsse og losse lastbiler samt sikre orden på lageret.

Virksomheden sætter kvalitet, engagement og samarbejde i høj fokus, så hvis du vil være en del af holdet, er dette noget som du skal besidde. Derudover er der et ret uformelt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet vil primært være kørsel af en truck, derfor er erfaring med truck særlig vigtigt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver er bl.a. indenfor:

  • Læsning og losning af lastbiler
  • Registrering af vare i deres IT-system
  • Klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Truckcertifikat og kørekort B

  • Effektiv og omhyggelig

  • Arbejdsom og mødestabil
  • Dygtigt og erfaren
  • Klar til at tage fat



Særlige forhold

Stillingen er på daghold og løn er efter kvalifikationer.

Virksomheden ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, og samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende.

Send os dit CV på Randers-u@jobteam.dk og vi vil kontakte dig snarest.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Electrical Technician - Wiring, Soldering & PCB Assembly
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Electrical Technician who can support wiring, soldering, PCB assembly, harness preparation, connector crimping, and general electrical/electronics work for our robotics and automation projects. The role involves building wiring harnesses, assembling control panels, testing circuits, and supporting prototype development.

Key Responsibilities

● Perform wiring, cable routing, crimping, and harness assembly for robots and electrical panels.

● Conduct soldering (through-hole & SMD preferred) and PCB-level assembly/rework.

● Assist in assembling control boxes, sensor wiring, motor driver wiring, and power distribution units.

● Read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, PCB layouts.

● Work with connectors like XT30/XT60, Molex, JST, Deutsch, Phoenix, etc.

● Handle testing, continuity checks, insulation checks, and ensure circuit integrity.

● Support prototype builds, repairs, and troubleshooting of electrical faults.

● Maintain inventory of wires, lugs, terminals, connectors, and electrical tools.

● Follow safety standards while handling power supplies, Li-ion/LFP batteries, and high-voltage systems.

Requirements

Skills & Requirements


● ITI / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics or related field.

● 0–4 years of hands-on experience in wiring, soldering, or PCB assembly.
● Strong knowledge of multimeters, crimping tools, soldering iron/stations, heat guns.
● Good understanding of DC systems (12V/24V/48V), motor drivers, sensors & controllers.
● Ability to read basic schematics & wiring diagrams.
● Experience with power distribution boards, harness building, cable management.

Preferred (Good to Have)


● Experience in robotics, drones, EVs, SPMs, or automation setups.
● Knowledge of CAN, UART, RS485 wiring.
● Experience with LFP/Li-ion battery wiring, BMS connections.
● SMD rework skills (hot air gun, flux use, chip replacement).
● Understanding of EMI/EMC-safe wiring practices.

title: Associate/Contractor - Lead Fire Safety Consultant
description:

At Ark Workplace Risk, we empower our clients to confidently manage risk, compliance, and safety through a trusted partnership built on expert knowledge, innovative solutions, and proactive guidance and insight.

  • Responsive Partnership: From every day, business-as-usual guidance to urgent, critical, complex, and contentious scenarios, we work in partnership with clients, becoming their trusted advisor and solution provider, whenever and wherever they need us most.
We’re looking for a Senior Fire Safety and Strategy Consultant who is passionate about fire safety and delivering the GOLD Standard in the built environment and enjoys working in a team of dedicated multi-skilled safety professionals.
Benefits

  • Working with our prestigious and diverse range of clients in the built environment, including residential and commercial.

  • Undertake retrospective fire strategies, and complex Type 1,2,3,4 fire risk assessments in complex residential and commercial buildings.
  • Reviewing and creating building safety management systems.
  • Undertake complex compartmentation surveys and make recommendations.
  • Develop a corporate fire safety management system across client portfolios.
  • Act as an internal source of expertise for the consultants.
  • Support clients with contentious matters including fire brigade interventions.
  • Implement fire safety advice and site management systems, audits and reviews.
  • Design fire management plans for existing buildings.
  • Create fire safety solutions across a range of sites (varying in complexity) within the built environment.
  • Work with colleagues across Ark to contribute to new projects and developments – we have an open culture and are always looking to share and expand on our knowledge!
  • Monitoring of External Wall/ facade to confirm remedial work is assured.

Requirements

  • 5+ years experience working as a Fire Safety Consultant in the built environment.
  • Extensive experience in undertaking fire specialist work e.g. fire strategies, fire management plans, and complex fire risk assessments in high risk commercial and residential buildings.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and excellent report writing abilities to deliver client reports in accordance with a forensic and pragmatic approach.
  • Comprehensive understanding of current UK building regulations e.g. Approved Document B.

Qualifications and Memberships
