title: Lead Software Engineer - Solution & Data Architecture - B2B SaaS Fintech
description:
Landytech is building the intelligent operating platform for modern investment management. Our AI-powered platform, Sesame, brings together investment, corporate and accounting data across asset classes, custodians, currencies and legal entities, creating one secure, trusted source of truth from which our clients can understand their wealth and act with confidence.

Sesame is much more than a reporting tool. We build technology that helps asset owners, asset managers, private banks and trust and company service providers run their entire investment ecosystem: automating complex data and document ingestion, surfacing portfolio and risk insights, anticipating liquidity needs, supporting investment decisions and deal flow, streamlining collaboration and turning intelligence into action through AI.

From family offices managing multigenerational wealth to financial institutions serving clients at scale, Sesame replaces fragmented data and manual processes with clarity, control and smarter decisions.

Why this role exists

Our domain is a healthy challenge: multi-custodian, multi-currency, multi-entity financial data, modelled thoughtfully and available at scale. The platform is Kotlin and Spring microservices, with Python where it pays off: metrics, analytics and our AI work. Good features start well before any code gets written, with clear communication about the outcomes to be delivered, followed by planning, prototyping when it helps, and a design the team agrees on.

As technical lead of an R&D team, you'll work closely with a Product Manager on initiatives, improvements and bugs: shaping the work, breaking it down, handing it out across the team, and owning what ships.

You go deep enough into the requirement to push back on it, ask the questions that need asking, and tell apart what the client needs from what the requirement says.

Then you work out how it fits. Usually the right answer is the simple one built on architecture we already have, and defending that is part of the job. Sometimes it isn't, and you're the one who flags that this is a truly new capability, writes the spec and plan, and takes it to our other architects to poke holes in before we commit.

You'll do all this in a team that uses coding agents every day, and you'll help shape how we do that well.

What you'll own

You own the partnership with Product: one PM, one lead engineer, one roadmap. You sit with product and domain experts before the ticket exists, understand the business problem, push back on the requirement where it needs it, and come back with honest trade-offs on cost, risk and time. You plan, size and hand out the work, and keep the team unblocked while it ships.

Security, scalability, availability and performance are design inputs on every initiative, not a hardening phase at the end. You cover tenant isolation, auth, data protection and auditability, because our clients' data is about as sensitive as it gets. You know how the system behaves under load and at month-end when everyone runs reports at once, you set the SLOs, and you make sure we can see whether we're meeting them. You are the escalation point when the team hits something genuinely hard, and you go in and solve it with them.

For every significant initiative you produce the design: what changes, in which services, what the contracts and data flows look like, what we reuse and what we leave alone. You write it down, take the challenge from our other architects, and improve it. When a requirement exposes a gap in the platform, you name it and propose what should exist.

You own feature architecture end to end, from the React frontend through our Kotlin and Spring services, across data stores and events, down to Azure. You decide what goes where, and push hard for the simplest solution the existing architecture can carry.

You set the coding standards, API design, testing, quality gates, and security and dependency hygiene. That now covers how we work with coding agents: the rules they follow, the skills and MCP integrations we build over our own systems, and the review process that holds quality as more code gets generated. You're the one who challenges what an agent proposed, because plausible code that passes its tests can still be wrong about concurrency, a data model or a failure mode.

You model the financial domain: positions, transactions, instruments, valuations, entities and hierarchies, so it holds up as new asset classes, custodians and jurisdictions arrive. You build pipelines that stay correct when the source data is messy, late or wrong, and fast enough to run over long histories on demand.

You line-manage a squad: objectives, one-to-ones, feedback that moves careers, hiring, onboarding and code reviews people learn from. You bring back what's new and make sure it lands with the team rather than staying in your head.

You stay hands-on throughout — this is not a role where you stop writing code.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years building backend systems in production, with real depth in Kotlin and/or Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Boot, Web, Security, Data).
  • A track record of architecting systems, not just services: you've owned significant design decisions in a distributed or microservices platform and lived with the consequences.
  • Strong data modelling and SQL skills, plus experience designing data ingestion, transformation or ETL pipelines. You've dealt with data you couldn't trust.
  • Enough Python to design and review it. Our metrics, analytics and AI services are written in it, so you need to be able to reason about them, not to be a Python specialist.
  • Fluency across the boundary: you can read and reason about a React/TypeScript frontend and hold a serious conversation about Kubernetes, cloud networking and cost.
  • You work well with Product. You've partnered closely with a PM, dug into complex business requirements, challenged them, and turned them into plans a team could execute.
  • You write. Technical specs, design docs, ADRs. Clear enough that another architect can challenge them and an engineer can build from them.
  • Comfortable with AI-assisted development. You use coding agents day to day and have a view on where they help and where they quietly cause damage. Experience writing skills, MCP integrations or agent conventions for a team is a strong plus.
  • Security is instinctive for you. Secure-by-design services, authentication and authorisation done properly, tenant and data isolation, secrets and key management, dependency and supply-chain hygiene. You've worked somewhere the data mattered.
  • You've built for scale and kept it up. Designing for growth in users, data volume and history; understanding availability, failure modes, graceful degradation and recovery; and being the person who owns the incident rather than watching it.
  • Performance is something you measure. Profiling and load testing before optimising, query and caching strategy, sensible use of async and batch, and knowing which numbers actually matter to a client waiting on a report.
  • A real testing habit, and a view on what belongs where: unit, component, integration, contract, end-to-end, and performance and scalability testing. You know which of these earns its keep on a given change, and which ones teams quietly skip until it hurts.
  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, trunk-based or short-lived branching, and CI/CD as code.
  • Experience leading engineers. You've line-managed or formally led a team, and you can point to people who got significantly better while working for you.
  • You lead through influence and clarity. You explain a design to a junior engineer and a product director in the same afternoon, in the right words for each.
  • Fluent English. Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or another STEM subject, or equivalent experience.

Bonus points

You don't need to come from finance. You do need to be curious about it, because the domain is half the job.

Our stack

  • Core backend: Kotlin, Java 17+, Spring Boot & Co, JPA/Hibernate, SQL and NoSQL, Elasticsearch, Gradle, JUnit/AssertJ/MockK
  • Metrics, analytics and AI: Python, FastAPI, Polars, LangChain
  • Frontend: React (TanStack Query/React Router/react-hook-form + Zod), TypeScript, nx.dev, Tailwind CSS/shadcn/ui, Vitest/Playwright/MSW, Vite, Recharts
  • Platform: Azure, Azure DevOps (CI/CD), Kubernetes, Docker, cloud storage, messaging and events, Git, SonarQube
  • AI in our workflow: Claude Code and Codex day to day, custom skills, MCP servers over our own platform, LLM-powered document and data ingestion

What the first year looks like

  • Month 1: you know the platform, the domain and the team, and you've shipped something real.
  • Month 3: you and your PM are running your initiatives together, and you've written the spec for a significant cross-service feature.
  • Month 6: your fingerprints are on our engineering conventions and on how the team plans, designs and reviews work.
  • Month 12: your team is noticeably stronger than the day you arrived, and the decisions you made are holding up under load.

Why join now

You're joining early enough to shape the platform and late enough that it has real clients, real scale and real revenue behind it. The problems are hard, the domain is deep, and the industry is genuinely ready for what we're building. You'll work with an international team across London, Paris, Pune and beyond, and you'll have a real voice in what we build.

Our Benefits

  • An opportunity to work in a fast growing fintech revolutionizing investment reporting
  • Hybrid style of work/WFH allowed depending on role
  • Competitive salary & stock options package
  • Private medical insurance for you and your family members
  • Pension Plan with NEST
  • Cycle to Work Scheme and gym allowance
  • Office food & drinks, regular socials

If this sounds like a match to you, we are looking for to receiving your application!

title: Avionics Certification Engineering Intern - Phoenix Site
description:
Acron Aviation is seeking an Avionics Certification Engineering Intern to support the development, certification, and regulatory approval of avionics systems and equipment for commercial, business, and military aircraft applications at our Phoenix, Arizona site.

This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. Interns will contribute to the design, development, testing, integration, and support of aviation products and technologies.

This internship provides hands-on experience with aviation regulatory compliance activities, including Supplemental Type Certificates (STCs), Technical Standard Orders (TSOs), FAA certification processes, and aircraft integration projects. The intern will collaborate with experienced certification engineers, systems engineers, ODA Unit Members, FAA representatives, and cross-functional project teams to help ensure avionics products and aircraft modifications meet applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards.

What you will do

  • Assist with the preparation and review of certification documentation supporting STC and TSO programs.
  • Support regulatory compliance activities for avionics systems, equipment, and aircraft modifications.
  • Assist in developing certification plans, compliance checklists, and requirements traceability matrices.
  • Research applicable FAA regulations, advisory circulars, policy documents, and industry standards.
  • Support the evaluation of avionics designs against applicable certification requirements.
  • Assist with the preparation and maintenance of engineering data packages, technical reports, and certification records.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical meetings, and certification status reviews.
  • Support test planning, test witnessing, and analysis of test results.
  • Assist with aircraft integration and verification activities for avionics installations.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to help resolve certification-related findings and technical issues.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation within company configuration management systems.
  • Complete other engineering and project-related assignments as needed.

Learning Opportunities

  • During the internship, the successful candidate may gain exposure to:
  • FAA certification processes and regulatory frameworks.
  • Supplemental Type Certificate development and approval.
  • Technical Standard Order authorization processes.
  • Aircraft system integration and modification programs.
  • Avionics architectures and aircraft communication, navigation, surveillance, recorder, and display systems.
  • Industry standards such as RTCA DO-160, DO-178C, DO-254, ARP4754A, and ARP4761.
  • Certification engineering best practices and compliance demonstration methods.
  • Collaboration across engineering, program management, quality, and regulatory disciplines.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in one of the following areas:
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Systems Engineering
  • Another related technical discipline
  • Strong interest in aviation, aerospace systems, avionics, and regulatory certification.
  • Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, aircraft, or systems engineering concepts.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work full-time and onsite for the duration of the internship program.
  • This position may require access to information, technology, software, or hardware that is subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations. To comply with these requirements, applicants must qualify as a US Person.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework related to avionics, aerospace systems, electronics, certification, or systems engineering.
  • Familiarity with FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 23, 25, 27, or 29.
  • Knowledge of avionics systems such as communication, navigation, surveillance, flight management, or cockpit display systems.
  • Familiarity with requirements management or systems engineering tools.
  • Previous internship, academic project, laboratory, aviation, or aerospace experience.
  • Familiarity with artificial intelligence tools or applications, such as Microsoft Copilot or Cursor

title: Senior Retail + Casework Installer
description:
We’re looking for a Lead Installer who is an absolute ace. Someone we can trust to figure it out.

The hours aren’t always pretty. Days, nights, weekends, long days, weird schedules, whatever it takes to get the job done. You’re good with all of that.

You know how to install. You know how to troubleshoot. You know how to look at a problem, figure out what’s actually wrong, and make a plan. If there's a change in plans, you know who to call and what to ask for. But before any of that, you’ve already walked the job, start to finish in your head and made note of the stumbling blocks, the what-ifs, and the things that nobody put in a drawing.

You’re also good with people. You can walk into a client's space, take charge without being a jerk, and make things happen without making it a big production. You make the client feel like they’re in good hands, you keep stakeholders in the loop and you understand the importance of using the right language for the right audience.

This is a lead role, and it comes with the authority to match. You’re coordinating with GCs, site supers and other trades to weave the work under tight deadlines. You understand the crush to get the CO at the end of a construction job and how crucial a clean carpet can be for a retail opening. You know when to push, and you’re the one to call a stop when something isn’t right, because we’d rather eat an hour than a go-back.

This work means nights, weekends and travel. None of this is a surprise to you, and you understand the varied nature of our industry.

What makes Axiom different from the other install jobs you’ve had is that we build what you install. Heck, sometimes you build what you install. The work you do comes out of our seventy-five thousand square foot shop full of people that you'll be collaborating with and working beside. When you’re off the road, you’re in the shop working with the build team, and when something gets crated badly or fights you on site, you’ve got the opportunity to get the needed changes into production for next time.

You’ve probably done most of this:

  • Led multi-phase retail, event, or commercial installs from the first logistics meeting through sign-off.
  • Held your own with a GC on site without making an enemy.
  • Trained up installers who are now great at what they do because of the time they spent shoulder to shoulder with you.
  • Structural rigging, anchoring, and fastening across a multitude of materials has taught you what can bend, and what shouldn't.

This isn’t a job for someone who needs a perfect set of instructions. Things will go sideways. You’re the person we want when they do, and we’re paying accordingly.

title: 21919 - Team Leader
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Proud to serve. Proud to keep justice going.

Our Team Leaders in HMCTS National Services play a critical role in helping deliver justice, this role will enable you to demonstrate and develop your leadership skills. You will be responsible for making sure your team deliver business objectives through providing excellent administrative support and customer service to service users and key stakeholders.

About us

HM Courts & Tribunals Service (HMCTS) is responsible for the administration of criminal, civil and family Courts and Tribunals England and Wales as well as the reserved unified tribunals across the United Kingdom. Our roles support our service users and colleagues within HMCTS, where people and businesses access potentially life-changing justice. We’re looking for individuals who are committed to public service and making a difference in people’s lives to deliver justice.

National Services provides centralised support through Courts and Tribunals Service Centres, Business Centres and Enforcement Offices. We handle case administration, customer queries by phone, email, and webchat and enable self-service in our digital services.

About your role

The role of a manager is at the heart of HMCTS operations, shaped by the Civil Service Line Management Standards. It’s rewarding, challenging, and essential to our success. We’re looking for managers who can drive strong performance, manage attendance effectively, and champion reward and recognition.

You will be part of the management team at Newport CTSC. Leading your team, you will provide outstanding service to all our users, delivering on your area of work against local, regional and national priorities.

As an effective Team Leader, you recognise the importance of the team’s overall wellbeing and can motivate them to succeed, using real time coaching to develop your team. You will create a sense of purpose, recognising successes and managing performance to deliver results and achieve key performance outcomes, ensuring exceptional service for every user.

Please refer to the role profile attachment to understand more about this key leadership position.

Essential knowledge, skills and experience

  • Ability to lead, motivate, coach and develop others to have the skills, confidence and experience to thrive in their role.
  • Strong organisational skills to prioritise, plan, allocate and manage work to deliver outstanding service.
  • Excellent communication skills. Able to establish and maintain trusted relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Able to manage difficult and challenging situations and resolve problems swiftly and professionally.
  • Confident in analysing data to make informed decisions to improve and maintain performance.
  • Ability to use IT and learn new systems.

Lead criterion at application stage: Statement of Suitability. A sift based on the statement of suitability may be held if a large number of applications are received.

Your development

Our HMCTS Leadership Development offer will build your confidence and capability as a leader. From bite-sized learning and interactive workshops to deeper insights through our Accountability & Decision-Making framework, we’ll equip you to lead with impact, inspire your teams, and drive performance across the organisation.

If you are interested in developing your career in a role with real purpose, apply today.

Further details:

New recruits to the Civil Service joining MoJ are expected to join at the band minimum.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. Shift patterns will be between 08:00 and 18:00 Monday-Friday and 08:30 to 16:00 on Saturdays. Applications for part-time working will be considered, however due to the nature of the role the minimum we could consider is 30 hours per week. HMCTS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs and are agreed prior to appointment. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Non-contractual hybrid working is currently available. Hybrid working arrangements will be determined by the business and will only be available when it has been established that delivering the service from home can be done effectively. We cannot facilitate requests for a particular work from home/working in the office schedule.

Skilled Worker Visa

From 22 July 2025, the Government increased the salary threshold and skills level for Skilled Worker visas. This role does not meet the eligibility criteria for sponsorship in accordance with the current immigration rules if you looking to apply for a Skilled Worker Visa for the first time.

The Department cannot consider sponsoring you for this role unless you have held a Skilled Worker visa continuously since before 22 July 2025. If you have held a Skilled Worker visa continuously, please raise this during your vetting checks and eligibility will be assessed in accordance with the immigration rules and transitional provisions in place.

If you are applying for this role and you do not meet the new eligibility criteria for sponsorship (or the transitional provisions), you will need to consider your options for obtaining and/or maintaining your right to work in the UK in light of these changes. Successful applicants must ensure they have and maintain the legal right to live and work in the Civil Service and in the United Kingdom.

The Department will continue to comply with UK Immigration Rules applied in the UK and Civil Service. You can read more about Skilled Worker visas and the eligibility criteria here.

Occasional travel to other courts

For this post, occasional travel to other sites will be required for cover when needed.

title: Environmental Health and Safety Internship
description:

Company Background:

For over 50 years, ABEC has been a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC’s unique value is based on combining long experience with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximize productivity. title: Senior Back-End Developer - Backbase
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Back-End Developer - Backbase based in Canada.

This is a fully remote opportunity for a senior backend engineer specializing in the integration and extension of a digital banking platform.
You will build scalable, secure, and maintainable backend solutions that address complex business challenges in financial services.
The role combines hands-on software development with client-facing consulting and close collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
You will translate business requirements into technical architecture and work alongside designers, product managers, and developers to deliver high-quality solutions.
You will contribute to large-scale distributed systems, microservices, cloud environments, and applications handling sensitive financial information.
The position offers an Agile, collaborative environment where clean code, continuous learning, and proactive problem-solving are highly valued.
You will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on client projects while working with modern technologies and a professional services mindset.

Accountabilities:

  • Backend Development and Platform Integration: Design, develop, integrate, and extend digital banking solutions while applying strong engineering practices to deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Technical Architecture: Translate complex business requirements into practical technical architectures and contribute to solutions involving microservices, distributed systems, SaaS platforms, and service-oriented architectures.
  • Client Collaboration: Work directly with clients in a consultative and professional capacity to understand business challenges, communicate technical solutions, and ensure successful delivery of project outcomes.
  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to build compelling products and services that address real business needs.
  • Quality and Testing: Write clean, testable code and contribute to unit testing, Test Driven Development, continuous integration, peer code reviews, and other practices that maintain high engineering standards.
  • Agile Execution: Apply Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban to manage multiple projects and priorities while helping teams improve delivery effectiveness and collaboration.
  • Problem Solving and Innovation: Investigate complex technical and business challenges, proactively identify solutions, and contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices, products, and client outcomes.

    • Requirements

    • Backbase Experience: At least 2 years of hands-on commercial experience integrating, extending, or implementing the Backbase Digital Banking Platform in production environments, with the ability to describe a commercial project and your personal contributions.
    • Java and Spring: At least 5 years of production-level experience with Java, Spring, and related extensions such as Spring MVC, Spring Boot, and Spring Security.
    • Backend Technologies: Strong experience with SOAP and RESTful web services, XML, JSON, RAML, microservices architectures, and enterprise integration patterns, including frameworks such as Apache Camel.
    • Distributed and Cloud Systems: Experience developing large-scale distributed systems and working with SaaS platforms or service-oriented architectures, together with cloud and container technologies such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, or Kubernetes.
    • Testing and Engineering Practices: Experience with JUnit-based unit testing, Test Driven Development, Continuous Integration, and source control technologies such as Git and Subversion.
    • Application Infrastructure: Familiarity with enterprise application servers such as Tomcat, WebSphere, WebLogic, or JBoss, as well as systems and applications that manage sensitive information.
    • Industry and Professional Services Experience: Background in financial services or professional services, with experience working in an agency or consulting environment where client interaction and consultative delivery are important.
    • Technical Education: A Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or a related field is required.
    • Communication and Collaboration: Strong analytical, problem-solving, teamwork, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, participate in peer code reviews, and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Professional Mindset: A proactive, engaged, adaptable approach to work, combined with a passion for technology, a commitment to clean and maintainable code, and the ability to learn new technologies and concepts quickly.
    • Location and Work Arrangement: This is a 100% remote, full-time opportunity for candidates based in the Americas. Candidates outside Canada may work as independent contractors.

      • Benefits

      • Compensation: CAD $90,000–$130,000 annually for Canadian employees, with an equivalent hourly contractor rate for eligible candidates outside Canada. Compensation is based on skills and experience.
      • Remote-First Work: A 100% remote work environment designed to support flexibility and distributed collaboration.
      • Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and extended health benefits with premiums fully covered by the company for full-time employees.
      • Bonus Programs: Employee bonus programs are available as part of the overall compensation offering.
      • Team Culture: Team-bonding events and a collaborative environment that values respect, support, diverse perspectives, and shared success.
      • Security and Trust: Because the role may involve access to highly sensitive information, successful candidates may be required to complete security screening, including a criminal record check.

title: Consultant

Civiteq is a specialist consultancy working at the intersection of technology, change and public services. We support organisations delivering complex digital transformation programmes, including major ERP implementations. We help them to design, deliver and embed change that genuinely works for people.

We're known for our collaborative culture, deep subject-matter expertise and practical, people-centred approach to delivery.

We're looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Consultant to join our growing team. This is an opportunity to work alongside experienced consultants, supporting clients through complex transformation programmes while building your own consulting, project delivery and business change expertise.

Role Objective

As a Consultant at Civiteq, you will support the delivery of digital transformation, organisational change and service improvement projects for clients across the public and private sectors.

You will work closely with clients, stakeholders and project teams to understand challenges, coordinate activities, analyse information, manage project outputs and help deliver successful outcomes. This role offers exposure to a broad range of transformation initiatives, including ERP implementations, business change programmes, service redesign and technology-enabled transformation.

We're looking for individuals with strong potential, excellent interpersonal skills and a desire to build a successful consulting career. Whilst previous experience in project delivery, consulting or transformation is beneficial, we place equal importance on attitude, behaviours and a willingness to learn.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Coordinating activities, actions, risks and project documentation

  • Supporting workshops, meetings and stakeholder engagement activities

  • Contributing to business change, process improvement and transformation initiatives

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

  • Confidence managing multiple priorities and deadlines

title: Transport & Distribution Worker (Jurien Bay)
description:
Join the Crew That Keeps WA’s Lobster Industry Moving

Geraldton Fishermen’s Co-operative (GFC) isn’t just a workplace—it’s a community. Owned by fishermen, run for fishermen, and powered by people who care about the coast, the catch, and each other.

Since 1950, GFC has been the beating heart of Western Australia’s lobster industry. We process and export the world’s finest Western Rock Lobster, with around 70% of WA’s commercial catch flowing through our supply chain. That makes us the largest rock lobster processor on the planet—and a proud contributor to the WA economy.

We support members, employees, licence holders, and families across 1,000 km of coastline. Now, we’re looking for strong, safety-focused team players to help us deliver the goods.

What GFC Values


We live by the 7 Co-operative Principles, with a strong focus on member participation and community care. Our #1 value is Safety—for our people, our products, and our places.

We’re looking for adaptable, reliable team members who share our commitment to:

  • Working safely and respectfully
  • Supporting each other through seasonal peaks
  • Representing GFC with pride and professionalism


About the Job


GFC operates all year round to service members up and down the coast. While seasonal activity peaks between November and March we are looking for motivated team members to join our team now. Transport & Distribution Worker roles include:

  • Grade 1 (Labourer/Swamper)
  • Grade 4 (HR Driver)


The Transport & Distribution Worker role is a critical and dynamic role, with key working relationships with the Logistic team, the GFC depots and GFC fishermen. Physical fitness is a requirement as the role includes loading and unloading the trucks with baskets of lobsters, bait and fishing supplies which can weigh up to 30 kilos each. It is preferable that Transport & Distribution Workers have flexible availability as the working hours are outside "regular office hours" including afternoons, evenings, nights, and weekends and occasionally shifts may be assigned with short notice.

Essential Job Requirements

  • Ability to pass
    • Alcohol test before each shift
    • Random drug testing
  • Comfortable working with seafood/shellfish
  • Able to lift and move >30kg (dual person lifts available)
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment Medical (Grade 4 Only)
  • HR Driver's Licence (Grade 4 Only)


Essential Skills

  • Manual handling and load securing
  • Experience driving commercially and rural/country driving
  • A desire to want to work in a safe environment, to be safety conscious
  • Ability to deal with situations calmly and diplomatically, allowing open communication and rapport at all levels of the organisation
  • Ability to follow instructions in English. Basic numeracy, literacy, and reasoning abilities
  • Ability to complete appropriate paperwork, Driver's logbook, vehicle logbook, etc
  • Ability to wear appropriate PPE as instructed


Desirable

  • Forklift License
  • Experience in seafood or transport environments

title: Live Operations Team Lead
description:
About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.

Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.

  • One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
  • Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
  • Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
  • Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click on this link to check out our TikTok account.⭐️

The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn’t join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a “pay it forward” mentality, but with big and bold goals.

As a Live Operations Team Lead, you will be leading the Live Operations team in managing real-time operational challenges, ensuring high save rates, controlled emergency (EM) spend, and a consistently strong customer experience. You will oversee day-to-day live operations, support and guide specialists during critical incidents, and drive performance improvements as we scale across high-volume and high-stakes partnerships.

Responsibilities

Team leadership & support

  • Supervise and support Live Operations Specialists during shifts, ensuring fast and effective incident resolution
  • Act as the main escalation point for complex or high-impact cases

Real-time incident oversight

  • Monitor ongoing emergencies (DNS, delays, cancellations) and ensure proper handling
  • Step in when needed to drive resolution of critical or time-sensitive cases

Driver reassignment strategy

  • Oversee and guide reassignment decisions to maximize save rates
  • Ensure optimal use of available supply during peak pressure

EM spend control

  • Monitor EM-related costs in real time and ensure adherence to guidelines
  • Approve or escalate high-cost interventions when necessary

Performance & quality management

  • Track key KPIs (save rate, EM cost, response time, incident handling quality)
  • Provide feedback and coaching to improve team performance

Removal prevention strategy

  • Ensure proactive actions are taken to prevent last-minute removals
  • Coordinate with teams (Driver Ops, Dispatch, CS) when needed

Customer & driver coordination (escalations)

  • Handle sensitive or high-priority customer communications
  • Support drivers during complex incidents and ensure alignment

Incident reporting & documentation

  • Ensure proper documentation of all incidents
  • Review cases and extract insights for continuous improvement

Pattern identification & process improvement

  • Identify recurring operational issues and escalate for systemic fixes
  • Propose and implement improvements in workflows and tools

Shift ownership & planning

  • Own shift performance, including peak hours, weekends, and high-demand periods
  • Ensure proper coverage and readiness for operational pressure

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of previous experience in a supervisory or team lead role in operations, customer support, or live operations roles
  • Strong decision-making skills under pressure
  • Excellent communication skills in English
  • Proven ability to manage incidents and prioritize effectively
  • Analytical mindset with focus on KPIs and performance improvement
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach
  • Ability to lead by example in high-pressure situations
  • Strong ownership mindset with accountability for team performance

Benefits

  • Vibrant and fresh work environment
  • Flexible work-from-home policy
  • The tools you need to perform your daily tasks successfully
  • L&D personal budget
  • Private Insurance Plan
  • +4 extra PTO days annually
  • The unique opportunity to join “the next big thing” at ground level

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. title: Production Technician (Manufacturing)
description:
The Opportunity
Join a growing team where your hands-on expertise really matters. This full-time, permanent role (37.5 hours per week) offers a pay rate from £13.49 per hour, with time-and-a-half for overtime, working Monday-Friday .

We’re looking for motivated Technicians who thrive on assembling and testing complex electro-mechanical products—and are excited to help shape the next phase of our expansion.

Security Vetting Information

OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.

Who We Are

OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.

Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.

We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.

The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.

Here’s what our benefits have to offer:

Rewarding Success - Competitive salary and bonus package, with performance bonuses of up to 25% and clear opportunities for career progression.

Enhanced Pension – Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.

More Time to Recharge – 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.

Breakfast & Lunch on Us – Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.

Health & Wellbeing – Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.

Sustainable Travel – Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.

Team Socials – Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.

Learning & Growth – A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.

What you’ll be doing:
You’ll play a hands-on role in building, testing, and supporting our specialist electro-mechanical products.

  • Assemble: Build intricate electro-mechanical camera systems within a clean-room environment.
  • Construct: Assemble projectiles with precision and consistency.
  • Prepare: Pack nets to exacting standards for operational readiness.
  • Configure: Pack and organise parachutes to meet safety and performance criteria.
  • Rebuild: Refurbish and reassemble shot projectiles used in testing and training.
  • Test: Join our outdoor field-testing activities to validate system performance.
  • Support: Assist with user training activities to help customers operate our products confidently.

What we’re looking for:

We're looking for hands-on, motivated individuals who bring practical skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset.

  • Tool-Proficient: Comfortable using mechanical and electrical hand tools.
  • Soldering-Ready: Keen to learn or already possess basic soldering skills.
  • Wiring-Capable: Interested in developing or already have good basic wiring abilities.
  • Communicative: Able to convey information clearly and confidently.
  • Positive: Bring a proactive, professional, and collaborative attitude.
  • Team-Focused: Thrive in a small, tight-knit, and dedicated team environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Maintain strong organisational skills and a meticulous approach.
  • Self-Driven: Motivated to learn, take initiative, and work effectively without supervision.

More about us:

Vision

Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.

Mission

Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence

Values

Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest

Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done

Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility

We are one team: Look out for each other and the team

Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on

Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people

We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK, as we are not able to provide visa sponsorship.

title: Sr. CET Interior Designer
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a design-driven Sr. CET Interior Designer to join our team. In this role, you will lead the technical execution of office spaces for complex design scopes, guide design strategy, and serve as a vital technical, product, and process resource for the broader team. Representing a top-tier U.S. commercial furniture dealer handling major brands like Haworth, Steelcase, Kimball, and Teknion, you will support multinational clients globally, translating intricate requirements into highly sophisticated, buildable, and high-performance commercial workplace environments.

As a seasoned professional, you will manage detailed documentation, mentor junior designers, and contribute directly to design operations. Partnering with sales leadership, Account Executives, and external partners, you will produce innovative workspace solutions, space plans, and polished visual presentations that win business and inspire global brands


Key Responsibilities


Technical Design & Execution

  • Advanced Visuals & Plans: Lead the development of detailed CET drawings, complex furniture plans, product specifications, high-quality 3D visuals, and presentation materials that align with sales strategy.
  • Space Planning & Standards: Lead detailed space planning efforts, integrating complex systems furniture, architectural plans, site conditions, and strict commercial codes (ADA, LEED, WELL) into accurate designs.
  • Documentation & Installation Packages: Produce and oversee installation drawings and supporting documentation packages, ensuring constructability, clear alignment with project intent, and seamless order entry/as-builts
  • Accuracy & Field Coordination: Conduct field verifications, inventories, and onsite measurements. Identify and resolve discrepancies between plans, specifications, field conditions, and installation requirements.


Strategy & Collaboration

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner strategically with Account Executives, VP of Sales, clients, architectural & design (A&D) firms, contractors, and technical partners (IT, electrical, etc.) to shape project vision.
  • Client Representation: Represent the design function confidently and professionally in client-facing meetings, presentations, and value-alignment discussions.
  • Project Oversight: Provide proactive, regular updates to Design Managers, Team Leads, and Sales leadership while helping steer project direction, risks, and priorities


Leadership, Quality Control & Innovation

  • Mentorship: Mentor Designer I and Designer II team members through technical guidance, drawing reviews, product knowledge, and process coaching.
  • Quality Control: Own design operations standards and workflow improvements, thoroughly reviewing all project deliverables prior to release.
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of product innovations, workplace ergonomics, manufacturer resources, and sustainability considerations, sharing insights across the team.


Qualifications:


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design or related field (FIDER or CIDA-accredited programs preferred).
  • Experience: 3–5+ years of progressive commercial furniture or workplace design industry experience, with specific background in furniture dealership projects and complex commercial interiors.
  • Software Expertise: Advanced mastery and proficiency in CET Designer (Configura) and AutoCAD are required, including complex drawing production, specifications, and revisions. Strong working knowledge of ProjectSpec and Microsoft Office.
  • Product Knowledge: Deep understanding of systems furniture, product specifications, ancillary solutions, finish selections, and technical applications.
  • Mindset & Soft Skills: Highly organized, solutions-driven, and detail-oriented. Possesses the independence and judgment to work with significant autonomy in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple complex projects.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge design technology.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, supportive team that values work-life balance.
  • Play a key role in design operations—your impact on company growth will be evident.
  • Join a culture that values your contributions and equips you with the tools to succeed.
  • Be part of an innovative team that continuously learns and adapts.

title: Oracle EBS - System/Solution Architect
description:
At Significance, we believe the best results come from investing in great people. As a woman-owned consulting firm supporting federal civilian and Department of Defense customers, we bring together talented professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and making a meaningful impact.

We're proud of the culture we've built - one rooted in trust, collaboration, respect, and genuine relationships. Our people are empowered to share ideas, grow their careers, and deliver exceptional results while supporting missions that matter. It's a culture we're proud of, and one that has earned us recognition as a Washington Business Journal Best Place to Work for seven consecutive years.

Significance Inc. is seeking an Oracle EBS - System/Solution Architect to support an upcoming federal program (contingent upon award). This role will be remote.
This role will be supporting The Department of Labor (DOL) requires Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services for its centralized financial management system, New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS). In addition to core O&M functions, the team will support the continuous improvement of financial management services, ensuring system performance, security, and availability meet the evolving needs of DOL stakeholders. All services will be performed in compliance with the applicable standards, policies, and performance expectations.
As a mission-critical enterprise system, NCFMS underpins DOL’s finance and accounting operations, including invoicing and payments, budget execution, fixed asset management, general ledger oversight, and project accounting. NCFMS was upgraded from Oracle EBS v12.1.3 to Oracle EBS v12.2.9 in February 2022. Subsequent notable upgrades include Replacing DUNS with Unique Entity Identifier (UEI); Single Sign On Implementation (PIV card integration with Azure); Implementation of REST APIs for custom developed screens; Deployment of Oracle Analytics Server for all NCFMS reporting needs; Upgrade to Tungsten Markview 2025.3 (10.6),Capture 11.2; Webservice updates to ETA OJC UMS; Integration with GrantSolutions managed by HHS; Implementation of NCFMS Data-in-Transit and Data-at-Rest Encryption; Integration of NCFMS and Treasury G-Invoicing, including migration to U.S. Treasury’s G-Invoicing system for Interagency Agreements (IAA) (7600A) and Orders (7600B); Modernization of the custom developed User Interface framework from legacy Enterprise Java Beans/OC4J code to ReactJS framework.

Required Skills:

    System Solution Architect designs, maintains, and modernizes enterprise financial systems for the Department of Labor's (DOL) New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS).
    Key Responsibilities
    • System Design: Create scalable architecture blueprints for NCFMS modules, ensuring alignment with federal financial standards.
    • Integration & Modernization: Oversee the integration of financial databases, cloud services, and web applications.
    • Compliance & Security: Enforce federal security controls like NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP compliance requirements.
    • Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with agency program managers, financial analysts, and cybersecurity teams to resolve system bottlenecks.

    Core Requirements

    • Experience: 12+ years in enterprise-scale solution architecture, specifically with federal financial or large-scale Oracle ERP systems.
    • Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree from an accredited university, preferably majoring in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.
    • Technical Stack: Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), database administration (Oracle/SQL), and modern API microservices.

Desired Skills:

    DOL is committed to achieving a cutting-edge, adaptable, and sustainable financial management system that meets the evolving needs of the department and its stakeholders that conform to all government regulatory and cybersecurity requirements.

    • Experience with DOL NCFMS or large federal Oracle eBS implementation
    • Agile delivery experience
    • AI focused
    • Team and Client-focused
    • Good communications skills

Additional Information:

    Must be able to obtain a Public Trust Level 5 or 6 clearance

    The work to be performed under this contract action is not anticipated at a gov’t owned/controlled site, however all performance must occur within the continental United States. Accessing Department of Labor (DOL) Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) or logging into the DOL network from outside of the United States is strictly prohibited without proper authorization.

    May be requested to attend meetings in-person at DOL HQ in Washington, DC.

At Significance, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location.
We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a comprehensive and generous benefits package.

title: Android Engineer
description:
We’re looking for an Android Engineer to lead the development of the mobile applications that control our industrial robots for construction automation. This role is open to exceptionally strong candidates with 1-3 years of experience who can operate at a senior level — you’ll own the Android codebase end-to-end, set technical direction for the mobile stack, and work closely with our robotics team to build interfaces that operators rely on in real-world, high-stakes environments. If you’re excited about pushing robotics applications forward and want ownership over a critical piece of the product, we’d love to talk.

Requirements

  • 1-3 years of professional Android development experience, but exceptionally strong: a track record of shipping complex, production-grade native apps and operating with senior-level ownership and judgment
  • Expert-level Kotlin (Java experience a plus); deep understanding of the Android SDK and app architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture, etc.)
  • Strong command of Kotlin Coroutines, dispatchers, and structured concurrency, and a solid grasp of Android component lifecycles (Activity/Fragment/ViewModel/Service) and how they interact with real-time data streams
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining apps that handle real-time data, low-latency communication, and hardware/device control
  • Familiarity with Magisk, root-level Android customization, and system-level modifications on custom or embedded hardware
  • Strong grasp of concurrency, multithreading, and performance optimization for resource-constrained or safety-critical applications
  • Experience with networking protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT, or similar) for real-time robot control and telemetry
  • Solid understanding of SQLite and relational databases, including schema design and query/database performance optimization
  • Experience building or maintaining backend services with Python and FastAPI, including RESTful API design
  • Demonstrated ability to drive code quality through reviews, testing, and sound architectural decisions
  • Comfortable owning technical decisions independently and collaborating cross-functionally with robotics, hardware, and backend teams
  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices
  • (Bonus) Experience building or customizing HMI (Human-Machine Interface) layers for industrial, embedded, or field-operated devices
  • (Bonus) Experience with Bluetooth/BLE, ROS, or other robotics communication frameworks

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain native Android applications for robot control and monitoring
  • Design and build the HMI (Human-Machine Interface) layer that operators use to control and monitor robots in the field
  • Define and evolve the technical roadmap for the mobile platform
  • Design intuitive, reliable UI/UX for operators working in demanding field conditions

title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison
description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage clinical development for the treatment of congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI). Rezolute’s mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity.

The Sr Medical Science Liaison (Sr MSL) are responsible for developing and enhancing professional relationships with medical thought leaders within the metabolic and oncologic space. Sr MSLs provide medical information through scientific exchange, and clinical/scientific support for Rezolute and the Medical Affairs department. This work position requires professionals with established personal and scientific credibility to interact with global thought leaders and academic centers of excellence. The Sr MSL will represent Rezolute to the highest professional and ethical standards, in accordance with company guidelines, policies, and the mission and values of the Medical Affairs organization.

The Sr MSL position reports to Sr. Medical Director Endocrine Oncology

Essential Functions

    KOL Development and Field Engagement:

    • Identify, develop, and maintain peer-to-peer relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and healthcare providers within relevant Metabolic and Oncology therapeutic areas

    • Identify new, up and coming thought leaders within target therapeutic areas

    • Develop and execute projects and program material in alignment with evolving launch readiness plans

    • Identify and communicate key clinical and research issues and insights from KOLs to appropriate departments

    • Capture, analyze, and report field-based medical and scientific insights in a structured and compliant manner to inform Rezolute’s strategic decision-making

    • Participate in medical education for healthcare professionals (HCPs) through virtual/on-site presentations at healthcare institutions, investigator meetings, national/international conferences, advisory boards, or regional meetings

    • Provide scientific support for additional activities such as medical congress staffing, advisory boards, and internal and external training initiatives

    • Respond to unsolicited medical information requests from healthcare professionals in a timely, accurate, and balanced manner

    • Support other Medical Affairs activities and responsibilities as assigned


    Positions self as Scientific Expert

    • Maintains an up to date and high-level knowledge of the therapy area, Rezolute products, new and emerging areas of research, therapeutic issues and trends, and competitive landscape.

    • Establishes reputation as a trustworthy and knowledgeable source of scientific and medical information for the healthcare community.

    • Supports development of Rezolute positioning as the scientific authority in Metabolism & Oncology therapeutic space. Attends appropriate scientific congresses to stay abreast of developments and to support International, National, Regional and local KOL activities and Rezolute interests.

    • Acquires a broad understanding of local, national and international protocols and standards of clinical practice and trends in disease management.

    • Provide clinical presentations and information in response to unsolicited questions (as appropriate) in academic, community, and healthcare provider settings in both group and one-on-one situations

    • Communicates emerging data and the clinical experience with our products through scientific exchange and peer-to-peer interactions discussing benefits and risks in an objective manner.

    • Provide support for data generation activities (company-sponsored studies, collaboration studies, ISTs and Rezolute’s Expanded Access Program)

    • Critically evaluate emerging scientific literature and evidence to provide evidence-based insights that inform internal strategy and external engagement.

    • Proactively identify and communicate potential publication opportunities arising from scientific exchange, field insights from interaction with external experts, data gaps, and analysis of the evolving literature

    Medical Affairs Planning and Plan Execution

    • Contributes to the development of the launch readiness plans and provides input into strategies and tactics.

    • Strong business acumen and understanding of cross-functional processes across research, clinical development, regulatory, and commercial functions.”

    • Works in a collaborative manner with cross-functional colleagues to meet defined strategic imperatives and critical success factors of commercial launch of Rezolute product(s).

    • Interacts with HCPs as a scientific resource to support activities aligned with launch readiness plans including advisory boards, speaker development, data generation and publication plans and clinical trials, as appropriate.

    Responsible for maintaining Company standards and values

    • Consistently acts to enhance Rezolute’s image as an advocate of medical advancement by using knowledge of product, disease state and pipeline products to engage healthcare providers in meaningful scientific exchange of information.

    • Document and forward reports of adverse events and product complaints according to Rezolute's policy to ensure safe and effective use of Rezolute’s products.

    • Adheres to the relevant international, national and local Codes of Practice.

    • Behaves ethically and with integrity at all times.

    • Acts as an ambassador for Rezolute following company mission and values.

    • Keeps own written development plan and implements.

    • Prepares timely reporting according to the company needs.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

    • Ability to research, critically analyze and communicate complex scientific/medical information and data.

    • Clear and concise communication and presentation skills.

    • Excellent planning and organization skills, with high-level attention to detail and accuracy.

    • Strong strategic mindset.

    • Highly self-motivated and ability to work autonomously.

    • Ability to learn quickly, be flexible and results-focused in a rapidly changing environment.

    • Demonstrated skills in inter-personal relationship building, networking, collaboration and teamwork.

    • Strong capabilities working with Microsoft suite of products and other digital platforms and tools are required

    • Excellent command of spoken and written English.

    • Ability and willingness to travel. Driving may be required.

    • Knowledge of healthcare environment and external experts in academia and medical community.

    • Demonstrated ability to develop trust and relationships with opinion leaders in disease states of interest.

    • Understanding of regulatory requirements for field-based personnel

    • Experience as a Medical Science Liaison with a strong track record of success is strongly preferred

    Required Education and Licenses

    • Advanced medical, clinical, or similar degree (such as MD, PhD, PharmD, , PA or equivalent)

    • A minimum of 5 years' experience as a MSL or comparable industry or clinical role is required, with a minimum of 2 years’ experience in rare disease.

    • This position will require field activities, and applicants must be willing to travel 60-75% time

    • Valid driver's license and live within 60 miles of an airport services by at least one major airline.


    Description of Physical Demands

    • Frequent travel (domestic and international) with potential extended time away from home.

    • Frequently operating a computer, printer, telephone and other similar office machinery.

    • Responsibilities may require a work schedule that may include working outside of "normal" work hours, in order to meet business demands.

    Preferred Experience, Special Skills and Knowledge

    • Ability to effectively prioritize and deliver high-quality results on tight timelines
    • Outstanding problem-solving skills including the ability to devise and implement practical solutions to resolve complex issues
    • Excellent English written, verbal communication and presentation skills

    • Act with HONOR: Honesty, Open with Direct Communication, Nimbleness, Open-minded, Respect

title: R&D Engineer – Specialty Fiber Preform Processes
description:
Join the international teams of Prysmian's Optical Fiber R&D organization and contribute to the development and industrialization of next-generation specialty optical fibers at the Douvrin plant, France.

Description:

Reporting to Fiber R&D Management, you will drive glass preparation, glass-structure assembly and drilling process development, qualification and scale-up for specialty fibers, especially Multi-Core Fiber, PANDA fiber and reduced-diameter fiber. You will support innovation projects from laboratory development through industrial implementation, with a strong focus on product performance, process robustness, manufacturing efficiency and cost competitiveness.

In a multicultural and multisite environment, you will:

  • Develop, optimize and industrialize manufacturing processes used for specialty fiber preforms and optical fibers.

  • Support the development of advanced products including Multi-Core Fibers, Polarization Maintaining Fibers, reduced-diameter fibers and future specialty fiber technologies.

  • Define, execute and analyze experimental programs to improve process capability, product quality and manufacturing efficiency.

  • Establish process specifications, operating windows and qualification criteria based on experimental results and statistical analysis.

  • Lead process qualification and validation activities in collaboration with Product R&D, Quality, Process Control and Manufacturing teams.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on yield improvement, cost reduction, process robustness and operational excellence.

  • Investigate process deviations, perform root-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.

  • Support technology transfer and deployment of new products and processes into manufacturing.

  • Contribute to equipment upgrades, tooling development, metrology improvements and industrial investment projects.

  • Collaborate with international R&D teams and production sites to share knowledge and best practices.

  • Contribute to innovation activities through patents, publications, technical benchmarking and technology watch.

  • Develop technical expertise and actively share knowledge within the organization.

Safety First:

In our industrial environment, safety is paramount. You will:

  • Apply and enforce health, safety, and environmental regulations.

  • Promote the prevention of occupational risks and control of pollution and nuisances.

  • Adhere to and advocate for best practices in safety and continuous improvement.

Travel within Prysmian's international organization may occasionally be required.

Profile :

  • Master's degree in Engineering or Science (Materials Science, Physics, Optics, Photonics, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering or similar); PhD is a plus.
  • Experience in industrial R&D, process development, manufacturing engineering or technology development.
  • Knowledge of optical fiber manufacturing, glass processing, deposition technologies, plasma processes, precision assembly, glass drilling or advanced manufacturing processes is an advantage.
  • Strong experimental mindset with demonstrated capabilities in data analysis, statistical methods and problem solving.
  • Experience with Design of Experiments (DoE), process characterization and industrial qualification methodologies.
  • Knowledge of programming, data analytics and database tools (Python, SQL, statistical software) is appreciated.
  • Fluent English is mandatory; French is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Autonomous, rigorous, innovative, hands-on and results-oriented.

title: Technical Data Analyst
description:
## **About the Opportunity**

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 28 September 2026

**Job Description**

**Title** Technical Data Analyst

**Department**      Asset Management Platform

**Location** Dublin, Ireland

**Level** 6

**About Fidelity International**

Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.

Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.

**About your team**

Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.

The Portfolio Management Tooling team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used by Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers and Investment Specialists across multiple investment capabilities, including Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, Fixed Income and Equities. Our platforms underpin critical investment processes including research, portfolio construction, analytics, order generation, execution management and investment risk.

As Artificial Intelligence increasingly changes how portfolio management tools are developed, access to trusted, well-structured and governed enterprise data becomes critical. The Technical Data Analyst will help establish the data foundations required by the team's AI-enabled applications, working closely with Data Strategy, engineering and investment stakeholders.

**About your team**

Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.

The Portfolio Management Tooling team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used by Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers and Investment Specialists across multiple investment capabilities, including Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, Fixed Income and Equities. Our platforms underpin critical investment processes including research, portfolio construction, analytics, order generation, execution management and investment risk.

As Artificial Intelligence increasingly changes how portfolio management tools are developed, access to trusted, well-structured and governed enterprise data becomes critical. The Technical Data Analyst will help establish the data foundations required by the team's AI-enabled applications, working closely with Data Strategy, engineering and investment stakeholders.

**About your role**

The Technical Data Analyst will provide the bridge between Portfolio Management Tooling and FIL's enterprise data capabilities, working closely with the Data Strategy team to make trusted, well-structured data available to AI-developed portfolio management tools.

You will combine strong data engineering and modelling knowledge with an understanding of modern AI data patterns, helping translate application and investment requirements into scalable, reusable data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Modelling & Integration**

- Design and develop **AI-ready data models** for enterprise and investment data used by AI applications, agents and front-office portfolio management tooling.
- Develop **data transformations and integration patterns** that connect enterprise data sources and curated datasets with the needs of AI applications.
- Design for **scalability and reuse**, ensuring common data capabilities can support multiple portfolio management tools and AI use cases.

**AI & Data Enablement**

- Work closely with the **FIL Data Strategy team and its Snowflake implementation** to identify, shape and make the data required by AI-developed portfolio management tools readily available for consumption.
- Support **modern AI data patterns**, including RAG, embeddings, vector search and the integration of structured and unstructured data.
- Use **AI-assisted development and rapid prototyping** to accelerate delivery while ensuring successful data solutions can be productionised in a robust and maintainable way.

**Data Quality & Governance**

- Embed **data quality, governance and lineage** into data solutions, ensuring AI applications have access to trusted, controlled and traceable data.

**Collaboration**

- Collaborate with **AI engineers, investment stakeholders, Data Strategy and architects** to translate business and application needs into practical data requirements and solutions.

**About you**

You are a **Technical Data Analyst** with a strong background in enterprise data and a passion for making data accessible, trusted and usable by modern applications. You enjoy working across business, data and engineering teams and are interested in how Snowflake and modern AI data patterns can provide the foundations for AI-enabled portfolio management solutions.

**Experience**

**Core Experience**

- Practical experience with **Snowflake**, including enterprise datasets, data modelling, transformations and curated data layers.
- Experience designing and implementing **ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines** integrating data from multiple enterprise sources.
- Good understanding of **data modelling, data quality, lineage and governance** with a focus on creating trusted and reusable datasets.
- Practical experience using **SQL and/or Python** for data analysis, transformation and automation.
- Experience working collaboratively with **data, engineering and architecture teams** to translate application and business requirements into practical data solutions.

**Useful Additional Experience**

- **Snowflake Cortex** and its use in AI-enabled data solutions.
- **AWS data and analytics capabilities** and integration with enterprise data platforms.
- **AI data pipelines, RAG, embeddings and vector search**.
- Integration of **structured and unstructured data** for AI applications and agent-based solutions.
- **APIs and enterprise data integration** patterns.
- **AI-assisted development tools and techniques**.

Experience within **Asset Management, Investment Management or Financial Services** is desirable but not essential.

**Personal Attributes**

- Passionate about **data, technology and the opportunities created by AI**, with curiosity about emerging data and AI technologies.
- Strong **analytical and problem-solving skills**, with the ability to understand complex data landscapes and identify practical solutions.
- **Collaborative** and comfortable working across business, data, engineering and architecture teams.
- **Pragmatic and delivery-focused**, able to move quickly from analysis and prototyping through to robust, production-ready solutions.
- Comfortable working in an **evolving environment**, taking ownership and working through ambiguity.

Able to balance rapid innovation with appropriate **data governance, security and risk controls**.
