title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go) (m/w/d)
description:
About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.


In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.


This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.



What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

description:

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
With more than 40 years of experience in the healthcare sector, Bioiatriki Healthcare Group is the leading provider of Primary care services in Greece. With a strong commitment to superior medical and digital technology, Bioiatriki is dedicated to advancing health and science and prides itself in its skilled and specialized workforce.

In BIOIATRIKI, we value our people as the “heart” of our organization and actively embrace our vision to look after every person’s health needs and support people live life well!

We embrace our values: Empathy, Excellence, Vision, and Accountability, creating a work environment that promotes diversity and creates growth potential for our employees.

Position Overview

As a Senior Database Administrator, you will play a critical role within our IT team by managing and optimizing our Microsoft SQL Server environment in a complex enterprise infrastructure.

You will take ownership of the full lifecycle of database operations — from performance monitoring and tuning to high availability, disaster recovery and security management. Your work will ensure that our mission-critical systems, including ERP and Business Intelligence platforms, remain secure, stable and highly available.

In addition, you will collaborate closely with Application, BI and SAP teams, acting as a key technical point of reference for database-related matters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support multiple Microsoft SQL Server instances (on-premise & virtualized environments).
  • Monitor database performance, perform performance tuning and capacity planning.
  • Design and implement backup, restore and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Ensure high availability (HA/DR) and business continuity.
  • Manage database security, permissions and compliance policies.
  • Develop and maintain SQL jobs, stored procedures and automation scripts.
  • Support and optimize ETL processes (e.g. SSIS or equivalent tools).
  • Enable data integration and exchange with SAP S/4HANA systems.
  • Support Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence environments.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with Application, BI and SAP teams to ensure seamless system operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Microsoft SQL Server DBA in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong knowledge of T-SQL.
  • Proven experience in performance tuning and query optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with backup/restore, replication, Always On and clustering.
  • Experience with ETL tools (e.g. SSIS or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of Data Warehouse and BI principles.
  • Experience in ERP integrations (ideally SAP).
  • Ability to manage mission-critical systems.
  • Very good command of the English language.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in SAP S/4HANA integrations.
  • Knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, etc.).
  • Experience in virtualization and/or cloud environments.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g. Azure Data, SQL Server).
  • Knowledge of other RDBMS platforms (e.g. Oracle).

Benefits

  • Life & Health Insurance plan
  • Healthcare provisions for employees and their first-degree relatives
  • Continuous training and unlimited access to the Group’s online L&D platform
  • Friendly and dynamic work environment with continuous feedback and career development opportunities
  • The opportunity to contribute to a leading healthcare organization with strong social impact

title: DESENVOLVEDOR APEX FULLSTACK SR
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a DESENVOLVEDOR APEX FULLSTACK SR based in Brazil.

This role is ideal for a senior developer who combines strong technical expertise with a broad understanding of business and systems.
You will design, develop, test, maintain, and troubleshoot applications within the Oracle APEX ecosystem.
The position goes beyond front-end development, requiring deep knowledge of Oracle APEX, PL/SQL, and Oracle Database.
You will contribute to solutions that prioritize quality, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
The role also involves integrations, technical and architectural decisions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of development practices.
You will work with modern development and version-control tools while collaborating with other technical professionals and supporting less experienced team members.
Autonomy, analytical thinking, and a strong problem-solving mindset will be key to delivering reliable solutions that meet business needs.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop and evolve Oracle APEX applications: Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Oracle APEX, ensuring solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with business requirements.
  • Build database solutions: Develop robust solutions using PL/SQL and Oracle Database, including Procedures, Functions, Packages, Views, and other database objects.
  • Develop integrations: Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, REST Data Sources, Web Services, and related technologies to connect applications and external systems.
  • Customize application interfaces: Develop and enhance APEX interfaces using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to deliver functional and effective user experiences.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize: Investigate and resolve application and database issues, including performance problems and technical challenges involving PL/SQL and JavaScript.
  • Contribute to technical decisions: Participate in technical and architectural discussions, helping define solutions that prioritize security, performance, quality, and maintainability.
  • Promote development quality: Conduct code reviews and contribute to development standards, best practices, and continuous improvements across the technical environment.
  • Manage version control: Work with Git, GitLab, or similar tools to support versioning, collaboration, and controlled change management.
  • Support technical development: Provide technical guidance to less experienced professionals, sharing knowledge and helping strengthen development practices across the team.

    • Requirements

    • Oracle APEX expertise: Solid and proven professional experience developing applications with Oracle APEX.
    • Oracle certification: Active or demonstrable Oracle APEX certification.
    • PL/SQL proficiency: Strong command of PL/SQL and practical experience developing database-driven solutions.
    • Oracle Database knowledge: Solid knowledge of Oracle Database and its development ecosystem.
    • Front-end development: Practical experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS applied within Oracle APEX applications.
    • Integration experience: Hands-on experience developing and working with REST APIs and related integration technologies.
    • Troubleshooting skills: Proven ability to investigate and resolve technical issues involving PL/SQL, JavaScript, application behavior, and database performance.
    • Security and performance: Knowledge of best practices for application security, performance optimization, and Oracle APEX development.
    • Version control: Experience with Git, GitLab, or similar version-control and collaboration tools.
    • Professional profile: Autonomous, analytical, and highly oriented toward problem-solving, with the ability to understand business needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.

title: Sr. Import/Export Analyst
description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS:

MKS Instruments is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Import/Export Analyst to join our Global Trade Compliance team. This role is responsible for supporting import and export compliance activities across multiple business units and regions. The successful candidate will ensure products are accurately classified for import and export purposes, support customs compliance initiatives, manage export control requirements, and partner with Supply Chain, Engineering, Logistics, Finance, and Customer Support teams to maintain compliance with global trade regulations while enabling business objectives.

You Will Make an Impact By:

  • Manage import and export trade compliance activities, including HTS classification, export classification (ECCN), country of origin determinations, restricted party screening, and export license reviews

  • Conduct product classifications utilizing engineering specifications, technical drawings, bills of materials, and product documentation to ensure compliance with global customs and export control requirements

  • Qualify products for applicable free trade agreements and preferential trade programs, including USMCA, KORUS, ILFTA, and other regional agreements

  • Support import and export operations by reviewing shipments, documentation, broker requests, customs declarations, and other trade transactions to ensure regulatory compliance

  • Respond to trade compliance inquiries from internal stakeholders, brokers, and logistics providers

  • Perform trade compliance audits and data analytics to identify process improvements, mitigate compliance risks, and support duty savings and recovery opportunities

  • Support customs inquiries, audits, disclosures, and regulatory reporting requirements

  • Maintain trade compliance procedures, records, and documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements

Skills You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Supply Chain, International Trade, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in import/export compliance, customs compliance, or global trade operations

  • Strong knowledge of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification methodologies

  • Experience with export controls, including ECCN classification, export licensing, and restricted party screening

  • Experience qualifying products under Free Trade Agreements and preferential trade programs

  • Experience with supporting responses to customs inquiries, audits, CF28s, CF29s, and other regulatory requests

  • Strong analytical skills with experience auditing trade transactions and identifying duty savings opportunities

  • Ability to interpret technical product information and collaborate effectively with engineering teams

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills

  • Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred), trade compliance software, and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Skills:

  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) preferred.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to communicate information and ideas so others will understand

  • Must be able to exchange accurate information

  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

title: 22158 - Head of Corporate Service
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Key responsibilities may include:

• Providing strategic leadership and direction for Corporate Services across the North West region.
• Supporting the Regional Probation Director and senior leadership team through effective governance, assurance and performance oversight.
• Leading and coordinating key corporate functions, including Workforce, Estates and Facilities Management, Risk, Health and Safety, and other regional priorities, to support safe, effective and consistent operational delivery.
• Working collaboratively with PDU Heads, regional leads and national colleagues to resolve issues, manage risk and drive improvement.
• Ensuring corporate services are responsive to regional priorities, business planning requirements and emerging operational pressures.
• Promoting a positive, inclusive and high-performing culture across the Corporate Services function.

We are looking for an experienced and credible senior leader who can operate confidently in a complex regional environment. You will bring strong leadership, excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across operational and corporate teams.

You should be able to balance strategic oversight with practical delivery, manage competing priorities and provide clear advice and assurance to senior stakeholders. A collaborative, inclusive and solution-focused approach will be essential, together with the ability to lead through change and support continuous improvement.

Anyone interested in the role is welcome to have a discussion with Andrea Leather to find out more. To arrange this, please contact Kali Gaffney on 0151 832 3281 or via email on kali.gaffney@justice.gov.uk

6 month contract with a possible extension to 12 months

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

description:
Role:- Solution Architect

Job Description

title: Project Officer
description:
About WorldFish

WorldFish is an international research organization working to transform aquatic food systems to reduce hunger, malnutrition, and poverty. It collaborates with international, regional, and national partners to co-develop and deliver scientific innovations, evidence for policy and knowledge to enable equitable and inclusive impact for millions who depend on fish and other aquatic foods for their livelihoods and nutrition. Our work in countries advances progress on multiple 2030 Sustainable Development Goals through science and innovation, with a vision of healthy people, healthy planet and shared prosperity.

About the Position

Under the supervision of the Country Representative the Project Officer is responsible for serving as a distributing information within the project, documenting review meetings, clarifying requests, managing visitor logistics, and administering contractor contracts to support efficient engagement and collaboration. The role ensures the delivery of quality services by maintaining donor funding data, arranging travel logistics, updating project records, and compiling data for reporting. The Project Officer supports effective project execution through streamlined communication, accurate record management, and reliable logistical support.

Key Responsibilities

Main Purpose of Job:

  • Provide information to and maintain project management tracking system in coordination with other teams to ensure timely implementation within budgets.
  • Execute operational administrative tasks related to procurement, logistics, contracts and payments, including handling requests for IT, to enable efficient completion of project objectives.
  • Gather, verify and maintain project databases and filing systems, including budget to ensure documents are complete and easily available, and expenditures align with available budgets and procedures.
  • Provide logistical and administration support in the organization of workshops, project meetings and training to ensure smooth delivery of events, including the arrangement of travel.
  • Support day-to-day administrative operations for RedSeaFish project and Abbassa Center

Main engagement, collaboration and communication responsibilities:

  • Serve as help desk contact point for projects for routine queries and responses.
  • Distribute received information within the project as directed by supervisor to support efficient flow of internal communication.
  • Record and track project review meetings within the project team to document discussions and decisions for successful project implementation.
  • Communicate and clarify requests and service details with other teams, consultants and partners, to ensure alignment and a seamless exchange of information and execution of tasks.
  • Welcome and guide visitors, managing their logistics and schedules during their stay to ensure effective use of their time.
  • Administer contractor contracts by collaborating with other teams to create contracts, review deliverables, and process payments, ensuring adherence to policies and deadlines.

Main responsibilities in the delivery of timely and quality services:

  • Arrange logistical and travel plans for team members, visitors, and workshop participants, including handling visas, hotel bookings, and claims, to ensure efficient and timely travel according to policies.
  • Maintain and regularly update shared project folders, databases, and filing systems, to ensure reliable institutional and project record management.
  • Collate project data for periodic reporting as required.

Requirements

This job might be for you if you have the below skills and qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Public Administration, Finance, Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Experience implementing routine administration and coordination processes.
  • Experience maintaining administrative databases.
  • Experience providing administrative and logistical support to meetings and facilitating information exchange.
  • Experience in project administration is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience handling procurement requests is an advantage.

Key Competencies Required

Core competencies

  • Accountability: Collaborates with team members, taking responsibility for both individual and team success and seeks feedback to improve performance. Meets deadlines consistently and follows ethical guidelines.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Conveys information clearly and ensures the recipient understands the message. Fully engages in conversations and shares relevant information to support informed decision-making.
  • Respect and Inclusion: Acknowledges team members' contributions and collaborates effectively with diverse colleagues. Demonstrates flexibility and openness, supporting inclusive approaches that encourage full participation.
  • Results and Impact Orientation: Proactively identifies challenges and demonstrates effective problem-solving; Consistently fulfills commitments and respects the organization’s mission and values. Adapts to new processes, emerging technologies and evolving requirements to maintain efficiency.

Functional and Technical Competencies

  • Analytical, Critical and Systems Thinking: Analyzes information from multiple sources to identify trends, draw conclusions, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Monitoring and Reporting: Has a good understanding of monitoring data collection tools and approaches (and/or financial monitoring) and reports anomalies; composes concise and coherent sentences that effectively convey key messages and supports ideas with evidence.
  • Data Analysis, Management and Visualization: Verifies data accuracy and consistency, addresses simple errors, summarizes and organizes data, and interprets basic trends using available systems and evolving data methodologies to support decisions or activities.
  • Planning and Organizing: Plans and manages multiple priorities and deadlines independently, using time management tools to stay on track, and effectively balances competing tasks while adjusting as needed.
  • Project / Program Management: Collaborates with team members to resolve project-related issues and tracks project milestones and budgets, identifying potential delays.

Benefits

This is a Nationally Recruited Staff (NRS) position and WorldFish offers a competitive remuneration package including comprehensive benefits (but not limited to) insurance coverage for staff and eligible dependents, employer provident fund contribution, paid leave, and others. The duration of the contract will initially be for a three-year period with possibility for extension, depending on funding and performance

How to Apply

Your application must include:

  • A copy of your curriculum vitae,
  • A cover letter which addresses key requirements stated above; and
  • Contact information of three professional referees who may be contacted if you are short-listed for the position.

To be considered, applications must be submitted by no later than 23:59 (MYT), 24 September 2026.

Location: The post holder serves in two locations; project location and WorldFish Ash Sharqiya, Governorate.

The screening will start immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Due to the high volume of applicants for WorldFish positions, we appreciate all interest, but only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Our Gender, Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

Over 40% of WorldFish staff is women with some 30 nationalities represented and contributing to its dynamic multicultural work environment. WorldFish is committed to promoting a work environment where diversity and inclusion are valued and we seek to have gender balance in the organization. We aim to also seek balance across other diversity dimensions.

People in WorldFish are treated equally irrespective of gender, ethnicity/race, national or social origin, disability, religion, political affiliation, age, family size, marital status or any other form of personal identity.

We are an equal opportunities employer and strongly encourage qualified women and men from developing nations to apply.

description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Teknisk projektleder
description:
Har du teknisk forståelse, projektledererfaring og styr på leverancen fra start til slut? Så er du måske Heydays nye tekniske projektleder.

Rollen kræver erfaring med digitale løsninger og en god teknisk forståelse, så du hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i komplekse problemstillinger. Din tekniske ballast kan være opbygget gennem både uddannelse og erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du kan stille de rigtige spørgsmål og indgå i en kvalificeret dialog med både kunder og udviklingsteams.

Du trives med at holde overblikket og arbejde struktureret med opfølgning og planlægning. Samtidig er du en people-person, der formår at skabe gode relationer til både kolleger og kunder. Hos Heyday bliver du en del af et kreativt udviklingsmiljø, hvor du kommer til at arbejde med hele udviklingsprocessen fra idé og koncept til færdigt produkt og efterfølgende drift.

Om rollen

Du bliver en del af et energisk team med en bred vifte af kompetencer inden for udvikling af komplekse digitale it-løsninger. Du får ansvar for en række kunder og den samlede leverance på dine projekter, hvor du sikrer fremdrift, deadlines og løsninger, der imødekommer kundernes behov.

Du faciliterer udviklings- og arkitekturprocessen i tæt samarbejde med det tekniske team og omsætter kundens behov til krav og epics. Her bringer du dine kompetencer som projektleder i spil, håndterer change requests og sikrer QA. Samtidig deltager du aktivt i dialogen med eksisterende kunder og bidrager til videreudvikling og mersalg.

Din tekniske ballast gør dig i stand til at vejlede kunderne om websites, CMS, e-commerce, apps og andre tekniske løsninger. Du kommer også til at arbejde med projekter, hvor AI indgår som en naturlig del af løsningen, fx intelligente assistenter, automatisering og integration af AI i websites, apps og forretningskritiske systemer.

Om dig

Du trives med at have ansvar for projekter, hvor kundens behov, den tekniske løsning og et godt samarbejde skal gå op i en højere enhed. Du arbejder struktureret og analytisk, holder overblikket, også når der er mange bolde i luften og korte deadlines, og motiveres af at skabe fremdrift og nå dine mål. Samtidig er du nysgerrig og god til at stille de rigtige spørgsmål, gå i dybden med kundens behov og forstå de tekniske problemstillinger, før retningen sættes.

Som person er du stærk i den kundevendte rolle og god til at skabe relationer. Du motiveres af at arbejde med en bred vifte af kunder med forskellige behov og produkter og kan guide dem til at træffe de rette valg omkring deres digitale løsninger og platforme.

Kvalifikationer

For at lykkes i rollen skal du først og fremmest have en solid projektlederværktøjskasse og en stærk teknisk forståelse. Du skal kunne drive komplekse digitale udviklingsprojekter fra start til slut og samtidig være teknisk stærk nok til at gå ind i dialogen med både kunder og udviklingsteams.

Vi forestiller os, at du kommer med erfaring fra:

  • teknisk projektledelse og digitale udviklingsprojekter
  • kundevendte projekter, gerne fra et konsulenthus eller digitalt bureau
  • CMS, digitale platforme eller andre komplekse digitale løsninger
  • udviklingsprocesser og gerne DevOps og arbejdet med epics
  • erfaring med at afdække kundens behov og omsætte dem til konkrete løsninger

Erfaring med AI-projekter er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på teknologi og har lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye løsninger.

Om Heyday

Heyday beskæftiger cirka 30 medarbejdere, som alle har en travl og dynamisk hverdag med et tæt samarbejde mellem forskellige teams og fagområder. Heyday er et succesfuldt digitalt bureau, som blev startet i 2008.

Som vores nye tekniske projektleder får du mulighed for at arbejde i et miljø, hvor korte beslutningsveje og en uformel og flad organisation er med til at bane vejen for en varieret og aldrig kedelig hverdag.

En af vores absolutte styrker er, at vi kan kæmpe sammen frem mod en deadline, grine af hinandens fejl og lære af hinandens kompetencer. Hver dag styrker vi fællesskabet gennem vores arbejde, men også når vi afholder fælles arrangementer.

Vi bor i hjertet af Aarhus, hvor vi udvikler spændende løsninger for en række private og offentlige virksomheder. Her håndterer vi digitale opgaver i alle faser – fra strategi og konceptudvikling til design, webudvikling, appudvikling, drift, kampagnestyring og analyse.

AI er i dag en integreret del af både vores rådgivning, arbejdsprocesser og digitale løsninger. Vi hjælper vores kunder med at identificere, udvikle og implementere AI-løsninger – fra den første idé og prototype til færdig løsning og efterfølgende drift.

Heyday udvikler bl.a. løsninger for Normal, NCG, Landbrug & Fødevarer, DOT, Vikan, Dansk Bilglas og Lidl.

Er du interesseret?

Er du interesseret i at høre mere om rollen, er du velkommen til at kontakte TalentPeople A/S på +45 7020 4011 eller sende os dit CV på info@talentpeople.dk.

title: Master Thesis: Enhancing Antenna System aspects with Digital Technologies
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Ericsson shapes the future through technology leadership and provides innovative solutions in more than 180 countries. We are involved in advanced antenna systems for 5G and LTE evolution, focusing on antenna systemization for overall system performance, verification technologies, and over-the-air testing of advanced/active antenna systems.

We are now offering interesting Master Thesis opportunities, where you will work with our senior staff on challenging problems at the intersection of antenna technology and digitalization, with opportunities to contribute to real-world applications. As a thesis student, you’ll contribute to innovative projects that push technology forward, with AI/ML approaches suggested in most topics.

What you will do:

The work generally includes a literature review, development of novel methods, validation, and preparation of a formal thesis report.

  • Investigate a selected thesis topic related to antenna systemization, advanced antenna design, or the development of sophisticated test methods for antenna systems. Multiple topics are available to be agreed on for the thesis.
  • Propose and apply innovative approaches using digitalization technologies to enhance spatial measurement capabilities as outlined in the agreed thesis scope.
  • Validate the proposed methods through simulations or measurements based on the thesis plan.
  • Document and present your findings in a detailed thesis report.

The skills you will bring:

  • Enrollment in a Master’s program in Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Preferred: Coursework in Antenna Technology.
  • Good knowledge of Electromagnetic field theory.
  • Experience with AI/ML.
  • Experience programming in Python, MATLAB, Java, or similar.

Additional desirable knowledge: RF measurement techniques, video signal processing, or related areas.

This thesis is suitable for one or two persons and offers the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects that push the boundaries of technology and deliver high value in the field of mobile communications.

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Τεχνολόγος - Ακτινολόγος Περαία
description:

Με δέσμευση στην ιατρική και στην ψηφιακή τεχνολογία, παραμένουμε αφοσιωμένοι στην προώθηση της υγείας και της επιστήμης, προσφέροντας ευκαιρίες απασχόλησης σε εξειδικευμένο εργατικό δυναμικό.

Στη Βιοιατρική, οι Άνθρωποί μας είναι η «καρδιά» του οργανισμού μας και υποστηρίζουν ενεργά το όραμά μας να φροντίζουμε τις ανάγκες υγείας κάθε ατόμου και να συμβάλουμε προς μια Καλύτερη Ποιότητα Ζωής για Όλους! Με όχημα τις αξίες μας, Ενσυναίσθηση, Αριστεία, Όραμα & Υπευθυνότητα, δημιουργούμε ένα περιβάλλον εργασίας που προάγει τη διαφορετικότητα και τη συμπερίληψη και αναπτύσσει τις δυνατότητες των ανθρώπων μας.

Την περίοδο αυτή αναζητούμε Τεχνολόγο - Ακτινολόγο για τη στελέχωση τμημάτων κλασικού ακτινολογικού, αξονικού και μαγνητικού τομογράφου στο Διαγνωστικό Κέντρο Περαίας.

Η ποιοτική εξυπηρέτηση των εξεταζόμενων μέσω της άριστης εκτέλεσης όλων των εξετάσεων στα συστήματα απεικόνισης.

  • Μεθοδικότητα, οργάνωση και ομαδικό πνεύμα συνεργασίας

title: Avionics Technician - Line
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

An Avionics Technician is a specialized professional within the aviation maintenance field responsible for inspecting, installing, testing, troubleshooting, and repairing the electronic systems that support an aircraft’s operation, communication, navigation, and flight control. These systems include radar, GPS, autopilot, flight data recorders, weather radar, communication radios, transponders, and electronic flight instrument displays.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and repair avionics components using test equipment and schematic diagrams. Diagnose Avionics malfunction down to the components level using equipment and schematic design.
  • Install and calibrate communication, navigation, and flight control systems.
  • Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulations and manufacturer specifications.
  • Perform software updates and configuration management on digital systems.
  • Collaborate with airframe and powerplant (A&P) technicians to integrate avionics with other aircraft systems.
  • Document maintenance actions, test results, and part replacements in accordance with regulatory and company procedures.
  • Maintain knowledge of current avionics technologies and safety procedures.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of electronics, circuit theory, and digital systems.
  • Proficiency in using avionics testing instruments (e.g. Bonding and mega meters, multimeters).
  • Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, wiring diagrams, and schematics.
  • Attention to detail and adherence to safety and regulatory standards. FAA certification preferred (Repairman Certificate or Airframe/Powerplant License with avionics specialization.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High School Diploma or GED/Educational Equivalent
  • FAA A&P License
  • Valid US Driver's License
  • Computer literacy
  • Must pass a background check and drug screen upon contingent job offer
  • An eagerness to learn and willingness to train
  • The ability to access elevated aircraft areas via ladders, lift trucks, boom lifts and other devices
  • The strength to lift 50 pounds, physical flexibility and the ability to work in confined spaces
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

The starting rate for this role is $38.77.

title: Embedded Software & Controls Engineer
description:
About Origin

Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.

About the Role

As an Embedded Software and Controls Engineer at Origin you will design and implement the control algorithms and foundational embedded software that give our robots their precision, reliability, and autonomy. This is a high-impact role offering the opportunity to build a groundbreaking product alongside a passionate, talent-dense team.

Key Responsibilities

Control System Architecture

  • Contribute to the architecture and design of robust control systems for our mobile manipulator robots.
  • Develop and implement control algorithms for precise navigation, motion control, and teleoperation modes.
  • Ensure real-time performance and reliability of all control loops.
  • Develop and tune low-latency, real-time control loops with strict timing guarantees.

Actuator & Motor Integration

  • Develop software interfaces for CAN / EtherCAT based actuators and motor drives.
  • Write and maintain drivers for motor controllers, servo motors, and stepper motors.
  • Integrate and configure SBCs (Jetson Orin, Jetson Nano, Raspberry Pi) as embedded compute nodes within the robot platform.

Embedded Compute & Firmware

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain low-level firmware and drivers for real-time performance and efficient hardware interaction.
  • Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers for low-level interfacing with sensors and actuators.
  • Implement and debug communication protocols including I2C, UART, SPI, CAN, and Ethernet across hardware subsystems.
  • Contribute to the embedded compute platform, including Linux modifications, driver development, and CPU/resource monitoring.
  • Build and maintain monitoring and logging infrastructure to ensure system health and facilitate rapid debugging.
  • Support the Over-the-Air (OTA) update pipeline for seamless software deployment.

Rapid Prototyping & Testing

  • Prototype and test control algorithms in simulation and on physical hardware.
  • Develop and implement automated testing procedures to streamline the development process.
  • Profile, debug, and minimize latency, frequency, and jitter issues across real-time control loops and communication interfaces.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, firmware, and controls-related issues.

Collaboration & Integration

  • Work closely with the software team to integrate the electromechanical system on ROS2 and contribute to ROS2 driver development.
  • Collaborate with hardware and mechanical teams to ensure seamless integration and system-wide performance.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded control systems for robotic or similar applications.
  • Experience working with SBCs such as Jetson Orin, Jetson Nano, or Raspberry Pi.
  • Experience with communication protocols including I2C, UART, SPI, CAN, and Ethernet.
  • Experience working with CAN / EtherCAT based actuators.
  • Experience working with motor drivers, servo motors, and stepper motors.
  • Experience building low-latency, real-time systems.
  • Ability to profile, debug, and minimize latency, jitter, and timing issues in real-time environments.
  • Experience developing Linux kernel drivers for low-level sensor and actuator interfacing.
  • Proficiency in embedded programming in C (C++ a plus) and firmware development.
  • Understanding of RTOS and embedded Linux — desirable but not mandatory.
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2 is highly desirable.

Preferred Experiences

  • Low-level kernel development.
  • Experience working with robotic arms, AMR platforms, or mobile manipulators.
  • Development experience on NVIDIA Jetson Series SBCs for Robotics.

title: Mentorship Associate

  • Match mentors with mentee teams based on interests, experience, casing strengths, industries, and development goals

title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Devices based in India.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and evolve device management solutions that enable organizations to securely manage large fleets of endpoints.
You will work across macOS, Windows, and Linux, combining operating system expertise with highly available cloud services and APIs.
Your work will support capabilities such as remote configuration, patching, security, monitoring, device enrollment, and endpoint telemetry.
The role offers the opportunity to work with Go, Node.js, cloud infrastructure, authentication technologies, and cross-platform system agents.
You will collaborate with architects, product managers, UX designers, DevOps engineers, and other technical teams to deliver scalable solutions.
Beyond feature development, you will contribute to technical strategy, automated testing, system reliability, and continuous improvement.
This is a remote-first opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex systems problems and working close to operating system internals.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform device management applications and services primarily using Go and Node.js.
  • Build software for Windows, macOS, and Linux environments, integrating closely with operating system capabilities and third-party applications.
  • Develop and improve device management functionality supporting remote configuration, patching, security, monitoring, enrollment, and telemetry.
  • Work with operating system components and technologies such as Windows services, Event Loggers, Windows internals, macOS LaunchDaemons, and other platform-specific capabilities.
  • Build and maintain highly available, scalable cloud APIs and backend services that communicate with endpoint applications and agents.
  • Collaborate with architects, UX designers, DevOps engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable and intuitive solutions.
  • Contribute to strategic planning, technical discovery, and feature scoping sessions with product teams.
  • Implement secure communication and authentication mechanisms, including mTLS and OAuth/OIDC flows.
  • Develop comprehensive unit, functional, and acceptance tests and contribute to automated testing and quality assurance practices.
  • Participate in a Scrum-based agile development environment, contributing to planning, execution, reviews, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor junior engineers and share technical knowledge across the engineering team.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and respond to production alerts and incidents during assigned shifts.
  • Contribute to engineering standards and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance system reliability, scalability, security, and development efficiency.

    • Requirements

    • 7–10 years of professional experience developing applications for macOS, Windows, or Linux, including integration with third-party applications.
    • Strong hands-on experience in backend software development or full-stack engineering, with professional experience in at least one modern programming language such as Go, Python, or Java.
    • Strong experience with Go or willingness and ability to work extensively with Go in a cross-platform software environment.
    • Experience working with at least one major public cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
    • Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, and deploying software, preferably using GitHub Actions.
    • Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
    • Understanding of device management and endpoint management concepts; prior MDM experience is an advantage.
    • Familiarity with security and authentication technologies such as mTLS, OAuth, and OIDC is desirable.
    • Working knowledge of Swift, C#, or C++ is an advantage, particularly for platform-specific development.
    • Experience working with Windows services, Event Loggers, kernel-level concepts, macOS LaunchDaemons, or application hosting on macOS is highly desirable.
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues across application, operating system, and cloud layers.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with globally distributed technical teams.
    • Willingness and ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
    • Fluent written and spoken English, as English is the primary language used for internal communication and the recruitment process.
    • Ability and authorization to work remotely from India.
    • Willingness to participate in scheduled on-call rotations and respond to production issues during assigned shifts.

      • Benefits

      • Remote-first working model, allowing you to work remotely within India.
      • Opportunity to build products at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, cybersecurity, and operating system technologies.
      • Work with modern technologies including Go, Node.js, AWS/GCP/Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, OAuth/OIDC, and mTLS.
      • Exposure to multiple operating systems and deep technical challenges involving Windows, macOS, and Linux.
      • Collaboration with experienced engineers, architects, product managers, UX professionals, and DevOps specialists across a global organization.
      • Opportunities to contribute to technical strategy, architecture, product planning, and long-term platform development.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules
