title: 22199 - Head of Business Change and Continuous Improvement
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other lice applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Architectural Wall Systems Specialist (CET)
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled, design-driven Architectural Wall & Commercial Workplace Designer with expertise in demountable partition systems and integrated commercial furniture. In this role, you will lead the technical execution and visual development of corporate interiors for major U.S. commercial projects.

Working within CET Commercial Interiors (Configura), you will bridge the gap between interior architecture and furniture specification, transforming client requirements into buildable, high-performance environments. You will partner directly with U.S. sales teams, A&D representatives, and project managers to deliver fast-turnaround visual presentations, accurate bids, and detailed installation documentation for major industry brands (Haworth, Steelcase, Teknion, Kimball).


Key Responsibilities

  • Architectural Wall Design & Detailing: Design, specify, and engineer demountable architectural wall systems, glass storefronts, and acoustic partitions integrated with systems furniture layouts.
  • Technical & Structural Coordination: Ensure wall solutions seamlessly integrate with base-building conditions, including slab-to-slab heights, drop ceiling grids, MEP/HVAC offsets, electrical feeds, and structural interfaces.
  • Space Planning & CET Modeling: Utilize CET Commercial Interiors and AutoCAD to produce space plans, 3D layouts, elevation profiles, section details, and photorealistic renderings.
  • Code & Standards Compliance: Align all designs with commercial building codes, ADA clearances, LEED sustainability criteria, and WELL acoustic/daylighting standards.
  • Specification & Pricing Accuracy: Generate accurate Bills of Materials (BOM), perform double-checks using ProjectSpec or CAP Studio, Hedberg, Khameleon, NetSuite etc., and apply appropriate discounting structures to eliminate specification errors.
  • Installation Documentation: Prepare comprehensive, field-ready installation packages—including wall connection details, power/data location plans, keying schedules, and finish schedules.
  • Field Problem Solving: Review field measurements and architectural base drawings to identify potential job-site conflicts and resolve issues impacting system integration prior to order placement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with sales leaders, A&D clients, general contractors, and technical partners to deliver winning client pitches and ensure smooth project execution.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Interior Architecture, or a related field.
  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in commercial interiors, contract furniture dealerships, or architectural wall systems.
  • Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in CET Commercial Interiors (Configura) is required. Working knowledge of AutoCAD, ProjectSpec/CAP Studio, and Microsoft Office 365.
  • System Knowledge: In-depth understanding of demountable glass partition systems, modular architectural interiors, and systems furniture applications from major manufacturers (Haworth, Steelcase, Teknion, Kimball, etc.).
  • Technical Acumen: Solid understanding of acoustic privacy (STC ratings), ceiling/floor attachment details, building codes (ADA), and MEP integration.
  • Communication & Work Environment: Strong English communication skills (written and spoken) with confidence working in a client-facing, U.S.-focused remote environment.
  • Remote Setup: Dedicated, quiet home office with high-speed internet and availability to work standard U.S. business hours (EST, CST, or PST).


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with industry standards.
  • Direct access to top-tier design software and hardware tools.
  • Opportunity to work on high-profile, enterprise-level commercial projects across North America.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that prioritizes work-life balance and continuous skill development.

title: Director, TBM Strategy & Planning
description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary:

Director, TBM Strategy and Planning is a strategic business partner role who supports IT strategy formulation, vendor governance and continuous cost optimization for one of The Standard’s most critical organizations, the IT Division. As a trusted partner to AVP’s and Sr Directors in the IT division, the Director leads data-driven analysis and contributes recommendations for long-term operating expense and delivery model optimization. This includes comprehensive analysis for major decisions on IT operations, development strategic insights and assessing the benefits and economic viability of transformation projects that will have a significant impact on our future.

Project work is broad in scope and requires strong stakeholder management, analytical abilities, structured thinking and strong written and oral communication skills.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

People Management (40%)

  • Managing a professional staff to meet the IT organizations need for strategy enablement, vendor governance and Technology Business Management (TBM) services. This may include managing the performance of IT Finance resources through coaching, continuous feedback, development and succession planning.

Strategy and Decision Support (40%)

  • Establishing strong relationships with IT and Business leaders to promote open dialogue regarding technology strategy and ensure management has the analytics and operational insights necessary to understand the cost structure of the existing operating model, changes in that model and opportunities to optimize through informed decision making.
  • Leading project definition, idea generation and business case development for Cost Optimization roadmaps. Performing quantitative and qualitative analysis on strategic issues while also delivering actionable insights and recommendations. Structuring analysis of technology, market and industry trends that will impact our business and propel the IT organization forward. Planning and executing work streams for discrete management-defined projects or subsets of enterprise projects.
  • Overseeing development and delivery of presentations and other strategic communications to ensure timely and accurate identification and understanding of critical issues facing IT. Representative analysis projects include strategic vendor analysis and selection, peer benchmarking, cloud migration strategy, or infrastructure automation.

Service Costing & Analytics (20%)

  • Leading service costing strategy and implementation of Technology Business Management capabilities designed to position IT executives with the knowledge to manage and communicate the cost, quality, and value of IT services.
  • Partnering with the TBM Analytics team to develop insight that links management reporting to business and technology strategies. Leverage TBM software capabilities to educate and increase awareness and understanding of IT performance from a value perspective.
  • Developing and maintaining service costing processes to support annual planning and demand management for technology services. Improving the consumption forecasting process by partnering with IT and Business leaders to improve the quality of operational data required to align TCO Analysis with the Cost Transparency objectives of The Standard.
  • Effectively communicating consumption of IT services to all levels of management, which includes preparing presentation materials, and presenting to ensure timely identification and understanding of volumes and key drivers of IT allocations to customers.

Job Specifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics or Operations Research. An MBA or advanced degree in business related field is preferred.

Experience: 8 - 10 years progressive Finance, Strategy or Management Consulting experience or the equivalent combination of education and/or relevant experience. Experience leading high performance teams with accountability for executing strategic initiatives. Experience leading high visibility projects at a top-tier consulting firm, or strategy group of a technology-driven company is preferred. Prior experience in Technology Business Management (TBM) or CIO advisory work. Experience in a rapidly changing environment and comfortable proposing, justifying, initiating and implementing change.

Knowledge & Skills: Requires highly developed problem solving and analytical abilities to frame problems, analyze solutions, and build detailed financial models to size strategic alternatives and deliver appropriate recommendations. Ability to work efficiently and effectively with multiple levels of management and staff across a collaborative organization. Knowledge of Strategic IT Planning and Financial Management practices such as budgeting, cost allocations, capital and operating expense handling, and product roadmaps or capability-driven funding models. Understanding of IT domains and services from prior experience. Familiarity with Apptio is preferred. Advanced proficiency in SQL, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI and Alteryx Strong project management and organizational skills – self-directed and capable of managing collaboratively to achieve results through others; express ideas clearly and persuasively in oral, written, and presentation forms. Strong ability to influence.

Professional certification preferred: CMA, CSCA, FP&A, Balanced Scorecard certification (Kaplan-Norton or Balanced Scorecard Institute), CTBME, ITIL or IT4IT

N/A

Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • An annual incentive bonus plan

  • Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure

  • A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

title: Ticketing Operations Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Ticketing Operations Associate based in Brazil.

This is a fully remote role supporting the smooth fulfillment of live event ticket orders in a fast-growing, technology-driven environment.
You will step in when automated processes require human intervention, ensuring customers receive their tickets accurately and on time.
The role involves resolving ticket transfer issues, researching order and buyer information, and coordinating directly with ticket marketplaces.
You will work across both routine and high-pressure situations, particularly during major sporting and live event periods.
Success in this position requires speed, precision, organization, and the ability to stay focused while managing multiple urgent requests.
You will play a critical role in preventing fulfillment issues from impacting customers and ensuring every order reaches its destination.
No prior ticketing experience is required, making this an opportunity for a dependable and resourceful professional to build experience in a dynamic operational environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Ticket Fulfillment: Step in when automated processes fail by locating tickets, identifying buyer information, and completing ticket transfers manually to ensure orders are fulfilled accurately and on time.
  • Technical Issue Resolution: Open, manage, and follow up on support cases with Ticketmaster to investigate and resolve technical issues affecting ticket fulfillment.
  • Marketplace Coordination: Handle calls and communications with ticket marketplaces to troubleshoot fulfillment problems, coordinate solutions, and keep orders moving toward successful delivery.
  • Order Accuracy: Monitor ticket deliveries closely and take proactive action to ensure every ticket reaches the customer within the required timeframe, with no avoidable delays.
  • High-Pressure Operations: Respond quickly and accurately to urgent requests during high-traffic event periods, maintaining focus and operational quality when demand increases significantly.

    • Requirements

    • Organization and Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills and a high level of attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple time-sensitive tasks and ticket orders.
    • Reliability: Dependable and trustworthy, with a strong sense of responsibility for completing assigned tasks and ensuring successful ticket fulfillment.

title: Perception Engineer
description:
About Origin

Origin (previously 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction to tackle rising costs, safety risks, and labor shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India’s most talent-dense robotics team consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, etc.

About the Role

As a Perception Engineer at Origin (Formerly 10xconstruction), you will help our autonomous drywall-finishing robots "see" the job-site. You'll design and deploy perception pipelines—camera + LiDAR fusion, deep-learning vision models, and point-cloud geometry—to give the robot the awareness it needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy 3D perception components for geometric scene understanding using depth sensors, LiDAR, and RGB cameras.
  • Build ROS 2 nodes that process and interpret spatial data (point clouds, depth maps, image streams) for environment modeling and task planning.
  • Train and integrate deep-learning models for 3D semantic understanding, including surface analysis and object segmentation.
  • Design robust sensor fusion strategies that combine visual, inertial, and spatial data for scene reconstruction and robot localization.
  • Benchmark and optimize perception models for deployment on edge compute platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson) using tools like TensorRT or ONNX.
  • Collect and curate high-quality datasets (real and synthetic); automate training pipelines and experiment tracking.
  • Collaborate across robotics teams (manipulation, navigation, cloud) to deliver production-ready perception stacks for autonomous operation in dynamic construction environments.

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills

  • Solid grasp of linear algebra, probability and geometry; coursework or projects in CV or robotics perception.
  • Proficient in Python 3.x and C++17/20; comfortable with git and CI workflows.
  • Experience with ROS 2 (rclcpp / rclpy) and custom message / launch setups.
  • Familiarity with deep-learning vision (PyTorch or TensorFlow)—classification, detection or segmentation.
  • Hands-on work with point-cloud processing (PCL, Open3D); know when to apply voxel grids, KD-trees, RANSAC or ICP.
  • Bonus: exposure to camera–LiDAR calibration, or real-time optimization libraries (Ceres, GTSAM).

Good to have:

  • Python 3.x
  • C++17/20
  • ROS 2
  • PyTorch
  • Open3D
  • RANSAC

title: Domestic Abuse Victim Advocate
description:
***NOW HIRING***
Domestic Abuse Victim Advocate for the Air Force Family Advocacy Program
Vandenberg Air Force Base
Hourly Wage: $34.48
Paid Holidays, sick leave and vacation.
Health & Welfare Rate: $5.42 per hour to be put towards benefits offered below.
Benefits Offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD, LTD & 401k plans
Employment Status: Minimum 40 hrs/week; 24/7 on-call response required
GENERAL SUMMARY
Domestic Abuse Victim Advocates (DAVAs) will work with the United States Air Force (USAF) Family Advocacy Program (FAP) and provide 24/7 non-clinical crisis intervention services and ongoing support to USAF personnel, their family members, or intimate partners who are victims of domestic abuse whenever requested. These services include, but are not limited to: development of safety/risk assessments, explanation of victim's rights, creating safety plans, court/medical/legal accompaniment, and providing information and resources. In addition, DAVAs are required to promote a coordinated community response to domestic abuse and support FAP by providing System Advocacy, Education and Public Awareness services.
Job Duties:
  • Provides 24/7 response to victims alleging abuse (these services are provided based on the needs of client via telephone or in-person).
  • Establish a Victim’s Safety Plan on a case-by-case basis. The victims’ safety is the DAVA’s top responsibility and priority.
  • Conduct initial and ongoing risk assessments.
  • Advise victims of the military or civil actions available to promote safety (e.g., military order of protection, restraining order, and injunction).
  • Offer victims information regarding their identified needs (e.g., emergency shelter, housing, childcare, legal services, clinical resources, medical services, transitional compensation).
  • Accompany clients to appointments or court proceedings when requested by the client.
  • Develop process to keep the social work supervisor and designated POC (e.g. on-call mental health provider, emergency room.) informed of DAVA’s location and timelines when providing DAVA victim services.
  • Continually evaluate the quality of the installation’s coordinated community response and collaborate with base agencies to improve the system response to victims.
  • Empower victims to be involved in plans or decisions about the safety of self and children.
  • Collaborate and establish protocols with Security Forces Squadron (SFS), Office of Special Investigations (OSI), and Military Medical Treatment Facilities confirming.
  • At the discretion of the Social Work Supervisor, the DAVA may also provide emotional support and information and referral services to the non-offending caregiver in a child maltreatment or youth sexual assault case.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education: Bachelor’s degree in one of the following disciplines or related field:
  • Social Work
  • Counseling or Behavioral Science
  • Psychology
  • Criminal Justice
  • Marriage, Family and Child Counseling

Experience: Two years of experience assisting and providing advocacy services to victims of domestic abuse or sexual assault. DAVAs shall have knowledge of military programs, organizations, chain of command, unit missions, life styles, and situations that contribute to family stress, problems and crisis situations.

Health Requirements: DAVAs must provide proof of immunization from the following diseases according to CDC guidelines:
  • Hepatitis B
  • Varicella
  • Measles
  • Influenza
  • Mumps
  • Rubella
  • Proof of a negative TB Skin test (completed within the past 12 months)

Skills Required: DAVAs must be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and have the ability to input, retrieve, and format documentation via various database/software. DAVA personnel working within an MTF must maintain current certification in either the American Heart Association Basic Life Support Course (BLS) (Course C) or the American Red Cross CPR/BLS (Heart Saver) Course.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

ADC Management Services Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – disability and vet.

title: STRIDES Technical Advisor, Outbreak Response

Job Summary

The STRIDES Outbreak Response Technical Advisor provides overall leadership, coordination, and operational oversight for STRIDES-supported outbreak preparedness, response, recovery, and transition activities associated with an ongoing outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). This role serves as the central focal point for STRIDES BVD coordination and incident management, ensuring timely implementation of response strategies aligned with national response plans, global gold standards, donor requirements, and organizational emergency management procedures. The Ebola Response Advisor will work closely with project teams, including the Headquarter (HQ) team and country offices teams, to oversee STRIDES technical and operational support, ensuring that STRIDES-supported interventions effectively reduce transmission, morbidity, and mortality associated with Ebola disease.

title: Design Lead
description:
About Build

AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world’s most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.

Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create.

To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We’re backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world’s best venture capital firms.

Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.

The role

Most companies can separate the brand from the product. The brand is what you say, the product is what you ship, and two different teams own them. At Build that separation doesn't survive contact with the work. We sell outcomes, which means the thing a client receives - the screening, the model, the recommendation they take to their investment committee - is simultaneously the product, the deliverable and the strongest brand expression we will ever make.

This role owns all of it. Brand, product, deliverable, and the internal tools our domain experts use to produce the work. One person, one system, one standard, from the first time someone hears the word Build to the artifact that decides a nine-figure commitment.

"The deliverable is the brand. There is no separate marketing."

You will sit at the centre of the company with the CEO and work directly with engineering and the domain team. There is no layer between you and the thing being made. You will not be handed requirements and asked to make them attractive - you will decide what should exist, design how it works, and either build it or direct the engineering that does.

This is a design role with genuine thing we are looking for. Identity systems and typography on one side; dense, information-heavy interfaces that professionals rely on under time pressure on the other. Most people are good at one. We need both, held to the same bar, by the same person.

What you'll do

- Update Build's positioning across the brand to match where the company is expanding - new

asset classes, new services, new m

- Evolve the brand through creative direction and the visual artefacts that carry it - campaign,

film, motion, print, environment

- Refine the brand voice, and design trust into Build at every layer from brand through to

product

- Establish the highest level of taste and identity across every touchpoint, and hold it when

velocity argues against it

- Design the client-facing productilder platform, the assistant, andthe way work is commissioned and delivered

- Design the deliverables themselvgs and models clients act on. Thisis the highest-leverage design surface in the company and today it is the least designed

- Design the internal tools our do throughput is our capacity, and the interface is the constraint

- Build one design system that spa deliverable, a deck and a screenare recognisably the same company

- Explore and invent new - new fords of artefact that nobody in ourcategory has made yet

- Direct contractors and the intermotion, and raise the standard ofeveryone who touches the work

- Work end-to-end: prototype it, st engineering where you aren'tbuilding it yourself

What we're looking for

- Genuine range across brand and pn identity system and a workinginterface, and you refuse to accept that those are different jobs

- Proficiency in design and enginefast and write a pull request

- Serious information and editorial design ability. Our outputs are documents that carry

consequence, and most of the craftraphy and restraint

- Strong spatial and systems thinking. You see how the pieces relate before anyone asks you to

- Experience designing for high-stakes decisions, where a user is accountable for acting on what you put in front of them

- Taste you can argue for. Strong opinions are worth nothing here if you cannot bring engineers and domain experts with you

- Comfort with ambiguity - this roaybook yet, and that's the point

- You operate for growth. You understand that design compounds distribution, and you want the

scale because it's the only way th

Background

There's no single profile we're hiring from. The person we want might come from:

- A brand or editorial studio - you can build an identity system with real rigor, and you have been close enough to product to know that a static guideline document is not a system

- Product design where design was the differentiator - you have owned complex, information-dense software that people relied on professionally, and the craft was the reason they chose it

- A founding role or previous founder - you've had to be the designer, the PM and the engineer because there was nobody else

title: Product Manager
description:
About Origin

Origin is building general-purpose autonomous robots for critical infrastructure buildout. Our priority is the buildout the US cannot afford to slow down: data centres and power plants, where rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages hit hardest. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team, consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, and more.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Manager who sits at the intersection of engineering, customer needs, and business strategy. You'll own the roadmap for one or more of our core robotics products from early concept through to customer deployment working closely with hardware engineers, software developers, and commercial teams.

title: Clinical Research Scientist
description:
# 

## **JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position Title**

**Clinical Research Scientist – Dermatology, Cosmetology & Product Research**

**Location:** Chennai, India

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** Competitive remuneration commensurate with qualifications, experience, scientific expertise, and prevailing industry standards.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a motivated and scientifically driven **Clinical Research Scientist** to join our dermatology and cosmetology research team.

The Clinical Research Scientist will be responsible for **designing,** **planning, leading, coordinating, implementing, analysing, and reporting clinical research and product evaluation studies** conducted within the dermatology and cosmetology setup.

The role will provide an opportunity to work at the intersection of **clinical research, dermatology, cosmetic product development, aesthetic medicine, and evidence generation**. The candidate will work closely with dermatologists, clinical researchers, product development teams, statisticians, and external research collaborators.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in research methodology, an interest in pursuing a long-term career in clinical research, and the ability to independently take research projects from **concept development through study execution, analysis, reporting, and publication**.

**Eligibility Criteria**

**Essential Qualification**

Candidates must possess **one of the following**:

- **MBBS**

- **Master of Public Health (MPH)**

- **MD in Community Medicine**

**Preferred Profile**

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

- Prior experience in clinical or health research.

- Experience in planning, implementing, or coordinating research studies.

- Experience in scientific writing and publication.

- Experience in data analysis and interpretation.

- Exposure to dermatology, cosmetology, clinical trials, product evaluation, or healthcare research.

- A demonstrated interest and intent to build a long-term career in clinical research.

Candidates with strong research aptitude and potential may be considered even if their direct experience in dermatology or cosmetic research is limited.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Clinical Research Planning & Study Implementation**

- Identify and develop clinically relevant research questions in dermatology, cosmetology, aesthetic medicine, and product research.

- Develop research concepts, study objectives, hypotheses, and study designs.

- Prepare and review clinical research protocols, case report forms, informed consent documents, questionnaires, and other study-related documents.

- Plan and coordinate prospective and observational clinical studies, product evaluation studies, and investigator-initiated research.

- Lead or coordinate study implementation from initiation through completion.

- Monitor recruitment, participant follow-up, data collection, and study timelines.

- Ensure studies are conducted according to approved protocols and established research procedures.

- Coordinate with dermatologists, investigators, research coordinators, laboratories, statisticians, and external collaborators.

**2. Dermatology, Cosmetology & Product Research**

Plan and support research evaluating:

- Skincare and dermatological products.

- Haircare and scalp-care products.

- Cosmeceuticals.

- Nutraceuticals.

- Dermatological and aesthetic procedures.

- Medical and cosmetic devices.

- Clinic-developed formulations and treatment protocols.

The role will include evaluating **efficacy, safety, tolerability, patient/consumer experience, and other relevant outcomes** associated with products and interventions.

The candidate will also support generation of scientific evidence for product development and marketing claims.

 

**3. Claims Substantiation & Evidence Generation**

- Work with product development and marketing teams to identify scientifically relevant and measurable product claims.

- Assess the type of evidence required to substantiate proposed claims.

- Design or support consumer, clinical, and instrumental studies for claims validation.

- Develop appropriate study endpoints and assessment tools.

- Review existing scientific evidence supporting proposed product claims.

- Interpret study findings in relation to proposed claims.

- Prepare scientific evidence summaries and claims substantiation reports.

- Identify gaps in available evidence and recommend appropriate research strategies.

**4. Clinical Outcome Assessment**

- Develop and implement appropriate clinical and patient-reported outcome measures.

- Coordinate standardized assessment of dermatological outcomes, including:

  - Acne severity

  - Pigmentation and skin tone

  - Skin hydration and barrier parameters

  - Skin texture and smoothness

  - Scarring

  - Skin ageing

  - Hair growth and hair loss

  - Patient satisfaction

  - Quality-of-life measures

- Support standardized clinical photography and image-based assessments.

- Ensure consistency and quality of outcome assessments across study visits.

**5. Data Management & Statistical Analysis**

- Develop and maintain study databases and research datasets.

- Perform data cleaning, verification, reconciliation, and quality checks.

- Identify and resolve data discrepancies.

- Conduct descriptive and appropriate inferential statistical analyses with support from statisticians where required.

- Interpret statistical outputs in the context of the research question and study design.

- Prepare tables, graphs, and summaries for research reports and presentations.

- Support interim and final analyses.

- Maintain organized and traceable research records.

**Preferred software exposure:**

- Microsoft Excel

- SPSS

- R

- STATA

- REDCap or other electronic data capture systems

**6. Scientific Writing & Publications**

The Clinical Research Scientist will be expected to actively contribute to the organization's scientific output.

Responsibilities include preparing:

- Clinical study reports.

- Research protocols.

- Scientific abstracts.

- Manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals.

- Conference posters and presentations.

- Research summaries.

- Literature reviews and evidence syntheses.

- Scientific reports and white papers.

- Internal research presentations.

The candidate will work with investigators and collaborators to take research projects from **study completion to scientific dissemination and publication**.

**7. Ethics, Regulatory & Research Quality**

- Prepare documentation for Institutional Ethics Committee/IRB submissions.

- Coordinate ethics submissions, amendments, continuing reviews, and study closure documentation.

- Maintain essential study documentation and research records.

- Ensure adherence to approved protocols and institutional SOPs.

- Follow applicable ethical and clinical research requirements, including ICH-GCP where applicable.

- Support research monitoring, audits, and quality assurance activities.

- Ensure appropriate documentation of deviations, adverse events, and other study-related issues.

**8. Research Strategy & Innovation**

- Identify emerging research opportunities in dermatology, cosmetology, aesthetic medicine, skincare, and product development.

- Conduct literature reviews to identify evidence gaps and potential research questions.

- Propose new clinical and product research initiatives.

- Contribute to development of the organization's clinical research pipeline.

- Support collaborations with academic institutions, clinicians, research organizations, and industry partners.

- Contribute to building a strong culture of scientific research and publication within the organization.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

**Essential**

- Clinical research methodology.

- Study design and protocol development.

- Research data management and quality checks.

- Basic to intermediate statistical analysis.

- Scientific and medical writing.

- Literature review and evidence synthesis.

- Microsoft Excel.

- Good scientific communication skills.

**Desirable**

- SPSS, R, STATA, or equivalent statistical software.

- REDCap or other EDC platforms.

- Experience with clinical photography or image-based assessments.

- Experience with dermatological outcome measures.

- Experience with consumer or patient-reported outcome studies.

- Experience with clinical/product claims substantiation.

 

**Preferred Certifications**

- ICH-GCP Certification.

- Clinical Research Certification.

- Biostatistics training/certification.

- Medical or Scientific Writing certification.

Additional certifications in clinical data management, regulatory affairs, or pharmacovigilance may be advantageous but are not mandatory.

 

**Key Competencies**

**Scientific & Analytical**

- Strong research aptitude.

- Critical thinking and scientific reasoning.

- Ability to interpret clinical and research data.

- Evidence-based decision-making.

- Attention to detail.

**Research Management**

- Ability to plan and execute studies.

- Project and timeline management.

- Problem-solving ability.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of research projects.

**Communication**

- Strong scientific writing skills.

- Clear verbal communication.

- Ability to communicate scientific concepts to clinicians, scientists, and non-scientific stakeholders.

- Presentation skills.

**Leadership**

- Ability to take ownership of research projects.

- Initiative to identify and pursue new research opportunities.

- Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams.

- Mentoring and supervision of junior research staff as the role develops.

- Strong commitment to scientific quality and research integrity.

 

**Career Opportunity**

This position offers significant scope for professional growth for candidates who are interested in building a long-term career in **clinical research, dermatology research, product research, and scientific affairs**.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to progressively take responsibility for:

**Research Concept → Protocol Development → Study Leadership → Data Analysis → Scientific Reporting → Publication → Research Strategy**

As the research program expands, the role can progress into senior scientific and research leadership positions.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is **not simply seeking a clinical research job, but wants to build a career in research**.

The ideal candidate will be scientifically curious, proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable working with data, and willing to take ownership of research projects. An interest in dermatology, cosmetology, skincare, and product research is highly desirable.

Candidates who demonstrate strong research potential, leadership qualities, and a genuine commitment to scientific work will be particularly valued.

This role will significantly impact the organization by overseeing financial planning, working capital strategies, and corporate development initiatives. The VP will also build and lead a formidable finance team, shaping the long-term capability and culture of the function.

## Responsibilities

- **Working Capital Optimisation**

  - Oversee end-to-end management of working capital including receivables, payables, inventory financing, and credit cycles.
  - Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, and sales teams to optimize the cash conversion cycle.
  - Create dynamic working capital models reflecting agricultural seasonality and credit patterns.

- **Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Development**

  - Support M&A evaluations, including target identification and valuation modeling.
  - Manage financial due diligence for potential acquisitions.

## Qualifications

## Experience

10 - 15 years of relevant experience in Business Finance or related fields, with a progressive career in either high-growth startups, investment banking, or management consulting.

## Environment

This role is based in Gurgaon and requires some travel as needed. The working environment is fast-paced, driven by impact, and centered around supporting a diverse agricultural landscape.

title: Governing Board Member (Volunteer Opportunity)
description:
DeKalb Brilliance Academy’s Mission. With unwavering commitment to exceptional academics, leadership development, and community collaboration, DeKalb Brilliance Academy prepares all Kindergarten-8th grade students to thrive in high school and college, have fulfilling careers, and become impactful leaders in our communities.

DeKalb Brilliance Academy’s Vision. Each child will know and leverage their unique brilliance to critically analyze the world around them and to design a better and more equitable future.

Purpose of the Board of Directors. The Board of Directors is a critical part of the school’s success. DeKalb Brilliance Academy Board members share a powerful commitment to the school’s mission and vision. They are dedicated, passionate, and entrepreneurial individuals willing to volunteer their expertise, connections, and time to ensure successful founding, launch, and operations for DeKalb Brilliance Academy to fulfill its mission.


Responsibilities of the Board of Directors.

  • Ensure the school's financial, legal, and programmatic success to be able to fulfill our mission
  • Help cultivate community support and galvanize a network of strategic partnerships
  • Develop and continue a Board to govern the school and be accountable for the school’s success


Expectations of Individual Directors.

  • Use specific expertise for the benefit of DeKalb Brilliance Academy
  • Advocate for the mission and vision of DeKalb Brilliance Academy
  • Complete 3-year term of service
  • Commit 1-2 hours per week to school-related work
    • Must be able to attend *in-person* meetings twice a month (once for full board, once for committee meeting)
    • Work on non-meeting weeks is virtual
    • Please note that once/year, state law requires that board members complete 12 hours of *in-person* training. Please plan to take 1.5 days off of work to complete this mandatory training.
  • Execute $1,500 give/get fundraising per board member
    • Can be met through board donations, individual fundraising, corporate match, and/or in-kind donations (in-kind donations must be pre-approved by staff). We offer extensive fundraising tools to support board members in these efforts (see our newly-launched fundraiser here).
  • Capitalize on personal/professional networks for the school’s financial/political/organizational benefit
    • Recommend community leader experts for Real-world Project-based Learning & candidates for the Board
  • Ensure high-quality governance:
    • Comply with all open meeting and open records laws
    • Complete annual state training requirements for charter school governing boards (note this is 1.5 days *in-person* and will require you taking time off from work)
    • Disclose any potential conflicts of interest to the Board Chair
    • Support the decisions made by the Governing Board as a whole

Requirements

Qualifications of Directors.

  • Purpose-driven: have deep reverence for the brilliance of our children and unwavering commitment to empowering our children to have impactful legacies in our communities
  • Community-minded: has ability work collaboratively with peers and manage up to improve the work of everyone around them
  • Expertise in law, real estate, finance, governance, marketing, development, education, advocacy, community, and/or strategy
  • Have a founder’s mindset: is a creative problem solver, enjoys building from the ground up
  • Emotionally intelligent: knows how to care for themselves, collaborate with others, use tools to regulate their emotions under stress, and approach difficult situations with others with empathy and compassion
  • Equity-minded: understand how specific behaviors, laws, and institutions limit the rights and freedoms of people and work with our community to take collective action to make our world fairer for everyone.
  • Strong project and time managers: has ability to adapt and persevere to deliver consistent and timely results to reach our goals

Benefits

Not applicable - this is a voluntary position.

description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

-All staff receive security and diversity training and an individual induction programme into their new roles

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Safety and Health - HSE Officer
description:
We are seeking a proactive and experienced Safety and Security Officer to lead and enforce a world-class health, safety, and security environment within our fast-paced 3PL warehouse. In this role, you will be responsible for safeguarding our workforce, visitors, and inventory by implementing robust HSE protocols fully aligned with Saudi Labor Law, HRSD, and Saudi Civil Defense standards.

From conducting hazard risk assessments and managing warehouse traffic flows to leading incident investigations and emergency preparedness drills, you will play a critical role in driving a zero-harm safety culture and maintaining operational compliance across all facility activities.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree or a 3-year Diploma in Occupational Health & Safety (OHS), Engineering, Logistics, or a related field.

Experience: 3–5 years of direct experience as a Safety Officer, ideally within a 3PL, logistics, or warehousing facility in Saudi Arabia.

Regulatory Knowledge (Mandatory): Deep practical understanding of Saudi Labor Law, HRSD OSH standards, and Saudi Civil Defense regulations.

Certifications: NEBOSH IGC, IOSH Managing Safely, or OSHA 30-Hour certification.

Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with warehouse-specific hazards (racking inspections, MHE/forklift safety, traffic management, PTW, and LOTO).

Languages: Full professional proficiency in Arabic and English (both spoken and written).

Bonus Qualifications: Knowledge of SFDA standards, HACCP, or ISO 22000 (Food Safety) is a strong plus.

title: Principal Software Systems Engineer
description:
Do you want to help a small company make a BIG difference in space? Do you take ownership of your job and responsibility for your actions? Then come work for Red Canyon and help us continue our mission of helping humankind reach the stars!

Red Canyon Software is looking for an enthusiastic and creative Principal Software Systems Engineer (Contract) to design and analyze new satellite and aerospace systems. We're looking for candidates who can bring exceptional engineering skills and strong experience in aerospace programs to the team.

Position Responsibilities:

The Principal Software Systems Engineer's primary responsibility will be driving the development of customer satellite systems with a focus on flight software delivery. This engineer will be involved in the full lifecycle of development, from requirements definition, validation, verification and operations. Being at the cutting edge of space technology, we need someone who is eager to learn, grow, and take on new and potentially unfamiliar challenges. There is no shortage of fascinating problems to solve.

The Principal Software Systems Engineer will provide autonomous solutions of complex problems, through direct work or delegation, under the leadership of the Systems Engineering Manager. The Principal Systems Engineer will have project and subject matter responsibility and authority.

Systems Engineering 75%

  • Perform systems engineering tasks for satellite software systems, including the heritage platform:
    • Requirements development – initial definition, decomposition and flow down, management of Software and Avionics Subsystem requirements
    • System design and trade studies – high level concept trades to support subsequent detail design
    • Verification planning and testing – verification matrices, buy-off / sell-off, test planning, analysis planning, etc.
    • Ensure proper Systems Engineering processes are followed including requirements traces / RVTMs
    • Coordinate and collaborate with internal and external stake holders to ensure that technical requirements are met
    • Flight Software anomaly resolution and troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated ability to participate in cross-functional planning, coordination, and task execution situations involving the full spectrum of engineering and integration activities

Roadmap Development 15%

  • Support spacecraft development product roadmap; includes design adjustments, schedule, and cost targets aligned for future business captures
  • Support the definition of spacecraft customization process for customer mission needs

Additional Responsibilities 10%

  • Perform all the necessary systems engineering activities to build, to maintain and to evolve the spacecraft products
  • Promote and optimize cost savings by reuse of the heritage platform designs and manufacturing infrastructures in the pursuit of various constellation prospects.

Qualified Experience / Skills / Training:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technical, Engineering, Math) or related scientific areas
  • Preferred: Masters in STEM (Science, Technical, Engineering, Math) or related scientific areas

Experience:

  • A minimum of 15 years with a bachelor's degree, or 12 years with a master's degree
  • Proven track-record of working with aerospace software systems, starting from conceptual designs and tradeoffs thru detailed design, development, integration, test, deployment, and operations
  • Proven track-record of leading multi-disciplinary teams to solve problems

Knowledge, Skills, Demonstrated Capabilities:

  • Familiarity with elements of space mission architectures extending beyond the satellite platform – including launch, flight operations, mission CONOPS, user interfaces, etc.
  • Experience with systems architecture, requirements definition and decomposition, and requirements verification and validation (e.g. Requirements Verification and Traceability Matrices)
  • Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and methods
  • Experience with requirements management tools (DOORS or similar)
  • Experience leading and/or performing analyses for affordability, safety, reliability, maintainability, testability, human systems integration, survivability, vulnerability, susceptibility, system security, regulatory, certification, product assurance or other specialties engineering disciplines
  • Communicate in a clear and concise manner effectively across multiple levels
  • Be team-minded and ready to work in a multi-functional and multi-cultural, fast-moving and complex/technical environment
  • Flexible attitude and strong initiative
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results
MUST BE A US CITIZEN
Red Canyon Engineering and Software: “Exploring Other Planets, Improving our Own”
Red Canyon contracts with NASA, NOAA, NREL, JPL, and DOD, in addition to customers such as Lockheed Martin Space, Raytheon, Sierra Space, a.i. solutions, Walt Disney Imagineering, SAIC, Sidus Space, Ball Aerospace, SpaceX, Honeywell, KBRwyle, Peraton, LASP, Maxar, Blue Origin, and Moog. We specialize in building spacecraft, developing renewable energy technologies to help make our planet a better world and cutting edge research and development. Our disciplines include embedded flight software, software testing, GN&C, systems engineering, mechanical design, structural analysis, real time flight and ground software, simulation software, user interface software, and mission management software. We help our contractors with the full life cycle of product development from requirements to test and delivery.
Some of the programs we have previously or currently worked on include: Human Lander System, Artemis I-II, WorldView Legion V, Perseverance Rover, InSight, GeoXO, Tranche-1, LizzieSat, Dream Chaser, Psyche, Mars 98, Odyssey 01, Stardust, Genesis and Deep Impact, Mars Phoenix, Joint Polar Satellite System, Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, Orion, Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, GOES-R, OSIRIS-REx, Maven, JUNO, Grail, and the MarsFlight and LunarSIM Simulation.
Red Canyon’s home office is located in scenic Denver, Colorado, and our regional office, Launch Now, is in historic downtown Titusville, Florida. We are a small company that maintains a flat organization to decrease our overhead and costs to our customers. Our number one focus is to solve some of the most complicated engineering problems humankind is facing.
Does it sound like you want to join our mission?
