title: Senior Software Engineer Embedded Linux/Android
description:
About HEADBORNE.AI

Safe, mission-based AI solutions for first responders and defense.

HEADBORNE's long-term mission is to defend free democracies of the world with ethical, interoperable, mission-based safe AI solutions for first responders, defense forces, and decision makers. We build a secure, AI-driven Cloud/OS platform integrated in the next generations of AR smart glasses, helmets, drones, robots, and training systems. We seamlessly connect them across air, land, sea, space, and cyberspace, delivering complete situational awareness, control, and command.

About the Role

HEADBORNE seeks a Senior Embedded Linux/Android Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. Our core systems engineers are building the embedded intelligence behind next-generation AI edge devices for defense, forces and first responders.


You will develop and integrate software for AI-enabled systems, driving advanced sensing, communications, and SOC/MCU integration. This is a hands-on, high-impact role spanning embedded architecture, system optimization, and mission-critical software reliability.


We’re looking for a brilliant, motivated engineer to join TEAM HEADBORNE—delivering mission-based, safe AI solutions that matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own and lead the implementation of software solutions for mission-critical imaging systems.

  • Write efficient, well-tested code in C++ and Python

  • Develop low-latency, high-bandwidth processing pipelines for airborne imaging sensors.

  • Jump into and understand large codebases.

  • Develop device drivers and perform hardware integration (IMX 95, AR Vision, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Audio, LCD, Backlight, Power Management, Battery/Charger management, Camera).

  • Perform board bring-up, bootloader customization, and root filesystem generation.

  • Integrate and adapt open-source software for embedded platforms.

  • Define and implement embedded software architectures (daemons, libraries, device drivers).

  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to define embedded hardware architectures.

  • Contribute to team leadership, project management, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Develop and maintain server-side administration tools (package management, deployment, and build systems).

Required Qualifications

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related field—or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Linux environment.

  • Expertise in C++ and Python.

  • Experience in embedded software development (Linux/Android).

  • Strong understanding of Linux command-line tools and system administration.

  • Experience troubleshooting and analyzing remotely deployed software systems.

  • Proficiency in English and German.

  • Right to work in Germany, without sponsorship.

  • Eligibility for German security clearances.

  • Self-motivated, organized, and collaborative.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of image processing and computer vision concepts.

  • Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics.

  • Experience with board-level debugging and system bring-up.

  • Familiarity with Jenkins or similar CI/CD systems.

Location

This in-person role is based in Jena, Germany. Candidates are expected to be located near Jena or open to relocation.

HEADBORNE.AI is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

What We Offer

  • Defend free democracies through mission-based, safe AI solutions
  • Closely collaborate with a small, international team of world-leading experts on cutting-edge AI-driven systems
  • Earn a competitive salary
  • Receive highly competitive stock options

title: Assistant Facility Security Offer
description:
About Pratt Miller, an Oshkosh company

Pratt Miller is a product development company in motorsports, defense, and mobility industries providing clients with product engineering and low-volume production solutions. Our range of research & development, engineering, prototype manufacturing, test & validation, and low-rate production capability help our customers bring their high-quality products to market faster.

Pratt Miller is actively hiring an Assistant Facility Security Officer (Assistant FSO).

This is an on-site position supporting the Facility Security Officer (FSO) and Operations Security team in the administration and implementation of Pratt Miller’s industrial security program. The Assistant FSO will work closely with security personnel, Human Resources, program management, and employees to help ensure compliance with company security policies, National Industrial Security Program (NISP) requirements, and applicable government regulations.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, professional, and comfortable handling sensitive and security-related information in a fast-paced environment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & SKILLS

Typical responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Industrial Security Administration

  • Assist the FSO with the day-to-day administration of the company’s industrial security program.
  • Support the implementation and enforcement of security policies, procedures, and practices.
  • Assist with maintaining personnel security records and documentation.
  • Support the processing and tracking of personnel security clearances and related requirements.
  • Assist with security briefings, debriefings, training, and required documentation.
  • Maintain accurate security records and ensure required documentation is completed and filed appropriately.
  • Assist with tracking security training requirements and completion.
  • Support the preparation for security reviews, inspections, audits, and assessments.
  • Assist with maintaining security-related databases, spreadsheets, logs, and tracking systems.
  • Assist with the review and implementation of changes to applicable security policies and requirements.
  • Maintain confidentiality of personnel, security, and government-related information.

Personnel Security

  • Assist the FSO with security clearance processing and personnel security actions.
  • Track employee security status, clearance requirements, and required security actions.
  • Assist with processing incoming and outgoing personnel security documentation.
  • Support security indoctrination and debriefing activities.
  • Assist employees with questions regarding security requirements and procedures.
  • Coordinate with Human Resources and other internal departments regarding personnel security matters.

Facility & Physical Security

  • Assist with facility access-control requirements and security procedures.
  • Support visitor control and facility security processes.
  • Assist with maintaining security-related equipment, records, and documentation.
  • Support personnel accountability and emergency security procedures.
  • Assist with investigations, security incidents, and reporting as directed by the FSO.
  • Help ensure security procedures are consistently followed throughout the facility.

Information & Operational Security

  • Assist with the protection of classified and controlled information in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Support employees in understanding and following security procedures for classified and sensitive information.
  • Assist with identifying and reporting potential security concerns or violations to the FSO.
  • Support OPSEC and other company security awareness initiatives.
  • Assist with security-related training and awareness activities.

Security Reception & Administrative Support

  • Support visitor management and access-control procedures.
  • Greet and assist employees, contractors, and visitors while maintaining established security protocols.
  • Assist with maintaining security reception areas and related administrative supplies.
  • Provide administrative support to the FSO and Operations Security team as directed.

EDUCATION / CERTIFICATION / YEARS OF EXPERIENCE

  • Graduate of an accredited high school or equivalent required.
  • Associate or undergraduate degree in security, criminal justice, criminology, business administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Previous experience in industrial security, personnel security, physical security, military security, law enforcement, or a related field is preferred.
  • Experience working in a cleared defense or government contracting environment is desirable.

title: Capital Planning & Investment Analyst (Business Strategy & Financial Modeling)
description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Remote Business Analyst, Capital Planning supports executive leadership in the development, evaluation, and execution of strategic initiatives and capital investment opportunities across the Medicare Advantage organization. This role is responsible for partnering with business leaders to develop data-driven business cases, perform financial and operational analyses, quantify benefits, assess risks, and support capital planning processes.

The analyst serves as a key contributor in translating strategic priorities into actionable investment proposals, enabling informed decision-making through rigorous analysis, forecasting, and performance measurement. This role works cross-functionally with Operations, Clinical Services, Finance, Technology, Compliance, Network Management, and Growth teams to evaluate opportunities that improve member outcomes, operational performance, regulatory compliance, and organizational growth.

Business Case Development

  • Lead the development of business cases for strategic initiatives, technology investments, operational improvements, and capital requests.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define business problems, opportunities, objectives, assumptions, and success criteria.

  • Quantify financial and non-financial benefits, including revenue growth, cost savings, productivity gains, quality improvements, risk mitigation, and member experience enhancements.

  • Develop return on investment (ROI), net present value (NPV), payback period, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses.

  • Prepare executive-level presentations and recommendations for leadership review and approval.

Capital Planning & Portfolio Support

  • Support annual and multi-year capital planning processes.

  • Evaluate and prioritize capital requests against strategic objectives, organizational value, and resource constraints.

  • Maintain capital project documentation, business case repositories, and investment tracking tools.

  • Monitor approved investments against forecasted benefits and business outcomes.

  • Assist leadership in developing investment roadmaps and prioritization frameworks.

Strategic Analysis

  • Analyze market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory changes, and Medicare Advantage industry developments.

  • Conduct research and benchmarking to identify opportunities for operational and strategic improvement.

  • Support enterprise strategy initiatives through quantitative and qualitative analysis.

  • Translate complex business requirements into actionable recommendations.

Data & Financial Analysis

  • Gather, analyze, and interpret operational, clinical, financial, and member data.

  • Build forecasting models to evaluate initiative impacts and investment scenarios.

  • Create dashboards, reports, and performance metrics to measure business outcomes.

  • Identify key business drivers, risks, dependencies, and implementation considerations.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with business leaders, project sponsors, and subject matter experts to gather requirements and validate assumptions.

  • Facilitate workshops, meetings, and interviews to assess business needs and opportunities.

  • Communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Provide ongoing support throughout initiative lifecycle planning and implementation.

Experience:

Required:

  • 3-7 years of experience in business analysis, strategic planning, management consulting, healthcare finance, or related analytical roles.

Education:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field.

Specialized Skills:

Required:

  • Experience developing business cases, financial models, and executive presentations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Experience working with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders and leadership teams.

title: Creative Content Producer
description:
About Origin

Origin is building general-purpose autonomous robots for critical infrastructure buildout. Our priority is the buildout the US cannot afford to slow down: data centres and power plants, where rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages hit hardest. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team, consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, and more.

About the Role

As Creative Content Producer, you will shape how Origin tells its story across video, social media, visual design, presentations, and brand assets.

You will capture content from our lab, office, robot testing, demos, team activities, deployment preparation, customer engagements, and field operations. You will also turn footage from international deployments, pilots, trade shows, and customer sites into compelling content.

This is more than a video-editing role. You will make complex, physical, real-world technology feel clear, credible, and exciting to customers, investors, partners, candidates, and the construction industry.

Because you will not always be where the action happens, you will also build simple, repeatable systems that help field teams around the world capture high-quality and usable content.

What You’ll Do

1. Video and Technical Storytelling

  • Own video projects from ideation and scripting through shooting, editing, packaging, and publishing support.
  • Produce short- and long-form content for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and other relevant channels.
  • Create product demos, robot showcases, explainers, reels, founder and team videos, behind-the-scenes stories, launch videos, event recaps, and deployment updates.
  • Capture authentic moments via video and brief interview from the lab, robot trials, demos, deployment preparation, and team activities.
  • Turn complex robotics, construction workflows, product capabilities, and field learnings into clear and engaging stories.
  • Adapt content for customers, investors, partners, candidates, and technical audiences.
  • Maintain a content calendar aligned with launches, demonstrations, events, hiring, and product milestones.

2. Remote and Field Content

  • Support time-sensitive content needs from international customer demos, pilots, deployments, trade shows, and site visits.
  • Create shot lists, filming guides, interview prompts, capture checklists, and content-request templates.
  • Guide engineers, operators, salespeople, and deployment teams in capturing better video, photography, interviews, and customer moments.
  • Turn raw field footage into reels, demo highlights, customer-facing clips, case-study assets, sales materials, investor updates, and internal communications.
  • Build a repeatable field-content system for documenting robot performance, jobsite workflows, customer reactions, and deployment learnings.
  • Coordinate with engineering, sales, deployment, and leadership teams to identify and deliver the strongest stories quickly.

3. Visual and Brand Design

  • Design social graphics, presentation assets, campaign creatives, event materials, product explainers, and marketing visuals.
  • Support pitch decks, sales decks, one-pagers, case studies, recruitment content, and customer communications.
  • Create reusable templates for social posts, video thumbnails, announcements, presentations, case studies, and launches.
  • Maintain visual consistency across video, social media, web, presentations, and print.
  • Support visuals for landing pages, product showcases, and campaign pages when needed.

4. Collaboration and Brand Storytelling

  • Work closely with founders, engineers, product, deployment, sales, and marketing teams to identify content opportunities.
  • Interview and film team members, operators, customers, and leadership.
  • Help construction companies understand how Origin’s robots work, where they fit, and why they matter.
  • Build a credible, high-trust brand grounded in real products, real progress, and real-world performance.
  • Help teams recognize what should be captured and how it can become valuable content.

Must-Haves

  • A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating video production, editing, visual design, or social content.
  • Ability to independently take video projects from idea and scripting through shooting, editing, and final delivery.
  • Strong proficiency with at least one video-editing tool, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.
  • Working proficiency with design tools such as Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or equivalent.
  • A strong eye for storytelling, framing, composition, pacing, typography, layout, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to create both polished brand content and fast, platform-native social content.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, and emerging content formats.
  • Ability to simplify technical subjects into clear and visually engaging stories.
  • Confidence turning imperfect or remotely captured footage into high-quality content.
  • Comfort working around engineers, hardware, robots, workshops, labs, testing areas, and field operations.
  • Ability to guide non-creative colleagues in capturing usable photos, videos, interviews, and customer moments.
  • Strong ownership, organization, resourcefulness, and ability to manage several creative projects at once.
  • Willingness to occasionally appear on camera.
  • Genuine interest in robotics, construction, technology, startups, and physical products.

Good-to-Haves

  • Experience in robotics, hardware, manufacturing, automotive, construction technology, industrial automation, aerospace, or another physical-product industry.
  • Experience working with engineering, product, deployment, sales, or other technical teams.
  • Experience producing content from customer sites, factories, labs, workshops, trade shows, or international deployments.
  • Experience building remote content-capture systems using shot lists, filming guides, prompts, checklists, and reusable templates.
  • Experience creating founder-led or technical content for LinkedIn.
  • Motion graphics, animation, 3D visualization, product-rendering, or interface-animation skills.
  • Photography skills, including lighting, framing, composition, and image editing.
  • Experience creating pitch decks, sales materials, case studies, one-pagers, event collateral, thumbnails, or product explainers.
  • Understanding of brand identity systems and cross-channel visual consistency.
  • Experience creating reusable workflows and templates that help teams publish consistently.
  • Familiarity with construction workflows, jobsites, industrial environments, or B2B technology audiences.

Portfolio Requirement

Applicants must share a portfolio, show reel, social media samples, design work, or links to published videos.

We are especially interested in technical storytelling, hardware or product videos, founder-led content, social videos, motion graphics, brand design, and work involving physical products.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small practical assignment using sample robot footage.

What You’ll Gain

  • The opportunity to shape the creative voice of an early-stage robotics company.
  • Hands-on experience with robotics, AI, automation, construction technology, and physical products.
  • A diverse portfolio spanning video, design, technical storytelling, product launches, and brand campaigns.
  • Direct exposure to founders, engineers, robots, customer demonstrations, and field deployments.
  • Experience creating content that supports sales, hiring, fundraising, brand development, and product adoption.
  • The chance to tell the story of technology being built for one of the world’s largest industries.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Platform Engineer based in India.

This role focuses on maintaining reliable, scalable, and highly available technology platforms in a fast-paced operational environment.
You will work across Kubernetes, containerization, Linux, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, and cloud technologies to support system stability.
The position combines proactive monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, automation, and continuous improvement.
You will help reduce operational dependencies by strengthening runbooks, automation, monitoring, and self-service capabilities.
The role requires close collaboration with technical partners while maintaining service levels and responding quickly to production incidents.
You will work with distributed systems and modern deployment strategies, with opportunities to improve platform resilience and delivery processes.
The position is suited to engineers who enjoy hands-on technical problem solving and are comfortable working rotational shifts.

Accountabilities:

  • Work with a proactive platform operations team to maintain system stability, minimize incidents, consistently achieve service-level targets, and improve capacity and operational performance through metrics and best practices.
  • Resolve Tier-1 incidents using established runbooks, including system restarts, network connectivity checks, model resets, data-flow checks, alert reprocessing, environment verification, and other standard operational fixes.
  • Monitor systems and alerting channels continuously, review operational metrics, provide immediate incident response, and prepare daily and weekly reports covering system performance, incidents, and key indicators.
  • Review root-cause analysis and resolution requests, execute documented runbook procedures, and escalate issues to L2/L3 support when they involve model, hardware, security, or other issues beyond the defined operational scope.
  • Maintain strong adherence to SLAs by prioritizing incidents according to severity and ensuring timely response, resolution, escalation, and communication throughout the incident lifecycle.
  • Perform regular operational checks, including server environments, real-time overlays, security desk systems, PagerDuty alerts, Redis database cron jobs, and other platform health indicators.
  • Schedule and coordinate system downtime for updates and maintenance activities while minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.
  • Improve platform operations by reducing manual and people-dependent processes, strengthening automation, and moving recurring workflows toward more reliable and self-sufficient operation.
  • Maintain consistent communication and collaboration with internal and external technical partners, ensuring operational status, incidents, escalations, and required actions are clearly communicated.

    • Requirements

    • Have 1–6 years of relevant professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, backend development, infrastructure operations, or a related technical discipline.
    • Demonstrate strong Kubernetes expertise, ideally supported by the Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification or comparable practical knowledge.
    • Have hands-on experience creating and maintaining container infrastructure and scalable Kubernetes environments, including Deployments, Pods, Jobs, StatefulSets, ConfigMaps, Services, NodePort, Ingress, Volumes, and Custom Resource Definitions.
    • Be highly proficient with Linux and Docker, including container maintenance, troubleshooting, container logs, health checks, probes, and Linux shell operations.
    • Have experience with Helm Charts, multi-container pod designs using sidecar and init containers, distributed-system design patterns, and Kubernetes deployment strategies such as blue/green, canary, and rolling updates.
    • Demonstrate strong DevOps and CI/CD knowledge, including continuous integration, deployment automation, monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and production reliability practices.
    • Possess strong Python development skills, including iterators, exception handling, file handling, data types and structures, object-oriented programming, and production-grade software development rather than scripting alone.
    • Have practical experience with web frameworks such as Flask and Gunicorn, along with strong understanding of software design patterns, database integration, streaming pipelines, and multiprocessing architectures.
    • Demonstrate strong Git and GitHub knowledge and experience working with technologies such as Redis and Kafka for data integration or streaming workflows.
    • Experience with GStreamer, FFmpeg, and OpenCV for video streaming or image processing is highly valued, along with knowledge of cloud services and hybrid cloud environments.
    • Be comfortable troubleshooting complex technical issues, working with operational metrics, following structured incident procedures, and communicating clearly with technical stakeholders.
    • Be available to work rotational shifts: Shift A from 6 AM–2 PM IST, Shift B from 2 PM–10 PM IST, or Shift C from 10 PM–6 AM IST, with two consecutive days off each week.
    • Be comfortable joining immediately and working remotely from a base location associated with Mumbai, Bangalore, or Trivandrum.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time remote work opportunity based in India, with Mumbai, Bangalore, and Trivandrum identified as base locations.
      • Exposure to modern platform engineering technologies including Kubernetes, Docker, Python, CI/CD, cloud services, distributed systems, and production monitoring.
      • Opportunity to work on highly scalable infrastructure and contribute to platform stability, automation, reliability, and operational efficiency.
      • Hands-on experience with incident management, deployment strategies, observability, and production-grade engineering practices.
      • A collaborative environment focused on transparency, diversity, integrity, continuous learning, and professional growth.
      • Rotational shift schedule with two consecutive days off each week.
      • Opportunities to work alongside proactive technical teams and collaborate with partners across a dynamic technology environment.

Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver faster execution, stronger project economics, and meaningful cost savings. Join India’s talent-dense robotics team, with colleagues from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, and other leading institutions.

About the role

As Program Manager - Regulatory, you will build and run the cross-functional program that takes Origin’s autonomous robots from engineering prototypes to compliant, deployable products. You will translate market, product, safety, and certification requirements into a clear roadmap, evidence plan, decision log, and execution cadence. You will partner with hardware, embedded, software, safety, manufacturing, legal, and deployment teams, as well as external laboratories and authorities, to ensure regulatory work is planned early and closed without slowing product velocity.

Key responsibilities

- Own the regulatory and certification program plan for Origin’s robot platform and deployed configurations.

- Map applicable product, electrical, radio, machinery, functional-safety, workplace, transport, and market-entry requirements across target geographies.

- Convert requirements into owners, design inputs, test plans, technical files, evidence packages, milestones, and release gates.

- Coordinate internal design reviews and external test houses, consultants, certification bodies, and authorities.

- Track risks, gaps, dependencies, costs, and schedule; escalate decisions early and drive closure.

- Maintain controlled documentation, compliance matrices, declarations, certificates, reports, and audit trails.

- Integrate regulatory readiness into product development, supplier qualification, manufacturing, and deployment processes.

Requirements

- 6+ years in regulatory affairs, certification program management, product compliance, safety engineering, or complex technical program management.

- Experience taking electromechanical, industrial, automotive, aerospace, robotics, or connected hardware products through formal compliance processes.

- Strong working knowledge of technical documentation, risk management, test planning, and evidence-based certification.

- Ability to coordinate senior engineering stakeholders and external laboratories while maintaining clear accountability.

- Excellent written communication, attention to detail, and program tracking.

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related technical field.

Preferred experience

- Exposure to UL, CE, FCC, IEC, ISO, OSHA, machinery safety, functional safety, EMC, or radio compliance.

- Experience with autonomous systems, construction equipment, industrial machinery, or products deployed in the United States.

- Formal program-management or quality-system experience.

title: Director, Professional Services
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Professional Services based in Canada.

This is a senior leadership opportunity overseeing professional services across North America, EMEA, and APAC. You will own the delivery strategy for enterprise implementations, rollouts, and services engagements across a diverse international customer base. The role combines operational leadership with significant commercial responsibility for revenue, margins, utilization, milestones, and expansion. You will build and lead a high-performing project management organization while partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success. The position offers direct visibility with executive stakeholders and the opportunity to shape how professional services drives customer outcomes and business growth. Global travel and engagement with major industrial organizations make this a highly strategic and influential leadership role.

Accountabilities:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of large-scale professional services programs across North America, EMEA, and APAC, from greenfield implementations through rollout expansions.
  • Establish and manage the regional professional services delivery model, defining performance standards, success criteria, and operational priorities.
  • Take ownership of services revenue, program margins, utilization, billable milestone attainment, and cross-sell and up-sell growth across the portfolio.
  • Ensure programs achieve customer ROI objectives and contractual Statement of Work (SOW) commitments.
  • Partner with Sales on services opportunities, including scoping, pricing, delivery strategy, customer presentations, and commercial negotiations.
  • Draft, negotiate, and manage SOWs and change orders while protecting margins and maintaining delivery discipline.
  • Identify project risks early, lead issue resolution, and ensure milestones are delivered on time while controlling project-hour overruns.
  • Allocate people, budgets, and time effectively, continuously monitoring program health and adjusting resources where needed.
  • Recruit, hire, lead, and develop Project Managers responsible for managing customer accounts and delivery programs.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and strengthen the capabilities of Project Managers and functional consultants through coaching and mentorship.
  • Drive collaboration across Sales, Product, and Customer Success, escalating risks proactively and providing actionable recommendations.
  • Serve as a senior executive advisor to strategic customers, aligning delivery roadmaps with their enterprise asset management objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to increase customer value through additional rollouts, training, license adoption, cross-sell, and up-sell initiatives.
  • Partner with Customer Success to translate product adoption and successful delivery into measurable customer ROI and long-term growth.
  • Maintain strong executive relationships across a globally distributed customer portfolio and represent the professional services organization in strategic discussions.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of experience delivering professional services, consulting, or SaaS implementation engagements for enterprise software within large or multinational organizations.
    • 3+ years of experience managing Project Managers, Program Managers, or comparable professional services leaders.
    • 3+ years of SAP Plant Maintenance experience or equivalent hands-on experience in maintenance, repair, planning, and scheduling operations within relevant industrial sectors.
    • Proven experience owning services revenue, margin, utilization, or comparable commercial performance targets.
    • Hands-on experience scoping, pricing, negotiating, and managing SOWs and change orders.
    • Strong track record delivering complex enterprise implementations, greenfield programs, and multi-site rollouts.
    • Demonstrated ability to manage executive-level escalations, resolve conflicts, and maintain productive relationships across customer and internal stakeholders.
    • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to turn successful delivery and customer adoption into expansion opportunities.
    • Highly accountable, independent, and solutions-oriented, with strong judgment when managing complex operational and commercial challenges.
    • Excellent written and verbal English skills, with the ability to lead executive conversations across multiple regions and cultures.
    • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
    • Experience delivering projects across at least two of North America, EMEA, and APAC, including managing distributed teams across multiple time zones, is preferred.
    • Experience with professional services automation or CRM platforms for forecasting, staffing, utilization, and expansion pipeline management is advantageous.
    • Enterprise-scale mobility implementation experience is a strong plus.
    • Willingness to travel up to 50% domestically and internationally.
    • Fluency or working proficiency in at least one additional language, particularly Spanish, French, or German, is preferred.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time, remote working opportunity.
      • Global scope across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other lice applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices.   • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

title: Senior Installer
description:
We’re looking for a Lead Installer who is an absolute ace. Someone we can trust to figure it out.

The hours aren’t always pretty. Days, nights, weekends, long days, weird schedules, whatever it takes to get the job done. You’re good with all of that.

You know how to install. You know how to troubleshoot. You know how to look at a problem, figure out what’s actually wrong, and make a plan. If there's a change in plans, you know who to call and what to ask for. But before any of that, you’ve already walked the job, start to finish in your head and made note of the stumbling blocks, the what-ifs, and the things that nobody put in a drawing.

You’re also good with people. You can walk into a client's space, take charge without being a jerk, and make things happen without making it a big production. You make the client feel like they’re in good hands, you keep stakeholders in the loop and you understand the importance of using the right language for the right audience.

This is a lead role, and it comes with the authority to match. You’re coordinating with GCs, site supers and other trades to weave the work under tight deadlines. You understand the crush to get the CO at the end of a construction job and how crucial a clean carpet can be for a retail opening. You know when to push, and you’re the one to call a stop when something isn’t right, because we’d rather eat an hour than a go-back.

This work means nights, weekends and travel. None of this is a surprise to you, and you understand the varied nature of our industry.

What makes Axiom different from the other install jobs you’ve had is that we build what you install. Heck, sometimes you build what you install. The work you do comes out of our seventy-five thousand square foot shop full of people that you'll be collaborating with and working beside. When you’re off the road, you’re in the shop working with the build team, and when something gets crated badly or fights you on site, you’ve got the opportunity to get the needed changes into production for next time.

You’ve probably done most of this:

  • Led multi-phase retail, event, or commercial installs from the first logistics meeting through sign-off.
  • Held your own with a GC on site without making an enemy.
  • Trained up installers who are now great at what they do because of the time they spent shoulder to shoulder with you.
  • Structural rigging, anchoring, and fastening across a multitude of materials has taught you what can bend, and what shouldn't.

This isn’t a job for someone who needs a perfect set of instructions. Things will go sideways. You’re the person we want when they do, and we’re paying accordingly.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Solution Architect based in United States.

This is a senior, globally focused opportunity for an experienced maintenance and SAP EAM professional who wants to shape the future of industrial maintenance. You will translate real-world plant processes into scalable mobile, digital, and AI-enabled solutions. The role combines onsite discovery, process consulting, solution architecture, value engineering, and strategic customer engagement. You will work directly with maintenance, reliability, IT, and operations leaders across major industrial environments. You will also strengthen existing implementations by identifying opportunities to improve adoption, digitize additional workflows, and unlock further value. With global travel and significant ownership of solution design, this role offers the chance to influence how complex industrial organizations modernize maintenance operations.

Accountabilities

  • Lead end-to-end solution design for enterprise maintenance environments, defining how mobile, digital, and AI capabilities transform existing workflows.
  • Conduct onsite discovery sessions, assessments, workshops, and gap analyses with maintenance, reliability, operations, and IT stakeholders.
  • Map current maintenance and repair processes and define detailed future-state workflows, including work order execution, notifications, confirmations, time and materials, measurements, parts handling, and offline field operations.
  • Define how AI-enabled capabilities can automate manual steps, capture information at the point of work, and improve the use of maintenance data.
  • Act as the design authority for SAP PM integration, master data structures, mobile configurations, security roles, and user access.
  • Translate solution designs into clear implementation plans that functional consultants can execute.
  • Review deployed solutions across existing customer accounts to determine whether the design continues to reflect actual operational requirements.
  • Develop structured action plans distinguishing design improvements from configuration, data, and training requirements, with clear ownership, sequencing, and effort estimates.
  • Identify additional processes, sites, and capabilities that could benefit from digital transformation and build expansion cases around measurable operational value.
  • Quantify and communicate business value using maintenance KPIs such as wrench time, schedule compliance, backlog health, PM/PdM completion, MTBF, and MTTR.
  • Coach functional consultants on maintenance processes, solution design principles, and architectural decision-making.
  • Support sales teams with technical discovery, solution scoping, customer presentations, and strategic solution discussions.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior operations and IT stakeholders and confidently communicate technical recommendations to both executive audiences and frontline maintenance teams.

    • Requirements:

    • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a maintenance or reliability technician, craft supervisor, MRO lead, or similar role within a refinery, plant, mill, mine, or other industrial environment.
    • 5+ years of experience in SAP PM or EAM implementation consulting, including ownership of solution design, onsite process assessments, and gap analysis.
    • Demonstrated experience transitioning industrial sites from paper-based work orders to mobile maintenance execution.
    • Proven ability to assess live customer environments, identify gaps between deployed solutions and operational reality, and develop actionable plans for implementation teams.
    • Strong practical understanding of maintenance and repair operations, including notification intake, work order management, confirmations, parts management, and closeout data quality.
    • Experience presenting quantified business cases to operations and IT executives while also being comfortable discussing process changes directly with frontline teams.
    • Experience defining security roles and access requirements for maintenance and enterprise systems.
    • Working knowledge of AI technologies relevant to industrial maintenance, including large language models, retrieval over technical documentation, agentic automation, and predictive models.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and hands-on maintenance experience.
    • Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Willingness to travel up to 50%, primarily across North America, with travel to EMEA and APAC as customer requirements dictate.
    • Ability to satisfy plant, refinery, mine, and other industrial site safety and access requirements.
    • CMRP, CRL, or equivalent maintenance and reliability certification is preferred.
    • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Asset Management and SAP integration patterns involving PO, ECC, and APIs is advantageous.

title: Principle Engineer - R&D
description: ABOUT Banyan Nation is a pioneer in circular economy for plastics, and a major player in India's FMCG bottle-to-bottle recycling industry. In the last one year, Banyan helped partners like HUL, Reckitt, and Shell put over 1 billion bottles made from recycled plastics on the shelves. Banyan Nation’s recycled resins are widely regarded as the benchmark for quality in the Indian HDPE and PP plastics recycling industry. Banyan Nation became the first Indian company to receive USFDA approval for its HDPE bottle grade resins. Banyan Nation's proprietary washing, color-homogenization, and deodorization techniques make its resins the preferred choice for FMCG and lube packaging applications. Banyan Nation won the World Economic Forum Circulars Award in 2018 and was also recognized as a ‘WEF Technology Pioneer’ in 2021. Banyan Nation was the recipient of the Social Enterprise Award at the ET Startup Awards in 2022 and the ‘Climate Warrior' Award at the Forbes India Leadership Awards in 2023 for its groundbreaking work in plastics recycling. Banyan Nation is also supported by the Indian EXIM bank’s “Ubharte Sitare” Program. Headquartered in Hyderabad, Banyan currently operates a state-of-the-art recycling plant in Pashamylaram, Telangana and is expanding to 5x capacity by 2025/26. JOB DESCRIPTION Role: Principal Engineer, R&D Location: Hyderabad Reporting to: Head – R&D GENERAL PURPOSE In this role, the incumbent must be a highly skilled polymer expert to join our R&D team. The candidate will be responsible for conducting research, analyzing data, and developing innovative polymer materials for various applications. This role requires expertise in polymer chemistry, materials characterization techniques, and a strong background in polymer processing and synthesis. DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES Novel Technology/Capability Development • Conduct research and development activities to design, synthesize, and optimize polymer materials with desired properties. • Analyze experimental data, interpret results, develop standard test methods for FTIR, DSC, TGA, GC-MS etc. • Stay updated to facilitate exchange of ideas with the internal working groups on current literature and advancements in polymer science and technology. • Define TDS, CoA, MSDS SoPs for new grade developments (R&D). Stakeholder management • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand application requirements and develop tailored polymer solutions. R&D lab/ Data management: • Design and execute experiments to evaluate and validate the performance of polymer materials in different environments and applications. • Maintain accurate documentation of experimental procedures, results, and observations, formalize recipe database - map testing data for all in-house/convertor/client trials. • Maintain repository of all defects and solution guidelines. • Accountable for regulatory compliance check, AMC of all R&D in-house lab equipment. KEY KNOWLEDGE / COMPETENCIES REQUIRED: • Technical: Proficiency in polymer characterization techniques such as FTIR, NMR, DSC, TGA, SEM, and rheology. Familiarity with polymer material testing and analysis, including mechanical testing, thermal analysis, and spectroscopy. Familiarity with relevant software and modeling tools used in polymer science. • Industry Knowledge: Strong knowledge of polymer chemistry, polymerization techniques, and structure-properties. Experience in polymer synthesis and formulation, including knowledge of different polymerization methods and polymer processing techniques. • Communication: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and present research findings. • Presentation & Analytics: Ability to design and execute experiments, analyse data, and draw meaningful conclusions. • Interpersonal skills: Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot and optimize polymer materials and processes. • Decision making: Should be able to make priorities and make decisions in line with R&D goals. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED. Ph. D in polymer science, chemistry, materials science, or a related field bachelors/master’s degree from CIPET or equivalent institutes may be considered. 5-8 years of relevant industry experience as polymer scientist is preferrable. title: Associate GP + UC - West Moore
description:
GP + Urgent Care Associate Veterinarian – CityVet West Moore Veterinary Clinic & Urgent Care
The Freedom to Practice. The Support to Thrive.

Love the variety of urgent care but still enjoy building lasting relationships with clients? At CityVet West Moore, you don't have to choose.

Our hybrid General Practice and Urgent Care hospital offers the best of both worlds, preventive medicine, surgery, dentistry, and same-day medical cases that keep every day interesting. Whether you're performing a routine dental in the morning or stabilizing an urgent walk-in that afternoon, you'll have the support, equipment, and team to practice high-quality medicine with confidence.

A Team That Truly Enjoys Working Together

At CityVet West Moore, culture isn't something we talk about, it's something Dr. Cowdrey and the team have built.

Led by an experienced veterinarian who values professionalism, teamwork, and thoughtful patient care, our hospital is home to a close-knit team that genuinely enjoys working together. You will be supported by a talented group of veterinary assistants who have worked alongside Dr. Cowdrey for years. That stability translates into efficient workflows, excellent patient care, and a team that knows how to have fun while working hard.

Outside the hospital, you'll often find the team spending time together, celebrating wins, and building friendships that make coming to work something everyone looks forward to.

Why You'll Love Practicing Here

CityVet West Moore is open seven days a week and serves as a trusted destination for both primary care and urgent medical needs. Our busiest days are weekends, making this an ideal opportunity for a veterinarian who enjoys a dynamic caseload and the challenge of same-day medicine.

Our hospital features:

  • Five exam rooms, including a dedicated feline exam room and a comfort room
  • Spacious surgical suite
  • Treatment area with T-table
  • Piloter ultrasound
  • Handheld digital dental radiography
  • Cold laser therapy
  • Cautery
  • Abaxis in-house laboratory analyzers
  • Two Imagyst diagnostic systems
  • OptiCell and VetScan+ diagnostics

The Veterinarian We're Looking For

We're seeking an experienced Associate Veterinarian who is comfortable practicing independently and enjoys a broad range of medicine.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Enjoy both general practice and urgent care medicine
  • Like surgery and dentistry as part of your regular caseload
  • Appreciate working with an experienced, highly efficient support team
  • Value professionalism, collaboration, and compassionate client communication
  • Enjoy practicing in a fast-paced environment where no two days are exactly alike
  • Are excited to participate in a rotating weekend schedule

About CityVet

For over 25 years, CityVet has been a company founded and led by veterinarians. We believe in empowering our doctors to practice medicine their way, fostering a culture of collaboration, and providing a clear path to career growth. Our local ownership model is backed by national support, giving you the autonomy you desire with the resources you need to succeed.

We are proud of our reputation, which is reflected in our accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place to Work™ for three consecutive years.
  • Recognized as the #11 Best Place to Work on Glassdoor across all industries.
  • The only GP veterinary company named on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Health Care™.
  • A 4.8-star average Google rating from over 10,000 client reviews.

How we break the mold

As a CityVet Veterinarian, you will focus on providing high-quality medical care to pets while building lasting relationships with their owners. We are looking for a doctor who is committed to excellence in general practice or urgent care services.

At CityVet, we C.A.R.E. about our doctors:

  • Culture: A workplace where people feel supported and valued
  • Advancement: Growth through mentorship and ownership opportunities
  • Relationships: Deep connections with teams, clients, and communities
  • Excellence: Delivering the best for people and pets

We invest in your future with unparalleled veterinary career opportunities:

  • A Pathway to Ownership: We offer a unique opportunity for partnership without the high financial pressure.
  • Continuing Education: Gain access to Affinity Academy for customized CE and leadership development programs.
  • Supportive Network: Join a community of over 150 veterinarians who collaborate and share knowledge.

Qualifications

  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degree or equivalent.
  • Licensed to practice in this state or eligible for licensure.
  • A collaborative spirit and a commitment to providing exceptional patient care.
  • Interest in General Practice and/or Urgent Care medicine.

Benefits & Compensation

We believe in rewarding our veterinarians with a benefits package that supports their professional and personal well-being.

  • Unlimited Earning Potential: A progressive compensation model with a guaranteed base salary and no ceiling.
  • Generous Production Commission: Earn up to 28% production commission with no negative accrual.
  • Retirement Savings: A 401(k) plan with a 4% employer match.
  • Financial Wellness: Access to student debt support, financial planning tools, and loan repayment resources.
  • Work-Life Balance: Enjoy generous paid time off, paid parental leave, and comprehensive mental health benefits.
  • Exceptional Health Care: We provide free virtual urgent care for all full-time team members and their families.

title: Customer Engineer II-MDP
description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

What We Offer

Location:

Shenzhen,CHN

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment

  • Use digital analytics for troubleshooting

  • Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]

  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)

  • Coordinate and communicate directly with customers

  • Fulfill additional duties, as assigned


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification

  • 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field

  • Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges

  • Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics

  • Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

  • Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.

  • Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field


Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 20% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

Yes

title: IT Support Technician (Multiple Shifts)
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Description

This position is not eligible for immigration and/or visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship by Jabil. Applicants requiring sponsorship will not be considered.

JOB SUMMARY

How Will You Make an Impact?

In this role as an IT Support Technician, you will support both a new factory startup and an existing factory facility. You are expected to operate in a dynamic, fast-changing environment where systems, processes, and infrastructure are being established. You will play a hands-on role in site IT bring-up, support early production ramp activities, and work closely with IT leadership, facilities, vendors, and manufacturing teams during startup and steady-state operations.

Location: On-site - Byhalia, MS and Memphis, TN facilities

Shifts: 2nd, 3rd, and Weekend

What Will You Do?

Core Support Responsibilities
• Load and verify software packages
• Troubleshoot and resolve end-user issues
• Install and configure PCs and peripherals
• Resolve site-level incident management requests
• Populate Knowledge Database and Configuration Management Database where appropriate
• Emphasize management of queues and adherence to SLAs and KPIs
• Install and configure PCs (imaging)
• Troubleshoot basic issues with scanners (MES / SAP RF)
• Provide phone-based or remote support for offsite users
• Purchase software and hardware via PO process
• Administer user accounts using Active Directory
• Support mobile device enrollment, configuration, and basic troubleshooting (corporate smartphones and tablets)
• Provide maintenance and support of Audio/Visual equipment
• Perform baseline support for standard IT applications
• Monitor Service Desk queues and resolve tickets in a timely manner
• Install, identify, and repair hardware and peripheral components
• Simulate or recreate user issues to resolve operating difficulties
• Maintain inventory of computer parts and logs of repairs
• Provide training and technical assistance to users

Startup & Factory Ramp Responsibilities
• Support IT infrastructure and end-user readiness activities during factory build, commissioning, and early production ramp
• Assist with initial deployment of IT equipment, workstations, printers, scanners, and shared devices across office and manufacturing floor environments
• Operate effectively in a startup environment with evolving processes, incomplete documentation, and shifting priorities
• Work hands-on in factory, warehouse, and construction-adjacent environments as systems and work areas are brought online
• Support non-standard schedules, including extended hours or weekends, during critical startup and production milestones
• Partner closely with IT leadership, facilities, manufacturing engineering, and external vendors to resolve issues impacting startup timelines
• Identify gaps, risks, or recurring issues during ramp and proactively escalate or propose improvements

Continuous Improvement & Professional Expectations
• Participate in the exchange of ideas and information within the department
• Ask questions and encourage input from team members
• Provide regular updates to appropriate managers
• Identify creative ways to reduce cost and improve efficiency
• Drive continuous improvement through trend analysis and metrics
• Ensure procedures and work instructions are efficient and not redundant
• Demonstrate strong customer service and sense of urgency
• Maintain discretion and confidentiality of IT systems and data
• Understand and embrace business and IT strategic direction
• Follow all corporate, regional, and site security, safety, and health policies

How Will You Get Here?

Education & Experience

• High School diploma and 5-8 years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Active Directory experience

• Experience troubleshooting network issues, VLAN's and VPNs
• Experience imaging new computer systems

• Experience with factory-floor shared devices - label printers & RF scanners

• Knowledge of Microsoft applications and utilities

title: business finance Lead
description: BIZZY BIX JOB DESCRIPTION Business Finance Lead Job Title Department Business Finance Lead Reporting To Finance & Accounts Location Founder Employment Type TBD Experience Required Full-Time 5 Years in Finance / Accounts About Bizzy Bix Bizzy Bix is reimagining the ₹50,000+ Cr biscuit category in India — building a new-age, better for-you brand with high energy, strong product innovation, and modern distribution. Funded and built out of one of India’s leading venture studios. We build like a sports team — small, sharp, fast. No passengers. Channels: Quick commerce · Modern trade · General trade · D2C Role Summary You will be the financial backbone of Bizzy Bix. This is not a reporting role. It’s not a compliance-only job. It’s a build-from-scratch, own-it-all role at a fast-moving consumer brand at the start of something big. You’ll own every rupee that moves through this business — where it goes, what it costs, what it means. Finance here isn’t a support function. It’s a growth lever. What You’ll Own Financial Management & Planning • Own the full financial planning cycle — budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. No one checks your work before the founder sees it. • Build financial models that actually drive decisions — unit economics, channel margins, pricing scenarios, fundraising inputs. • Lead annual planning and keep it alive through the year. Plans should predict reality, not just document ambition. MIS & Reporting • Design and own MIS dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility — not 10-day-old numbers in a spreadsheet. • Deliver financial and operational reports that are sharp, on time, and tell a clear story. The founder shouldn’t need to ask twice. • Be the single source of truth. Data in, data out — accuracy is non-negotiable. P&L Management • Own the P&L — every line, every week. Revenues, COGS, channel costs, gross margins. Nothing should surprise you. • Spot risks before they become problems. Spot opportunities before the team misses them. Come with a point of view, not just a report. • Drive cost discipline across business units. Plug leakage. Make every rupee work harder. Audit & Compliance • Run internal and statutory audits cleanly, on schedule, with zero surprises for the leadership team. • Keep the company clean — GST, TDS, ROC, statutory filings. Compliance is your baseline, not your ceiling. • Manage relationships with external auditors, CA firms, and regulatory authorities. Be the point person — no hand-holding needed. Cash Flow Management • Know the cash position at all times — daily, weekly, monthly. No liquidity surprises. • Optimise working capital continuously. Ensure we’re never cash-constrained when the business needs to move fast. • Own banking relationships and fund utilisation. Capital should be working, not sitting. Payment Recovery Management • Own accounts receivable end-to-end. What’s owed to us gets collected — on time, every time. • Build and run dunning and recovery frameworks that reduce DSO and keep bad debt close to zero. • Work closely with sales and ops to make collections a shared accountability, not a finance afterthought. Bookkeeping & Accounts • Keep the books tight — payables, receivables, journal entries. Clean, current, complete. • Own the general ledger and run month-end and year-end close without it becoming a fire drill. • Review all reconciliations — bank, vendor, inter-company. Gaps get caught here, not by auditors. ERP & Systems • Own the ERP — configuration, data hygiene, user governance. It should be a system people actually use, not work around. • Drive ERP adoption and process standardisation across teams. Messy data in means messy decisions out. • Continuously improve financial systems and workflows. Automate the repetitive. Eliminate the manual. Who We’re Looking For • CA, MBA Finance, or equivalent — the credential matters less than the depth of financial thinking behind it • 5+ years in finance or business finance — ideally at a startup, FMCG company, or fast-moving consumer brand where you’ve had to figure things out without a big team behind you • Comfortable in an ERP (Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, SAP, or similar) — and strong enough in Excel or Google Sheets to build anything the ERP can’t Key Skills & Mindset Technical Skills Financial Modelling & Analysis P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow MIS Reporting & Dashboards ERP / Accounting Software Tax, GST, TDS, Compliance Advanced Excel / Google Sheets Soft Skills You’ll Thrive Here If… High ownership & accountability Strong analytical thinking Excellent communication skills Attention to detail & accuracy Ability to work under pressure Cross-functional collaboration • You think in systems and root causes, not just symptoms • You move between strategy and spreadsheets without losing pace • You hate ambiguity in numbers and fix it fast • You’re excited to build, not just maintain • You can hold your own in a room with the founder, investors, or a vendor CFO This role is not right for you if… You’re looking for a structured finance function with clear processes handed to you. This is a zero-to-one build. The upside is significant. So is the ownership. What Success Looks Like Month 3 Books clean, ERP running, compliance calendar owned. Leadership has a weekly MIS they actually trust. Month 6 Full P&L visibility by channel. Cash flow forecasting running with confidence. Receivables process built and active. Month 12 Finance is a strategic input to every major decision. Audit clean. DSO improving. The founder trusts the numbers without checking them twice. Month 18 Finance function investor-ready. Unit economics documented and improving. You’re operating at CFO level. The title may follow. Why This Role Matters • Direct access to the founder and leadership team — your work shapes decisions at the top • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience • The chance to build the finance function from zero — your systems, your processes, your standards • A lean, high-ownership team where accountability is celebrated and bureaucracy doesn’t exist • A clear path to CFO as Bizzy Bix scales — if you build it right, the title follows
