title: 22171 - Senior Project Manager
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Executive Director of Soccer Development
description:
The Executive Director of Soccer Development provides strategic and operational leadership for YMCA soccer programs at the Emory Folmar YMCA Soccer Complex, including recreational soccer, competitive soccer club, camps, clinics, tournaments, adaptive soccer opportunities, and community outreach. The role is accountable for growing participation, strengthening the player development pathway, improving the participant and family experience, developing coaches and volunteers, building community partnerships, and ensuring programs operate with excellence, inclusion, financial discipline, and alignment with the YMCA
mission.
This position requires a highly visible presence at the complex and throughout the community, including practices, games, tournaments, camps, clinics, special events, schools, churches, daycare centers, youth organizations, and other partner settings. The Executive Director will work closely with the Vice-President of Athletics, branch leadership, coaches, volunteers, association leadership, and community partners to expand access, strengthen program quality, and advance the YMCA’s mission and strategic goals.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, enthusiasm, professionalism, organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with players, parents, coaches, volunteers, officials, staff, and community partners.
In addition, every position within the YMCA of Greater Montgomery is responsible for upholding the Christian principles central to our mission by modeling behaviors that exemplify the four pillars of character: caring, honesty, respect, and responsibility.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
Soccer Program Operations
  1. Organize, administer, and oversee all YMCA recreational youth soccer programs, adult recreational soccer programs, and competitive soccer programs.
  2. Manage the administration of soccer programs, including player registration, tryouts, player recruitment, team formation, rosters, scheduling, uniforms, equipment, awards, referees, coaches’ meetings, and communications.
  3. Develop and implement strategies to increase player participation, recruitment, retention, and overall program growth.
  4. Ensure programs are organized efficiently and provide participants and families with a high level of customer service and a positive experience.
  5. Maintain a regular presence at games, practices, tournaments, and other activities to evaluate program quality and effectiveness.
  6. Develop and support an effective Soccer Branch Board of Directors by engaging volunteers, strengthening committee work, advancing program priorities, and aligning board efforts with YMCA mission, growth, fundraising, and community impact goals.
  7. Work with YMCA staff to develop and implement marketing strategies and materials for recreational soccer, Competitive Soccer, camps, clinics, tournaments, and other soccer programs.
  8. Communicate positively, professionally, and effectively with players, parents, participants, coaches, volunteers, officials, staff, and community partners.
  9. Provide timely responses to emails, phone calls, registration questions, complaints, and requests for information.
  10. Create a welcoming, inclusive, and professional environment for all members, participants, families, coaches, and visitors.
  11. Build positive relationships with members and participants and consistently promote the YMCA mission.
  12. Prepare, manage, and monitor annual budgets for assigned recreational and competitive soccer programs within approved YMCA budget guidelines.
  13. Monitor program revenues and expenses to achieve established financial goals.
  14. Carry out all YMCA of Greater Montgomery policies and procedures related to management, administration, purchasing, and accounting.
  15. Recruit and secure team and program sponsorships for recreational soccer and Competitive Soccer.
  16. Support the YMCA Annual Campaign and other fundraising initiatives.
Recreational Soccer
  1. Organize and implement all recreational youth and mini-soccer programs, including team formation, rosters, game schedules, uniforms, awards, volunteer coaches, referees, coaches meetings, and coach training. Recruit, screen, train, schedule, support, and supervise volunteer recreational coaches and program volunteers.
  2. Develop educational resources and training opportunities for recreational coaches to improve the quality and consistency of the participant experience.
  3. Organize and oversee all adult recreational soccer programming.
  4. Conduct end-of-season evaluations and participant surveys to identify opportunities to improve recreational and competitive soccer programs.
Competitive Soccer and Player Development
  1. Direct and oversee all competitive soccer programming.
  2. Develop and maintain a club-wide player development philosophy and curriculum.
  3. Oversee player identification, evaluation, placement, recruitment, retention, and development within the competitive program.
  4. Organize and direct competitive tryouts and assist with the selection and formation of competitive teams.
  5. Recruit, hire, train, develop, evaluate, and supervise professional coaches.
Camps, Clinics and Community Outreach
  1. Create, direct, and lead YMCA and competitive summer and winter soccer camps, clinics, and other player development opportunities.
  2. Conduct soccer clinics and community outreach activities designed to introduce children and families to YMCA recreational and competitive soccer opportunities.
  3. Develop initiatives and partnerships that expand the reach of YMCA soccer throughout Montgomery and surrounding communities.
PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:
  • Increase soccer participation, player recruitment, and family retention across recreational and competitive programs.
  • Strengthen coach development, volunteer engagement, and consistency of the player and family experience.
  • Achieve financial performance goals by managing revenue, expenses, sponsorships, fundraising, and program resources responsibly.
  • Expand community partnerships, outreach opportunities, and alignment with YMCA mission and character values.
SAFETY AND RISK MANAGEMENT: Safety and risk management responsibilities include maintaining a safe environment for participants, families, staff, volunteers, and visitors; ensuring compliance with YMCA policies and applicable program standards; supporting emergency preparedness; addressing facility or program concerns promptly; and communicating expectations clearly to coaches, officials, staff, and families.
YMCA COMPETENCIES:
Mission Advancement: Incorporates the Y’s mission and values into the organization’s vision and strategies. Ensures community engagement; promotes the global nature of the Y. Leads a culture of volunteerism ensuring engagement, inclusion, and ownership. Leads a culture of philanthropy.
Collaboration: Advocates for and institutionalizes inclusion and diversity throughout the organization. Initiates the development of relationships with influential leaders to impact and strengthen the community. Is recognized as an inspirational community leader who navigates complex political and social circles with ease. Communicates to engage and inspire people within and outside the YMCA. Ensures that a talent management system is in place and executed effectively.
Operational Effectiveness: Possesses penetrating insight and strong strategic and critical thinking skills. Invests resources in well-designed innovation initiatives. Creates a structure to deliver organization-wide results to achieve objectives. Develops and implements stewardship strategies. Determines benchmarks and ensures appropriate leadership to meet objectives.
Personal Growth: Creates a learning organization. Effectively drives change by leveraging resources and creating alignment to expand organizational opportunities. Shares authority and demonstrates courage and humility. Has the functional and technical knowledge and skills required to perform well; uses best practices and demonstrates up-to-date knowledge and skills in technology.
QUALIFICATIONS:
  1. Bachelor's degree in human services, recreation, business, social services, or equivalent experience.
  2. Five or more years of youth sports experience in the YMCA or another nonprofit preferred.
  3. Knowledge and experience in program development, including staff supervision and development, quality program design and implementation, volunteer engagement, facility and property management, and sound financial practices.
  4. Understanding of the mission and cause of the YMCA and the respective roles of volunteers and staff.
  5. Ability to relate effectively to diverse groups of people from all social and economic segments of the community; track record of building authentic, constructive relationships with others.
  6. Ability to manage multiple demands and priorities while achieving organizational objectives.
  7. YMCA Multi-Team Leader certification preferred.
  8. Demonstrated ability to lead with innovation, initiative, and sound judgment while developing programs, solving problems, and advancing organizational goals.
  9. USSF “D” License preferred.
  10. USSF “C” License preferred.
  11. Currently authorized to work in the U.S.
Required Certifications and Trainings (Current or within 30 days of hire)
CPR, First Aid and AED
Mandatory YMCA Safety Trainings
The YMCA of Greater Montgomery is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment is subject to a background check.

title: Data Scientist IC role - Nirvana
description:
Who we are

Nirvana is on a mission to modernize commercial insurance and enable a safer world. Our technology platform delivers modern insurance & risk management to not only help our customers protect their businesses, but actually improve safety for everyone.

To start, we’re transforming the legacy, $750B+ commercial insurance industry through cutting-edge predictive models using real-time IoT data (~50B connected devices by 2030), automation to deliver instantaneous quotes & faster underwriting, & proactive, and data-driven insights to help customers prevent accidents.

Backed by top-tier VCs including General Catalyst & Lightspeed Ventures, Nirvana became the fastest insurtech EVER to launch in Jan 2022 and crossed >$10M run rate in under 6 months, more than 2x faster than best-in-class insurtechs. Our leadership team has helped scale multi-billion dollar companies from scratch including Samsara, Rubrik, Acko & Flexport, and includes industry veterans from Hiscox, AIG, The Hartford & RLI.

About the role

At Nirvana, we work with heterogeneous datasets and mine predictive signals to accurately identify risks for businesses. Some of the data we work with includes,

  • 100s of millions of GPS and sensor data points per vehicle, ingested and stored in our proprietary data platform.

  • Safety events like harsh braking, distracted driving, etc computed from sensors in commercial vehicles.

  • High-dimensional datasets containing, among others, decades of vehicle inspection, crash, and violation data for all commercial vehicles in the US.

As a Data Scientist, you will work closely with our data engineering and insurance teams and use these large datasets to help build data-driven insurance and safety products in a fast-paced startup environment. You must enjoy working with large data and finding interesting patterns in the data through analytics experiments in a methodical and data-driven scientific way.

The insurance / risk business has many unsolved problems where sophisticated use of information plays a critical role. Join us in making an impact on the industry!

What you’ll do

  • Extract actionable insights and recommendations from time series data to help our customers improve their safety

  • Work closely with the insurance team to build and validate complex risk models

  • Standardizing analysis methodology and building automated frameworks

  • Understand data characteristics, prepare and clean large high-dimensional data sets, and define and automate robust data quality measures

  • Work in cross functional teams

About you

title: Network Engineer
description:
Location: Nashville, TN, Memphis, TN, Atlanta, GA, Greensboro, NC or Charlotte, NC – Field Based

Position Level: Tier 2 / Tier 3 Network Engineering

Position Summary

We are looking for a Network Engineer with a strong background in routing and switching to lead our on-site enterprise deployments. This is not a standard "cable tech" role; we need a Cisco-certified professional who can bridge the gap between physical infrastructure and complex logical networking. You will be the technical authority on-site, responsible for configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining high-capacity circuits for our most critical business clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced L2/L3 Troubleshooting: Resolve complex connectivity issues involving BGP, OSPF, VLAN tagging (802.1Q), and STP.
  • Enterprise Deployment: Lead the installation and CLI-based configuration of Cisco, Juniper, and Meraki hardware.
  • Circuit Validation: Utilize high-end diagnostic tools (VIAVI, NetAlly) to ensure Fiber and Ethernet circuits meet strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • NOC Collaboration: Act as the primary field liaison for our Network Operations Center, assisting in the turn-up of static IP blocks and complex routing tables.
  • MDF/IDF Management: Perform "deep-dive" audits of client server rooms to optimize equipment placement and extend demarcations.
  • Infrastructure Reliability: While the focus is logical, you will ensure the physical layer (Fiber/Copper) is spliced and terminated to enterprise standards.

Technical Skills & Qualifications

Certifications (One or more required):

  • Cisco: CCNA (Routing & Switching) required; CCNP or CCIE highly preferred.
  • Alternative: Juniper JNCIA/JNCIS, or CompTIA Network+ (with significant field experience).

Core Competencies:

  • Hardware: Deep experience with Cisco ISR/ASR routers, Catalyst switches, Juniper MX/EX series, and Meraki MS/MX stacks.
  • Protocols: Proficiency in TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and SD-WAN architectures.
  • Network Analysis: Experience with packet-level analysis using Wireshark to identify latency or jitter issues.
  • Physical Layer: Familiarity with Fiber Optic standards (GPON/Active Ethernet) and the ability to use an OTDR or Fusion Splicer when necessary.

Soft Skills & Requirements

  • The Technical Consultant: Ability to walk into a Fortune 500 server room and speak as a peer to their Network Architects.
  • Critical Thinking: A methodical approach to the "broken" circuit—isolating variables from the handoff to the core.
  • Mobility: Must hold a valid driver’s license and be comfortable with daily travel to client locations.
  • Physical Ability: Must be able to rack heavy enterprise equipment (up to 50 lbs) and work in professional data center environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • First-Visit Resolution: Utilizing your Cisco expertise to solve routing loops or configuration mismatches that a standard tech would miss.
  • Network Integrity: Ensuring that every client handoff is clean, documented, and performing at 100% capacity.
  • Client Confidence: Serving as a trusted advisor to client IT managers, ensuring they feel secure in our network’s reliability.

title: Special Authorization Analyst II – Clinical Drug Services
description:
Alberta Blue Cross® is an Alberta based organization dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experience and community leadership. We’re committed to providing the best health coverage to over 1.8 million members and take an active role in promoting wellness. We believe in what we do—and place trust in our employees to deliver our vision.

Working at Alberta Blue Cross® means having a career where you’ll be recognized for your contributions. We value diversity, encourage our team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance and provide opportunities for career growth.

OVERVIEW:

Our Special Authorization Analyst II team is growing. This position plays a critical clinical decision-making role in assessing Special Authorization requests and determining appropriate medication coverage within established standards. Special Authorization is a process where prescribers can request coverage for specific drugs for their patients, and this role requires clinicians to apply evidence-based guidelines, clinical judgment, and a strong understanding of member needs to support timely access to medications.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Apply clinical expertise to assess Special Authorization requests, determine eligibility for requested drug therapies, and make decisions that directly impact member access to medications.
  • Interpret clinical information, accepted medical conditions, and plan criteria to ensure decisions are accurate, consistent, and clearly documented.
  • Record decision rationale and required information in Alberta Blue Cross® computer systems to support appropriate claims adjudication and continuity of member access.
  • Prepare clear, clinically informed correspondence for prescribers and subscribers regarding Special Authorization decisions.
  • Respond to electronic and telephone inquiries from internal and external customers by explaining decision outcomes, requirements, and next steps in a professional and member-focused manner.
  • The ability to work occasional weekdays until 5:00 pm, weekends, and statutory holidays on a rotation basis is required.

WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:

  • Preferred post-secondary education in Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Health Sciences, Nursing, or similar clinical disciplines. Or, experienced Pharmacy Technicians and existing special authorization professionals.
  • Knowledge of pharmacotherapy, disease states, treatment guidelines, drug reimbursement principles, and clinical decision-making.
  • Preferred experience in Special Authorization, drug benefits administration, pharmacy practice, formulary management, drug utilization review, or health insurance adjudication.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, work independently, and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
  • High degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and commitment to quality work.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel; Access experience is considered an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, supported by strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a positive and flexible approach.
  • Service-oriented and responsive, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external customers.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE:

  • This role is well suited to pharmacology graduates, experienced pharmacy technicians, and drug benefits professionals who are looking to apply their medication knowledge in a meaningful alternative career path outside of traditional dispensing or frontline pharmacy practice.
  • The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys analyzing clinical information, applying drug coverage criteria, and making thoughtful, evidence-informed decisions that influence whether members can access the medications they need.
  • This opportunity may be especially attractive to experienced clinicians and pharmacy professionals seeking a role that offers clinical complexity, meaningful member impact, and the ability to contribute to medication access without the demands of a retail, hospital, or direct patient-care environment.

This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is selected.

Alberta Blue Cross® is an inclusive employer committed to a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We empower and are advocates for our team members by welcoming, respecting and valuing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

We offer the opportunity to work in an innovative, high-energy team-focused environment. If you have the qualifications we are looking for, apply online at

Inside Out is a US-based premium placement firm matching executive assistants—and increasingly other high-value roles—with American founders and executives who pay a premium for speed and quality. Demand is completely solved through our paid advertising and in-house sales team, meaning you will never have to find a client. Your job is to run and grow the machine that delivers for them.

This is a senior seat reporting directly to the founder. You will have true ownership of the delivery side of the business and share in the financial upside as we scale.

What You Will Own

• Time-to-fill: Managing the timeline from signed client to placed candidate.
• The Bench: Maintaining a pipeline of fully screened, interview-ready candidates for our highest-volume roles.
• Team Performance: Leading an operations coordinator, recruiters/screeners, and sourcing support while establishing productivity standards and scorecards.
• Quality Control: Ensuring placement quality and 90-day retention (replacements come directly out of our margin).
• Process Optimization: Managing our ATS pipeline (JazzHR), sourcing channels, and overall candidate experience.
• Scale & Expansion: Driving more placements per month without quality slipping, and expanding the roles we place as the business grows.

Your First 90 Days
• Audit the current pipeline, bench, and screening processes to identify what is working and what isn't.
• Set the fill-speed and quality standards the team will be held to, putting scorecards in place to track them.
• Rebuild the candidate bench so a signed client is never waiting on sourcing.
• Establish a daily and weekly operating rhythm that keeps every open search moving.

Who You Are
• 5–10+ years in recruitment with real leadership experience (ran an agency, branch, or perm desk with P&L or billings responsibility).
• Experienced in managing recruiters and holding a firm quality bar under speed pressure.
• Highly data-driven: you know your placements per month, fill times, and fall-off rates cold.
• Calm, structured, decisive, and ruthless with prioritization—you don't drop balls.
• Comfortable working US-aligned hours remotely.
• Proficient in leveraging AI tools to screen, source, and move faster.
• A builer at heart: comfortable rewriting broken processes or scaling a half-built function.
• Experience placing into US, UK, or Australian clients is strongly preferred.

Why You Should Join Us
• No Red Tape: Work directly with the founder. Decisions get made in a conversation, giving you a direct line to strategy and hiring.
• Zero Client Acquisition: Inherit a paid-ads and sales engine that already produces signed clients so you can focus entirely on delivery.
• Massive Upside: Beyond base and performance bonuses, this role is on a path to a profit-share incentive. Build the machine and share in what it produces.
• Premium Positioning: We charge top-of-market fees, allowing us to hire well, pay well, and maintain elite standards.
• Global & Remote: Join a 100+ person team across South Africa, the Philippines, and Latin America with no commute and US-dollar earnings.
• Room to Build: Shape how our role expansion happens rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.

title: Principal Developer - IT
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

Our Values: At United Airlines, we believe that inclusion propels innovation and is the foundation of all that we do. Our Shared Purpose: "Connecting people. Uniting the world." drives us to be the best airline for our employees, customers, and everyone we serve, and we can only do that with a truly diverse and inclusive workforce. Our team spans the globe and is made up of diverse individuals all working together with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation.

With multiple employee-run "Business Resource Group" communities and world-class benefits like health insurance, parental leave, and space available travel, United is truly a one-of-a-kind place to work that will make you feel welcome and accepted. Come join our team and help us make a positive impact on the world.

United’s Digital Technology team is responsible for designing, developing, and operating highly scalable technology solutions powered by modern architecture, advanced data analytics, and digital innovation.

Within this ecosystem, the NCUS (NOC, CSR, UAX and SOC) team leads the development and maintenance of the airline’s Network Operations Center (NOC); the operational nerve centre that powers mission-critical capabilities. These include irregular operations (IRROPS) management, flight delay and passenger misconnection predictions, managing aircraft routing, and cancellation recommendations. Leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies and infrastructure, the team continuously enhances recommendation, prediction, and forecasting platforms to deliver intuitive, data-driven tools that enable real-time situational awareness and informed decision-making.

Job Overview and Responsibilities


Our United team in India is on an exciting growth trajectory, and to fuel this momentum, we are seeking a highly experienced Principal Developer who will provide deep technical leadership, hands-on architecture guidance, and engineering excellence for enterprise applications that are essential to driving our business success.
We are looking for a technical leader who combines strong software engineering expertise with the ability to influence architecture, guide complex design decisions, mentor engineering teams, and collaborate closely with product, business, and technology stakeholders. Deep experience in modern application development, cloud-native architecture, Agile delivery, DevOps practices, coding and testing with AI-enabled tools, and solution architecture will be key to success in this role.

Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence: Provide principal-level technical leadership across application design, development, modernization, and delivery. Lead architectural discussions, define engineering standards, review complex designs, mentor developers and tech leads, and promote high-quality, secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with US technology leadership, product teams, business stakeholders, and local/global engineering teams to align technical solutions with business priorities and technology roadmaps. Communicate architecture decisions, delivery risks, technical trade-offs, and opportunities for innovation in a clear and effective manner.
Application Architecture & Delivery: Drive the design and delivery of mission-critical applications using modern engineering practices, cloud-native patterns, microservices, APIs, containers, CI/CD, and DevOps automation. Ensure applications are resilient, observable, performant, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture, compliance, and operational standards. Identify and resolve technical risks that may affect quality, scalability, reliability, or delivery timelines.
Product Technology Strategy and Innovation: Collaborate with United business and DT leadership teams, product SMEs, and cross-functional technology partners to shape product technology strategy, define scalable solution approaches, and support multi-year modernization roadmaps. Apply engineering expertise, data-driven thinking, and AI-enabled development practices to solve complex operational challenges and deliver intuitive, reliable, and innovative capabilities.


This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd - a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
• 12+ years of IT and business/industry experience in application development, software engineering, solution architecture, or large-scale software delivery roles, with a strong focus on technical leadership.
• 10+ years of hands-on experience in application development using Java, .NET, React, AWS, and related modern technology stacks.
• 4+ years of experience architecting and designing complex, enterprise-scale software applications, preferably using cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven patterns.
• Expert-level knowledge of Aviation NOC (Network Operations Center), including IRROPS, day-of-operations management, operational decision support, and mission-critical airline technology platforms.
• Must have agentic AI based development exposure.
• Proven ability to provide technical direction, architecture guidance, design reviews, and engineering mentorship to application development teams, preferably within the Airline NOC space.
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with business partners, product owners, architects, engineering teams, and senior technology stakeholders.
• Strong expertise in microservices architecture, Docker/container platforms, APIs, CI/CD, DevOps automation, observability, cloud-based application development, and secure engineering practices.
• Strong knowledge of stakeholder engagement and collaboration with US-based leadership and globally distributed technology teams.
• Ability to lead the technical design and deployment of agentic AI systems that autonomously plan, reason, and act to drive enterprise-scale innovation.
• Guide engineers and cross-functional partners in integrating agentic AI into business workflows, ensuring ethical, scalable, secure, and high-impact outcomes.
• Experience in Agile, DevOps, and cloud-based application development (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
• Excellent communication, technical influencing, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to collaborate across cross-cultural teams and time zones to drive technical alignment and successful delivery.
• Must be legally authorized to work in India for any employer without sponsorship.

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications)

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Systems, or another related field
• Experience mentoring developers, influencing technical direction, and leading architecture decisions across large engineering teams
• Certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect or related engineering certifications
• Airline/NOC (Network Operations Center) experience is a plus

title: Head of B2B Partnerships
description:
About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.

Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.

  • One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
  • Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
  • Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
  • Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click on to check our TikTok account.⭐️


The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn’t join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a “pay it forward” mentality, but with big and bold goals.

As the Head of B2B Partnerships at Welcome Pickups, you will play a key role in driving the growth and success of the B2B segment. In this role, you will oversee and provide strategic guidance to the Demand Generation, SDR, Sales, and Customer Success teams. You will manage our global B2B network - including Accommodation Partners (Hotels & Vacation Rentals), Travel Agents, Web Affiliates, Corporates, and any new segments across all destinations. This position requires a senior leader with extensive experience in online partnerships, e-commerce, and sales leadership. The ideal candidate will have their finger on the pulse of new and emerging partnership models and integrations, combined with the business acumen to determine where to focus for maximum impact.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Commercial Ownership

  • Own B2B revenue target-setting in partnership with the CCO.
  • Own the end-to-end commercial B2B strategy, ensuring alignment with company objectives and long-term growth plans.
  • Translate company strategy into clear commercial priorities across all B2B functions.
  • Build, structure, and scale the B2B organization to consistently meet and exceed annual targets.
    Act as the senior commercial owner of the B2B function, providing clarity, direction, and accountability.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop the B2B organization, overseeing Sales Development, Business Development, and Partner Success teams - a total of 21 people across multiple global markets and locations.
  • Set clear targets, expectations, ownership, and strategic direction for team leads and managers.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative culture focused on accountability and continuous growth.
  • Partner with CRM & Sales Excellence to ensure structured onboarding, training, and development across all teams.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and support long-term talent development and own succession planning for your direct reports.

Define End-to-End B2B Sales Cycle & GTM

  • Own the performance and effectiveness of the entire B2B sales lifecycle, from lead qualification to deal closure and long-term partner retention.
  • Define ICPs and identify new routes to market and opportunities for scale.
  • Ensure seamless collaboration and handovers between functions:
    • Sales Development (lead qualification and demo booking)
    • Business Development (demos, negotiations, and deal closure)
    • Partner Success (onboarding, retention, and churn prevention)
  • Act as the escalation point for complex negotiations and key accounts.
  • Ensure consistency in partner experience across all stages of the B2B journey.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing to ensure strong alignment on target segments, messaging, and lead handover.
  • Work with Finance and Operations to align on revenue forecasts, hiring plans, and organizational scaling.
  • Translate partner requirements and opportunities into features and themes to partner with Product Management to solve.
  • Represent the B2B function in cross-functional initiatives and senior leadership discussions.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Own B2B commercial reporting and performance visibility across the full sales funnel.
  • Lead a disciplined operating cadence using standardized reviews, actionable insights, and clear accountability mechanisms to improve consistency and execution across markets.

Budget Management

  • Own and manage the B2B commercial budget in collaboration with the CCO and Finance.
  • Ensure efficient resource allocation across teams and initiatives.
  • Monitor budget adherence and return on commercial investment.

Continuous Improvement & Enablement

  • Identify and drive targeted improvements in sales processes and ways of working.
  • Promote strong CRM discipline and best practices across the B2B organization in collaboration with Sales Excellence.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or e-commerce leadership, including 5+ years leading multi-functional commercial teams (Sales, BD, Customer/Partner Success).
  • Proven track record owning and delivering revenue targets across the full B2B funnel, from lead generation through renewal.
  • Proficiency in CRM and sales automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce); strong command of pipeline management and reporting tools.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling distributed commercial teams across multiple global markets.
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate data into strategy and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Experience owning a commercial budget and P&L, with a track record of efficient resource allocation.
  • Deep understanding of online partnership ecosystems (Accommodation Partners, Travel Agents, Web Affiliates, Corporates) and emerging integration models.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. Extra languages are a plus.
  • Self-motivated, hands-on leader with a collaborative, high-accountability mindset.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth start-up environment.

Benefits

  • Vibrant and fresh work environment
  • Flexible work-from-home policy
  • The tools you need to perform your daily tasks successfully
  • L&D personal budget
  • +4 extra PTO days annually
  • The unique opportunity to join “the next big thing” at ground level

The University of Melbourne
We take pride in our people, who all contribute to our mission to benefit society through the transformative impact of education and research. Discover more via our website.

Your next career opportunity
You will support high-impact translational and health services research in palliative care across clinical and community settings.
You will expand your mixed-methods skills while contributing to better outcomes for people with advanced illness. You will work closely with leading clinicians, researchers, consumers and community partners in the Palliative Nexus group.

What you will deliver:

Your new team

The Palliative Nexus group leads translational and health services research that informs real-world care for people with advanced illness. You will work alongside clinicians, researchers and community partners who value compassion, rigorous methodology and inclusive, patient-centred outcomes, while accessing the resources and support of a leading global university.

title: Senior Federal & Workplace Design Specialist
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a design-driven, highly technical Senior Federal & Workplace Design Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will lead complex design scopes, guide design strategy, and serve as a vital technical, product, and process resource for the broader team, with a specialized focus on GSA, public sector, and government contract projects. Representing a top-tier U.S. commercial furniture dealer handling premier brands like Haworth, Steelcase, Kimball, and Teknion, you will translate intricate client requirements into highly sophisticated, compliant, and high-performance commercial and federal workplace environments.

As a seasoned professional, you will manage detailed contract-aligned documentation, navigate complex product compliance, and mentor junior designers. Partnering with sales leadership, Account Executives, and government stakeholders, you will produce innovative workspace solutions, space plans, and polished visual presentations that win business and secure high-visibility contracts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Visuals & Plans: Lead the development of detailed CET drawings, complex furniture plans, product specifications, high-quality 3D visuals, and presentation materials.
  • GSA & Code Alignment: Lead detailed space planning efforts, integrating complex systems furniture, architectural plans, site conditions, commercial codes (ADA, LEED, WELL), and specific government procurement requirements.
  • Documentation & Installation Packages: Produce and oversee detailed installation drawings and contract-aligned specification packages, ensuring absolute accuracy, constructability, and alignment with project intent.
  • Accuracy & Field Coordination: Conduct field verifications, inventories, and onsite measurements. Identify and resolve discrepancies between plans, specifications, field conditions, and installation requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner strategically with Account Executives, VP of Sales, clients, manufacturer representatives, and internal teams to shape project vision and solve complex design challenges.
  • Client Representation: Represent the design function confidently and professionally in client-facing meetings, government presentations, and complex coordination discussions.
  • Project Oversight: Provide proactive, regular updates to Design Managers, Team Leads, and Sales leadership while helping steer project direction, risks, and priorities.
  • Mentorship: Mentor Designer I and Designer II team members through drawing reviews, technical guidance, product knowledge, and process coaching.
  • Quality Control: Drive and contribute to design standards, workflow improvements, internal reporting, and quality control practices to ensure all deliverables are flawless before release.
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of product innovations, workplace ergonomics, manufacturer resources, and sustainability considerations, sharing insights across the team.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Preferred Bachelor's degree from a FIDER or CIDA-accredited design program or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive industry experience, including responsibility for complex commercial interiors, furniture dealership projects, workplace design solutions, or GSA/government contract projects.
  • Software Expertise: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (complex drawing production, specifications, and revisions) and high comfort/familiarity with CET Designer (Configura) or ProjectSpec.
  • Product & Sector Knowledge: Advanced expertise in systems furniture, ancillary solutions, finish selections, and a strong knowledge of GSA requirements and government project processes.
  • Mindset & Soft Skills: Excellent organization, judgment, communication, and problem-solving skills. Works with significant autonomy and acts as a senior technical and process resource for project teams.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge design technology.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, supportive team that values work-life balance.
  • Play a key role in design operations—your impact on company growth will be evident.
  • Join a culture that values your contributions and equips you with the tools to succeed.
  • Be part of an innovative team that continuously learns and adapts.

title: Investment & Lending Associate

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills
  • Strong communication and negotiation abilities

  • Commercial mortgage banking

  • Loan origination and capital markets
  • Debt/equity structuring

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based compensation
  • Opportunity to work on high-value commercial transactions
  • Career growth within an expanding real estate finance platform
  • High exposure to acquisitions, underwriting, and capital markets
  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial team environment

  • Lead and inspire a high-performing team of Financial Counsellors and Financial Capability Workers, providing supervision, coaching and professional development to support excellent client outcomes.
  • Oversee end-to-end service delivery, including intake, triage, allocation and client support processes, ensuring services are timely, equitable, client-centred and responsive to community needs.
  • Provide expert practice leadership on complex financial counselling, financial abuse and family violence matters, supporting safe, ethical and evidence-informed decision-making across the team.
  • Drive continuous improvement and service excellence by developing and enhancing service models, processes and quality assurance practices that strengthen program performance and client outcomes.
  • Build strong partnerships and manage program performance, ensuring services meet funding and contractual requirements while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to maximise impact.

About you

title: Founding AI Research Engineer - Robot Learning
description:
About Origin

Origin is building Physical AI for the built world - starting with autonomous robots for Interior Construction. We are building Construction Action Models which allows our modular robots to learn, adapt and work in unstructured construction job site.

Our robots are already deployed on live sites in New York City, helping accelerate schedules for large-scale commercial projects while improving safety and predictability on the job site. Backed by Tier-1 investors, Origin is working to close the gap between America’s surging demand for housing, data centers, and manufacturing infrastructure, and the construction industry’s growing labor shortage.

The Role

Our system runs a Multi Agent Action Expert architecture: classical precision algorithms orchestrated alongside learned policies. The job is systematically expanding the learned components while keeping the system production-safe. You own the full lifecycle of learned components on OG-1: from data collection and model training through edge deployment on Jetson AGX Orin. Every research project will have a deployment milestone. This is not a lab position.

What You Will Do

  • Train and deploy VLA models for contact-rich manipulation using our imitation learning infrastructure.
  • Build the data flywheel: teleoperation pipelines (GELLO, SpaceMouse, VR), DAgger-style online correction, demonstration curation.
  • Research and prototype world models for surface state prediction, spray dynamics, and anomaly detection.
  • Design offline evaluation metrics that predict real-world finishing quality before deployment.
  • Optimize models for edge: TensorRT compilation, latency profiling, memory budgeting on dual Jetson AGX Orin.
  • Design the interface where learned policies propose actions and deterministic safety layers enforce constraints.

Requirements

  • BS/MS/PhD in CS, Robotics, ML, or equivalent experience shipping learned systems on physical robots.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch; comfort modifying research codebases (you'll work directly with open-source VLA implementations).
  • Experience in at least two of: imitation learning, RL, vision-language models, robot learning from demonstration, sim-to-real.
  • Track record deploying ML on real hardware: not just training to convergence, but debugging why the policy fails on the actual robot.
  • Working knowledge of ROS2 or equivalent robotics middleware.
  • Experience working with Simulation Systems like Isaac Sim.
  • GPU profiling and optimization (TensorRT, ONNX, CUDA); you understand why 200ms policy latency kills contact control.

Strong Plus

  • Hands-on with VLA architectures (π0/π0.5, OpenVLA, RT-2, Octo) or foundation model fine-tuning for robotics.
  • Teleoperation data collection and DAgger/HG-DAgger pipelines.
  • World model architectures (DreamerV3, V-JEPA, latent dynamics models).
  • Construction, manufacturing, or contact-rich industrial domains.
  • Publications at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS: valued but equivalent shipped work counts.

title: Lead Technical Program Manager
description:
About Origin

Origin is building general-purpose autonomous robots for critical infrastructure buildout. Our priority is the buildout the US cannot afford to slow down: data centres and power plants, where rising costs, safety risks, and labour shortages hit hardest. Our modular, multi-trade platform combines purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to navigate complex environments and execute tasks with precision. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion, and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team, consisting of individuals from IITs, Stanford, UCLA, and more.

About the Role

As the Lead Technical Program Manager at Origin, you will own how the engineering team executes. This is the first dedicated program function at Origin, and you will build it from the ground up.

You will run the OKR system, own the dependencies across autonomy, hardware, and field operations, and drive the delivery cadence that turns three teams into one machine. Sitting at the centre of a Physical AI company, you will move fluently between ML engineers, mechanical and manufacturing teams, and field deployment, keeping the product rollout on schedule and the robots shipping faster.

You do not own the engineering. You own how it comes together on time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and run the company-wide OKR system, with every key result owned, tracked, and reported on a weekly cadence.
  • Own cross-team dependencies and the critical path across autonomy, hardware, and operations, so work moves without the founders brokering it.
  • Drive the autonomy program across data, model development, simulation, and QA, keeping milestones, dependencies, and handoffs on track in partnership with the autonomy leads.
  • Drive the hardware program across design, manufacturing, assembly, and validation, holding the schedule and surfacing risks in partnership with the hardware leads.
  • Own triage and closure of field issues from deployed units, accountable for time-to-resolve rather than just logging the bug.
  • Make work visible across Asana and the hardware design tracking system, so no deliverable lives only in someone's head.
  • Build the weekly delivery rhythm and reporting that lets the founders step out of day-to-day coordination.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field or MBA
  • 8+ years in technical program or engineering program management, including hardware or robotics programs.
  • Proven track record running cross-functional programs where mechanical, electrical, embedded, and autonomy all had to land together.
  • Fluency with both fast-iterating autonomy delivery and hardware realities such as long lead times, BOMs, design freezes, and manufacturing dependencies.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to build a program function from zero, not just operate one that already exists.
  • Excellent written communication and sharp judgment on what to escalate and what to absorb.
  • Ability to lead and thrive in a fast-paced start up environment.

Bonus

  • Experience in robotics, autonomous systems, or another Physical AI domain.
  • Hands-on exposure to hardware manufacturing and assembly at an early-stage company.

Why Join Us?

  • Work directly with the founders to define how a venture-backed Physical AI company runs.
  • Be part of a mission to build robots that take on the harshest, least safe work across critical infrastructure.
  • Experience the thrill of building not just a product, but a company from the ground up.

title: SPRZEDAWCA  / SPRZEDAWCZYNI JYSK KOŁBASKOWO (5600PLN) - UMOWA NA ZASTĘPSTWO
description:
Odkryj inny wymiar pracy w handlu. Dołącz do JYSK!

Szukasz pracy, w której dużo się dzieje, ludzie grają do jednej bramki, a Twoje pomysły naprawdę mają znaczenie? Lubisz działać i wspólnie osiągać cele? Chcesz się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i szybko brać na siebie kolejne wyzwania?

Świetnie - być może właśnie na Ciebie czekamy!

CO NA CIEBIE CZEKA?

  • Możliwości rozwoju i jasne ścieżki kariery. Dowiedz się więcej tutaj.
  • Wynagrodzenie i premie powiązane z efektami Twojej pracy oraz wynikami zespołu.
  • Konkursy sprzedażowe i dodatkowe akcje z atrakcyjnymi nagrodami.
  • Elastyczny grafik i zespół, który wie, że poza pracą też jest życie.
  • 20% rabatu pracowniczego na zakup produktów we wszystkich sklepach JYSK i spółkach Lars Larsen Group - również na produkty objęte promocją.
  • Atrakcyjne benefity, m.in.: prywatna opieka medyczna, finansowe świadczenia świąteczne, karta Multisport, wspólne integracje i wydarzenia.
  • Stabilne miejsce pracy, w firmie o skandynawskiej kulturze organizacyjnej, opartej na współpracy i wzajemnym szacunku.
  • Nagrody jubileuszowe - doceniamy osoby, które rozwijają się razem z nami.

CZYM BEDZIESZ SIĘ ZAJMOWAĆ?

  • Obsługa klientów z wykorzystaniem wiedzy o produktach.
  • Wspólna realizacją celów sprzedażowych i budowanie wyników wraz z zespołem.
  • Dbanie o spójny, atrakcyjny wyglądu sklepu.
  • Praca operacyjna z zespołem - dostawy, towarowanie, organizacja sklepu.

SZUKAMY OSÓB, KTÓRE:

  • są zorientowane na sprzedaż, realizację wyników oraz wysoką jakość obsługi klienta,
  • budują pozytywne relacje, są otwarte na współpracę i dobrze odnajdują się w pracy z ludźmi,
  • potrafią wspierać i rozwijać zespół poprzez komunikację, feedback i codzienne zaangażowanie,
  • wykazują inicjatywę i energię do działania,
  • dobrze odnajdują się środowisku, w którym dużo się dzieje i jest wiele wyzwań,
  • mają gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach otwarcia sklepu, w tym w soboty oraz niedziele handlowe,
  • cenią różnorodność, elastyczność w wykonywanych zadaniach.

Poznaj jednego z naszych Sprzedawców i dowiedz się, jakim pracodawcą jesteśmy tutaj.

UWAŻASZ, ŻE TO PRACA WŁAŚNIE DLA CIEBIE? Aplikuj już dziś!

O NAS

W JYSK ludzie są w centrum wszystkiego, co robimy. To ich energia, zaangażowanie i współpraca napędzają nasz rozwój. Dlatego tworzymy środowisko, w którym można się rozwijać, zdobywać nowe doświadczenia i budować swoją ścieżkę kariery krok po kroku, w swoim tempie.
Nasza historia sięga 1979 roku, kiedy Lars Larsen otworzył pierwszy sklep w Danii. Od tego czasu rozwinęliśmy się w międzynarodową sieć obecna w wielu krajach, w tym w Polsce, gdzie mamy już ponad 340 sklepów oraz nowoczesne centrum dystrybucji, które wspiera sprawne funkcjonowanie całej sieci. Rozwijamy zarówno sprzedaż stacjonarną, jak i kanały online, pozostając blisko klientów i ich codziennych potrzeb.
Naszą kulturę definiują trzy wartości: Kupiec, Kolega i Duch Firmy. Przekładają się one na codzienną pracę: odpowiedzialność za wyniki, współpracę w zespole oraz zaangażowanie.
W JYSK stawiamy na środowisko oparte na zaufaniu, szacunku i rozwoju. Wspieramy się nawzajem i dajemy przestrzeń do nauki, niezależnie od miejsca startu.
Jesteśmy organizacją otwartą na różnorodność. Cenimy ludzi bez względu na wiek, tożsamość płciową, orientację seksualną, sprawność, pochodzenie, doświadczenie czy sposób myślenia. Wierzymy, że różne perspektywy, talenty i doświadczenia wzmacniają nasze zespoły i pozwalają nam działać lepiej każdego dnia.

Chcesz uzyskać więcej informacji, odwiedź naszą stronę kariera JYSK.

Dowiedz się, w jaki sposób przetwarzamy Twoje dane osobowe w naszej Polityce Prywatności.

title: Custom Manufacturing Project Manager
description:
AXIOM

Axiom Custom Products is a 30 year old privately-owned, full-service creative manufacturing team that designs and builds architectural environments, retail activations and experiences, art installations, and more.

With a 75,000 sf shop in NE, Axiom creates projects of which you will want to be a part! We make the impossible possible through our vast, unmatched capabilities: exceptional client services, fearlessly creative design, innovative problem-solving, unparalleled in-house services (building, CNC, metal fabrication, technology, paint and powder coating, custom crating), detailed installation, and tight deadlines. With our client’s expressive custom statements brought to life, the rest is history.

THE PRE-REQ

You have years of fabrication experience; you've built things with your own two hands, lots of things. You've made the leap from building things to managing the builders of things OR you want to, and you have the confidence and drive to succeed as Project Manager.

This particular Project Management role isn't suited for folks with experience only in design, event management, general project management or building as a hobby. This isn’t an IT or finance PM role either.

You have to have worn a tool belt/had a tool box at a job and understand how things are built. You've personally worked with a variety of materials (metal, plastic, wood, glass, laminate), adhesives, and finishes.

**Please note, hands-on metal fabrication/carpentry/woodworking/cabinet making experience is a non-negotiable requirement of the role, we won’t be considering folks who do not have this experience.

THE ROLE

We assure quality custom products with efficiency and dedication. And we deliver. At the helm of delivery is the Project Manager. Our Project Managers navigate and execute temporary and permanent installations working with their the Sales team, Account Managers, other Project Managers, Design Engineers, CNC Programmers, Fabricators, and Management.

Project Managers work through design, estimating, planning, development, production, and installation phases of the project life cycle. They have a direct connection to the profitability of Axiom and the reason they are successful is that they understand how things are built. But, it's not that simple, that's the foundation they bring. Then, they come to Axiom learn the process of project management and production at Axiom, inside and out, and execute it. In tandem with the sales and accounts teams, they develop new relationships and maintain on-going relationships with clients, agencies, designers, general contractors, architects and artists.

YOU

Our Project Managers help keep the team running at full speed. You will be joining a team of like-minded folks managing production of experiences and brand touch-points that are simply put, awesome. You have a passion for unlocking the potential of the greater team by removing roadblocks and creating a clear path to getting things done through an obsession with planning, process, and transforming complex requests into actionable to do's.

You are comfortable and confident in managing what you know how to build and you enjoy being an integral part of a team. You are highly motivated, organized, a collaborator. You are committed to project excellence and have an outstanding attention to detail -- you love the craft.

You have exemplary communication skills. You thrive when working in an active environment against tight deadlines, managing budgets and workflow. Drawings, the computer, email and spreadsheets are familiar tools; software we use includes in-house ERP, Slack, and SmartSheets. You welcome the challenge to manage multiple projects, clients, and resources at a time. You are able to quickly learn about our what you are unfamiliar with in our industry, including retail environments, millwork/casework, tradeshow booths, and custom crating. You will check in with clients, visit the project site, etc.; frequent local travel requires a current local driver's license and a clean driving record.

THE RETURN

Our way of life promotes hard work, but health and family always come first. We ask employees to give us their all, and in turn, we help them live a rewarding life with the balance they need to enjoy their career at Axiom. We offer an opportunity for growth, an excellent salary, paid holidays, 401k and Roth investment options, and medical, dental, vision benefits (with dependent coverage options). Best yet, in year two you accrue 4 weeks of PTO!

Important note: there are dogs in the office.

NEXT STEPS

See our full capabilities at www.axiomcustom.com and check out the breadth of projects we tackle at www.instagram.com/axiomcustom.

The salary range is $70k to $90k.

Side note: the office is dog friendly.

title: Consulting Neurologist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Consulting Neurologist based in Canada.

This is a fully remote contract opportunity for a neurologist contributing clinical expertise to global research studies focused on brain health.
The role centers on supporting a clinical study involving Myasthenia Gravis through expert clinical assessment and standardized scale administration.
Consultants receive comprehensive training on operational policies, study-specific procedures, clinical interviewing, and virtual cognitive assessments before beginning study work.
You will apply your clinical and assessment expertise within a structured research environment with ongoing supervision and skill recalibration.
The position offers flexibility, with work assigned on an as-needed basis according to your availability and study requirements.
Your expertise will contribute to the reliable measurement of neurological and cognitive outcomes in clinical research.
This is an opportunity to work remotely while supporting research that aims to improve the assessment and understanding of neurological conditions.

Accountabilities:

  • Clinical Study Support: Provide clinical expertise and support for research activities associated with a Myasthenia Gravis study, applying relevant neurological knowledge and assessment experience.
  • Rater Training: Complete comprehensive training covering operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing techniques, and virtual cognitive assessment methods before performing remote scale administrations.
  • Clinical Assessment: Apply appropriate clinical interviewing and cognitive, behavioral, or functional assessment techniques in accordance with study requirements and established procedures.
  • Scale Administration: Perform remote administration of relevant clinical and functional rating scales accurately and consistently, following study-specific protocols and training.
  • Ongoing Calibration: Participate in regular supervision and ongoing recalibration activities to maintain consistency, quality, and appropriate clinical skill throughout study participation.
  • Quality and Reliability: Meet deadlines and maintain a highly organized, methodical approach to ensure accurate and timely delivery of assigned research activities.

    • Requirements

    • Clinical Qualification: Neurologist with an MD, DO, MBBS, NP/APRN, PA, RN, or PhD/PsyD in Psychology, Neuroscience, Nursing, or a related health science discipline, or an equivalent international qualification.
    • Clinical Interviewing and Assessment: Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, supported by practical experience applying these skills in clinical, academic, or research environments.
    • Relevant Experience: At least 2 years of direct clinical interviewing and psychological or related assessment experience within clinical research, academic, or clinical settings.
    • Neurological Populations: Direct experience conducting cognitive, behavioral, or functional assessments with neurological or psychiatric populations.
    • Myasthenia Gravis Expertise: Experience working with or assessing individuals with Myasthenia Gravis is required.
    • Research and Scale Experience: Experience administering relevant clinical or cognitive rating scales is valuable, particularly scales used to assess neurological, functional, cognitive, or behavioral outcomes.
    • Organization and Reliability: Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines, follow structured procedures, and maintain close attention to detail.
    • Technology Skills: Comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Word and Excel, email, video conferencing platforms such as Zoom or similar tools, and cloud-based storage services.
    • Language Skills: Fluent English, Japanese, or Mandarin is required for the study, depending on the assigned opportunity.

      • Benefits

      • Fully Remote: Work remotely from Canada without a requirement for on-site participation.
      • Flexible Engagement: Contract position with work assigned on an as-needed basis according to your availability and study requirements.
      • Comprehensive Training: Fully compensated training covering operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing, and virtual cognitive assessment.
      • Ongoing Support: Regular supervision and continued clinical skill recalibration throughout study participation.
      • Research Impact: Opportunity to contribute specialized clinical expertise to global research initiatives focused on neurological conditions and brain health.
      • Professional Exposure: Gain experience working within structured clinical research programs and applying standardized assessment methodologies in a virtual environment.
