title: Planner - Electrical
description:
BlueScope is an Australian-born global success story spanning 15 countries. Our team of over 16,500 people is our strength and we want our people to be safe, successful and well. We’re leaders and innovators in transforming steel into smart products and solutions that support society, today and in the future. We’re proud of brands, like COLORBOND ® steel that inspire and protect everything from hospitals to bridges and stadiums.

The Opportunity

Come and discover the opportunity to join our Maintenance team at our Western Port Manufacturing facility as an Electrical Maintenance Planner. As a part of the broader Australian Steel Products Portfolio, we have five major manufacturing sites at Western Port which operate 24 x 7 and deliver a variety of products, innovative solutions and services to export and domestic customers.

In this key role, you will utilise your comprehensive electrical knowledge to coordinate and plan maintenance activities and improvement initiatives for our manufacturing operations including inspections and monitoring methods, detailed planning of work and participating in work scheduling and execution.

If you are a highly skilled Electrical Tradesperson, looking to expand your skill set and join the heavy industrial sector, this is an excellent opportunity for you to continue developing your career with an iconic, global organisaiton.

What’s in it for you?

  • permanent full time position working Monday to Friday dayshift
  • enjoy a competitive salary package, overtime eligible, option for 14% superannuation, participation in our company incentive program and annual salary review
  • on-going training, development and learning providing career pathways
  • access to numerous wellbeing initiatives including an Employee Assistance Program
  • access to discounted gym fees through the ‘Fitness Passport’
  • canteen on-site – food made fresh daily
  • free on-site parking
  • no need to purchase workwear – you’ll be provided with a uniform and personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • enjoy a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture that hosts regular celebrations and BBQ’s
  • access to a range of exciting discounts across travel, vehicles, health and more!

What you will do?

Deliver ongoing technical guidance and support to the plant maintenance teams and the wider asset management teams across the business, you’ll be responsible for the establishment and continual improvement of our maintenance plan. You will be:

  • scheduling maintenance work and performing detailed planning of work
  • develop, implement, and manage detailed shutdown maintenance plans and schedules
  • coordinate resources, labour, and materials for shutdown maintenance projects.
  • liaise with contractors and suppliers to attain cost effective methods of execution and delivery of planned work
  • coordinate task dependencies and ensure seamless integration of maintenance activities with other shutdown operations.
  • capture and review of maintenance history to drive maintenance strategy improvement
  • analyse prior maintenance work orders to ensure follow up work is captured and actioned
  • support alignment of Safety, Quality and Plant Critical priorities with key stakeholders
  • providing supervision to internal and external resources
  • manage and control maintenance spares utilisation, refurbishment and/or replenishment
  • perform administrative activities such as raising purchase orders, invoice management and cost review

More about you

You’ll bring your technical skills and experience in maintenance of equipment in continuous production facilities. You’ll also bring:

  • a electrical trade qualification is preferred, Electrical Engineering qualifications with practical experience will also be considered.
  • demonstrated experience in planning and scheduling inspections and maintenance of site equipment
  • solid experience of SAP including MS Office suite
  • experience in determining root cause through investigation processes and tools to recommend informed corrective measures
  • highly developed communication and influencing skills - building constructive and effective relationships
  • a commitment to the safety and wellbeing of yourself and others

Why BlueScope

As we’re creating strength for the future through our people, products and solutions, BlueScope supports you to build your expertise within a safe and positive team environment. At BlueScope, you’ll:​

  • Learn and develop as you grow. Work alongside specialists and keep your skills and knowledge at the forefront of industry with our lifelong learning culture.​
  • Experience connection and care. Experience a positive, inclusive work environment where we look out for each other’s safety and wellbeing.​
  • Build innovative products. Seek better, smarter ways to work, help develop sustainable solutions and make things happen.​
  • Deliver work that matters. Every action you take matters in delivering for our customers and strengthening communities for the future. We value what you do.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and valued to be their authentic selves, and we encourage Women and First Nations people to apply. We’re passionate about driving sustainability outcomes that matter to our communities, including action on climate and our 2050 net zero goal.​ At BlueScope, we offer work-life flexibility through our B-flex program.

Join us, creating strength for the future.

title: Kaipūhanga Raraunga Mātāmua Senior Data Engineer
description:
Z has a clear purpose: Powering better journeys, today and tomorrow. As one of New Zealand’s largest transport energy companies, we have a commitment to delivering safe, secure, and reliable transport energy – with the opportunity to deliver new journeys, with new energy solutions in a changing world.

We are proud to be the Kiwi contingent in the Ampol Group, an independent Trans-Tasman energy company, with trading offices across the globe, which are united behind our shared purpose. While many of the challenges and opportunities we face go beyond national boundaries, together we have the scale, influence, and capability to deliver for our customers, communities, and our people.

Tech, Digital & Data @ Ampol

As we embark on our digital transformation, we are committed to making Ampol easier to work with and within, enhancing every interaction through innovative solutions.

Our approach is anchored in data-driven decision-making and advanced technology integration, allowing us to create seamless and personalised customer experiences that truly resonate. By prioritizing value-based decisions and outcomes, we ensure that our digital transformation will drive meaningful impact and measurable outcomes.

We are dedicated to empowering our business through technology-enabled differentiation, strengthening our foundations to build sustainable value for the future. Our team thrives on the challenge of innovation—dreaming up big ideas, questioning the norm, and tackling complex problems. Together, we are shaping a future that not only meets the needs of today but anticipates the demands of tomorrow.

Join us as we embrace this journey of transformation, committed to delivering exceptional value and experiences that make a lasting impact on our business, customers and industry.

About the role:

As a Kaipūhanga Raraunga Mātāmua Senior Data Engineer, you'll bring a rare blend of data engineering, data architecture and data modelling expertise to the team. You'll partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams and Group Data functions to understand customer and marketing challenges, translate them into clear data solutions, and provide technical leadership across the delivery lifecycle.

This is more than a hands-on engineering role. You'll help shape data architecture decisions, influence engineering standards, mentor team members and guide the evolution of our customer data platforms as we continue to mature our loyalty and CRM capabilities across both Australia and New Zealand.

Working across technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, Azure and Terraform, you'll help deliver scalable, secure and observable data products while contributing to the future direction of our customer data ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and optimise modern data pipelines, data products and customer data solutions using Databricks, Snowflake and Azure technologies.
  • Support data architecture and high-level solution design activities in partnership with Group Data Architecture teams.
  • Develop scalable data models that support customer, loyalty, CRM and MarTech initiatives across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define problem statements and translate requirements into actionable data solutions.
  • Deliver production-grade data platforms with strong focus on quality, performance, governance, security and reliability.
  • Implement observability practices including monitoring, lineage, logging, tracing and automated data quality controls.
  • Contribute to technical direction, engineering standards and architectural decision-making across the team.
  • Mentor Data Engineers and actively support capability uplift through coaching, reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Champion modern engineering practices including Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and automation.
  • Collaborate across product, engineering and data teams to deliver high-value customer outcomes.

What you’ll bring:

We're looking for a senior data professional who can think beyond pipelines and platforms. Someone who can partner with the business to understand customer and loyalty challenges, define the right data approach, and provide the architectural guidance that enables teams to deliver with confidence.

  • Significant experience delivering modern data engineering solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong expertise across both Databricks and Snowflake, with the ability to evaluate and work across multiple data platform technologies.
  • Deep capability in data modelling and data engineering, with the confidence to operate across all three disciplines.
  • Strong grasp of data architecture principles
  • Advanced SQL and Python skills, coupled with experience building scalable and reliable data pipelines.
  • Experience working with Azure data services, including Data Factory, Data Lake and cloud-native data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, observability and operational excellence principles.
  • Ability to influence technical direction and collaborate effectively with architects, engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and helping uplift engineering capability within a team environment.
  • A customer-first mindset, with the ability to connect business problems to practical and scalable data solutions.

And of course, you’ll be passionate about what matters to Z, embracing and living our values to help us deliver on our aspirations and broader commitment to Aotearoa New Zealand.

The base salary range for this role is $117,000.00 to $155,500.00 per annum, plus 15% STI based on company performance, a 5% KiwiSaver employer contribution and health insurance through Southern Cross.

Why Z?

title: Youth Career Navigator
description:
Job Title: Youth Career Navigator

Reports to: Program Manager

Office Location: Center of Grace - Olathe, Kansas

Non-exempt: _X_

Primary Objectives of Position: Under the general supervision of the Program Manager, the Youth Career Navigator is responsible for delivering career counseling, job placement, and case management services to Young Adult (Youth) job seekers eligible for the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) services.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Perform outreach and recruitment in the local community to publicize program opportunities and eligibility guidelines, referral options and access points, and application procedures.
  • Conduct or facilitate pre-employment/work-readiness workshops to individual participants, and/or in group or classroom settings.
  • Collect documentation from applicants (and/or family members as required) sufficient to determine eligibility for services, consistent with applicable Federal, State, and Local requirements, guidelines and policies.
  • Assist participants with career exploration and career planning, job readiness activities, and in accessing educational, employment and training opportunities linked to career pathways that chart a course toward economic self-sufficiency.
  • Build, manage and support a caseload of eligible Youth, and facilitate their placement and participation in work-based learning and other training activities.
  • Provide job placement and retention services.
  • Provide services in various settings, to include within the Workforce Center environment, or at partner sites/locations and other agencies throughout the community.
  • Understand other programs and funding sources available to customers so that use of resources is maximized and perform dual- or co-enrollments into other appropriate workforce programs where permissible and appropriate.
  • Possess or develop a working knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and local policies that relate to program eligibility, services, and performance expectations/outcomes.
  • Conduct an Objective Assessment (OA) of customer needs and goals, and develop an Individual Service Strategy (ISS) that identifies an employment barriers and an action plan to meet those needs and barriers.
  • Periodically review and modify the ISS to ensure ongoing, successful progress toward stated goals and desired outcomes.
  • Adhere to the Company's quality management system and protocols to ensure customer satisfaction, and program integrity and performance.
  • Possess a basic working knowledge of other One-Stop programs such as those available to Adults/Dislocated Workers, and available through the Wagner-Peyser/Job Service program.
  • Perform routine, timely and accurate data entry of narrative information and required data elements into the KansasWorks MIS database to ensure the full and proper tracking of all enrollments, and activities and services provided, and to document customer interactions and progress through various program components.
  • Other duties as assigned to meet program and company objectives.

Preferred Qualifications:

Education: Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in a Social Service or Human Resource field, or equivalent work experience.

Experience: Background in the field of Workforce and Career Development is beneficial. Experience in a field related to Workforce Development, Technical Education or Career Counseling is preferred.

Skills/Abilities: Excellent interpersonal skills and customer service orientation; strong working knowledge of personal computers and software; ability to perform accurate and timely data entry, such as 'case-notes,' and to keep detailed records of services provided to customers. Bi-lingual, Spanish and English extremely beneficial.

Other: Ability to learn and apply Federal, State and Local policies as they relate to a particular program area; knowledge of local community resources preferred. Must have valid driver's license and adequate vehicle insurance coverage.

description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Social Storyteller
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Storyteller based in Brazil.

This role is designed for a highly observant content creator who can turn everyday experiences into compelling digital stories.
You will work closely with a senior business leader, following meetings, events, trips, conversations, and behind-the-scenes moments to identify valuable narratives.
The position combines storytelling, audiovisual production, copywriting, interviewing, editing, and social media expertise.
You will be responsible for the complete content journey, from identifying an idea and capturing the moment to editing, publishing, and analyzing performance.
The role requires strong editorial judgment, including knowing when to record, what to publish, and when discretion is essential.
The environment is dynamic and fast-paced, with frequent travel, short turnaround times, and the need to work independently with professional equipment.
This is an opportunity to shape an authentic personal brand and transform real experiences, knowledge, and perspectives into content that creates connection and influence.

Accountabilities:

  • Follow and document the daily routine: Accompany the executive across meetings, events, lectures, business visits, trips, and other commitments, identifying and capturing moments with strong content potential.
  • Identify and build stories: Observe conversations, experiences, ideas, and everyday situations and transform them into authentic, relevant narratives without relying solely on predefined content briefs.
  • Produce audiovisual content: Capture high-quality video, photography, and audio using smartphones, professional or semi-professional cameras, and other equipment appropriate to each situation and platform.
  • Develop storytelling and scripts: Create content ideas, scripts, questions, hooks, titles, captions, and narrative structures that make real experiences and insights engaging and easy to understand.
  • Edit and publish content: Independently edit and finalize audiovisual materials, adapting language, pacing, and formats for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and other relevant digital channels.
  • Conduct interviews and extract insights: Lead conversations and ask thoughtful questions that uncover stories, perspectives, experiences, and knowledge that can be transformed into valuable content.
  • Create content in real time: Work quickly when events, trips, or relevant developments require content to be captured, edited, and published within short deadlines.
  • Research trends and references: Monitor trends, formats, discussions, and references related to business, management, technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, and the future to identify new storytelling opportunities.
  • Manage the content archive: Organize videos, photographs, interviews, recordings, stories, and other materials into a structured and reusable audiovisual library.
  • Analyze content performance: Monitor metrics such as retention, reach, shares, saves, and interactions and use these insights to continuously improve themes, formats, and narratives.
  • Collaborate with communication teams: Work closely with marketing and communication stakeholders when content opportunities connect with institutional initiatives, positioning, or the executive's professional journey.
  • Protect confidentiality and reputation: Exercise sound editorial judgment and discretion when handling personal, business, and strategic information, carefully assessing what should be recorded, published, or kept private.
  • Support travel-based coverage: Accompany frequent domestic and international trips, ensuring content can be captured, edited, and published even when working away from the usual base and under tight deadlines.

    • Requirements

    • Content production experience: Proven experience creating and producing content for social media, with hands-on experience in video capture and editing.
    • Storytelling expertise: Strong understanding of storytelling, narrative construction, and the ability to transform real experiences into engaging digital content.
    • Writing skills: Ability to develop scripts, hooks, captions, titles, and written content adapted to different digital formats and audiences.
    • Audiovisual skills: Practical knowledge of video production using smartphones and professional or semi-professional cameras, including framing, lighting, and audio capture.
    • Platform knowledge: Familiarity with the languages, formats, and content dynamics of Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.
    • Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to conduct conversations, ask insightful questions, and uncover strong stories.
    • Creative and proactive mindset: Strong observational skills, curiosity, creativity, initiative, and autonomy to identify opportunities and propose new content ideas.
    • Agility and adaptability: Ability to operate effectively in dynamic environments and rapidly transform events and experiences into publishable content.
    • Organization: Strong ability to manage files, equipment, content ideas, schedules, and multiple demands simultaneously.
    • Discretion: High level of responsibility when handling personal, business, and strategic information, with strong judgment regarding confidentiality.
    • Stakeholder interaction: Comfort working closely with entrepreneurs, executives, and diverse audiences in professional and public-facing environments.
    • Portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating content creation, audiovisual production, editing, and narrative development capabilities.
    • Travel availability: Genuine availability for frequent travel within Brazil and internationally, including weekends and trips arranged with limited advance notice.
    • Education: Higher education completed or in progress in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Journalism, Audiovisual Production, Cinema, Design, or a related field is considered a plus.
    • Additional skills: Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or equivalent editing tools; photography and image treatment; personal branding; content production for executives, entrepreneurs, creators, specialists, or public figures; event and travel coverage; content performance analysis; and AI tools applied to content creation are all considered valuable differentiators.

      • Benefits

      • Meal support: Choice between meal or food allowance.
      • Transportation: Transportation assistance.
      • Remote work support: Home-office allowance where applicable.
      • Education support: Postgraduate assistance and partnerships with universities, including exclusive discounts.
      • Learning and development: Financial support for external courses and language programs, plus access to Alura and Voors learning platforms.
      • Career development: Structured feedback, Individual Development Plans, mentoring with specialists, and technical and behavioral development events.
      • Healthcare: Health insurance with coparticipation, dental insurance, and access to psychotherapy services.
      • Financial protection: Life insurance.
      • Wellbeing: Support and incentives for sports and physical activities.
      • Recognition: Employee referral rewards for recommending new talent.
      • Exclusive discounts: Partnerships with a range of establishments offering additional advantages and discounts.
      • Birthday benefit: A day off on your birthday.

title: Student Activities Assistant & Ultimate Frisbee Coach
description:
About North Park

Founded in 1891, North Park University is a Christian university affiliated with the Evangelical Covenant Church of over 3,200 students from around the country and the world.

North Park University is located in the Albany Park neighborhood of Chicago, one of the most ethnically diverse zip codes in the United States. It is nine miles from downtown Chicago. The North Park campus has often been referred to as an oasis in the heart of the city – a place where students from urban, rural, and suburban backgrounds alike can call home. And all of this within the major metropolitan backdrop of Chicago: one of the world’s largest and most diversified economies, renowned for its museums and music, and voted best large city in the U.S. for four years in a row by Condé Nast Traveler.

Mission

The mission of North Park University is to prepare students for lives of significance and service through education in the liberal arts, professional studies, and theology.

Vision

Building on our core institutional identity—Christian, city-centered, intercultural—our vision is to create a university of uncommon character and enduring excellence, where faith, learning, and service meet.

Position Summary

North Park University Office of Student Activities is seeking to hire a part-time Student Activities Assistant and Ultimate Frisbee Coach. This position begins August 2026-May 2027. Reporting directly to the Director of Intercultural Student Affairs, the position will be responsible for working to create spaces of belonging and student success for North Park University students. The position will also serve as the captain to both the Allihopa (women) and Lost Boys (men) Ultimate frisbee teams.

  • Responsibilities
    Assists in the planning and execution of major departmental programs, including the Voyage Student Involvement Fair, Homecoming, and signature programs hosted by the Office of Student Activities and the Office of Intercultural Student Affairs.
  • Serve as a support staff during events, providing assistance to new students, families and guests.
  • Plan local events in the City of Chicago for North Park University students that expose them to the arts, concerts, culture, entertainment, sporting events, and educational offerings.
  • Process reimbursements requests and approve program purchasing requests.
  • Design and support co-curricular education initiatives centered on culture, identity, and diversity to promote student success and belonging.
  • Communicate with all North Park staff and faculty whose services are needed, including but not limited to, the Offices of Housing and Residence Life, Alumni Relations, Physical Plant, Media Services and North Park Dining.
  • Promote events and opportunities for connection and development to commuter students using various communication channels and strategies.
  • Provide programming and support to the commuter council for commuter student week, meetings, and special initiatives.

Ultimate Frisbee Coach

  • Collaborate with team captains to create practice plans, team development strategies; running and controlling team drills; in-game strategy, and increase individual and team skills.
  • Assist the team captains in campus player recruitment and selection process.
  • Work with the captains to coordinate Fall tournament schedule and Spring tournament schedule.
  • Travel with the frisbee teams to tournaments and events by vehicle.
  • Other duties as assigned by Director of Intercultural Student Affairs, Office of Student Activities staff, and the Division of Student Engagement staff.

Salary: $10,000 per year

Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Coaching or playing experience and extensive knowledge of the frisbee sport.
  • Experience and enthusiasm for student activities, programming, leadership development, social media, and marketing.
  • Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Have good attention to detail and excellent organizational and planning skills.
  • Ability to travel on weekends and work evenings for team practices and events.
  • A valid driver’s license is required and the ability to operate a North Park University vehicle.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Suite: Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, etc.
  • Possess a clear understanding and personal commitment to North Park University’s mission of Christian higher education.

Desired

  • Acceptance in a North Park University graduate program.
  • Demonstrate understanding of the foundational purpose of student development theory and cultural programming.
  • CPR Training or ability to obtain certification.
  • Comfortable with using student engagement technology.

title: Enhanced Access Remote GP (Bank)
description:
About Us:
Ortus Health provides high-quality, remote clinical services to GP practices across the UK. Our mission is to support general practice by improving access, reducing pressure on clinicians, and delivering safe, efficient patient care through innovation and teamwork.

We are seeking experienced and well-organised GPs to join our remote team. This role is specifically to cover our Enhanced Access service, providing telephone appointments for a PCN. As a Remote GP with Ortus Health, you will make clinical decisions that directly influence patient outcomes. You’ll be part of a dynamic, supportive team, working remotely but closely connected to the practices we serve.

You will be responsible for dealing with patients across one or more GP practices.

This is a remote role with flexible working arrangements. Sessions can be tailored around your existing portfolio career or other commitments.

We are looking to move quickly with the hiring for this role.

The Role:

  • Complete telephone appointments for Enhanced Access 6.30pm-8.00pm. Consultations MUST be started after 6.30pm to be compliant with EA rules.

  • Appointments are up to 15 mins long.
  • Can sign up for 2 months to trial if this is the right fit, ahead of a potential ongoing role for EA or any of the other roles we are hiring for.
  • Issue prescriptions, fit notes, referrals, and offer safety-netting advice
  • Escalate complex or high-risk cases appropriately
  • File pathology results (normal and abnormal) and complete tasks from clinical letters
  • Adapt to different clinical systems (e.g. SystmOne, Accurx) and local processes
  • Accurately document consultations in line with GMC and practice standards

Requirements

Requirements:

  • To be able to start within 2-3 weeks.
  • Full GMC registration with a license to practise
  • NHS England GP Performers List inclusion
  • At least 2 year post-CCT (preferred but not essential)
  • Experience with remote consultations (preferred but not essential)
  • Ability to manage clinical risk safely in a remote environment
  • Familiarity with SystmOne

Benefits

What We Offer:

  • Pay £11-13 per appointment dependent on experience
  • Pay into a limited company if preferred
  • Laptop provided
  • An opportunity to gain experience in a unique, remote setting.

title: Business & Technology Integration - Business Analyst Sênior
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business & Technology Integration - Business Analyst Sênior based in Brazil.

Join a dynamic Agile innovation environment focused on connecting business needs with impactful SAP solutions.
You will contribute to a long-term international project, working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams.
The role offers significant autonomy, from requirements discovery and process analysis through solution design, configuration, testing, and delivery.
You will help identify opportunities for process improvement while applying SAP best practices and a Standard First approach.
Your expertise will directly support high-quality implementations, incident resolution, and enhanced user experiences.
You will work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment alongside technology specialists, consultants, and business professionals.
This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on SAP professional looking to grow while contributing to complex international initiatives.

Accountabilities:

  • Independently lead the identification, analysis, management, and follow-up of business and technical requirements.
  • Understand business processes and work closely with users and stakeholders to identify needs and translate them into effective SAP solutions.
  • Design solutions aligned with SAP best practices, prioritizing a Standard First approach.
  • Evaluate new SAP functionalities and solutions and identify opportunities for process and user-experience improvements.
  • Estimate effort and timelines and develop structured work plans for assigned initiatives.
  • Configure SAP solutions, conduct testing, and document deliverables and supporting evidence.
  • Identify and analyze gaps between business requirements and standard SAP functionality, preparing appropriate justifications and specifications when required.
  • Develop functional and technical specifications and coordinate with development teams throughout solution implementation.
  • Investigate and resolve incidents and problems, including SAP Notes research and communication with SAP support when necessary.
  • Maintain close relationships with business areas to ensure alignment, validation, and approval of delivered solutions.
  • Prepare and execute test plans and test cases, including unit and integration testing.
  • Ensure the quality, traceability, and documentation of all deliverables.
  • Identify opportunities to improve user experience through SAP solutions, including SAP BTP.
  • Apply Agile methodologies and structured maintenance and support practices throughout the project lifecycle.

    • Requirements:

    • Solid professional experience in one of the following SAP specialties: SAP SD with FSCM – Credit Management, SAP TM, or SAP TD.
    • Proven experience gathering, analyzing, and managing business requirements.
    • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and manage initiatives end-to-end.
    • Strong understanding of SAP best practices and solution design principles.
    • Hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager.
    • Knowledge and practical experience with Agile methodologies.

title: Facilities Operation Engineer
description:
OUR STORY


At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.


When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 122 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 49,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.


Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.

Job Title

Facilities Operation Engineer

Department

Facilities O&M / Maintenance

Job Purpose

The Facilities Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the site’s facilities utilities. The role also provides support for the coordination and maintenance activities related to facilities system as well as management of contractors, to ensure operational stability, equipment reliability, and compliance with company requirements.

Key Responsibilities

General Facilities Operation:

  • Manage comprehensive facilities operations, providing direct oversight and guidance to technical staff/technicians/chargeman
  • Oversee day-to-day operation checklists, utilities consumption, trending and providing comprehensive reports and improvement
  • Establish operational procedures, OPL, work instructions and enforce LOP/SOP/POR compliance in Facilities Department.
  • Manage facilities operational budget and purchase related operation system rectification and stock balance.
  • Manage Operational work records, competency monitoring & regulatory requirement check, Online Gas Monitoring, stock balance, and other online monitoring system related to facilities operation.
  • Involve in all Facilities related meetings, discussion, visits, audits, central team

Electrical Systems

  • Manage and maintain 132 kV and 11 kV substations with the supervision of competent person
  • Oversee operation and provide support for maintenance of electrical rooms, Main Switchboards (MSB), and breakers, including GIS, ACB, VCB, gensets, and all related electrical systems
  • Support on troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, and restoration of electrical systems
  • Use FMCS for monitoring, alarm review, and troubleshooting support
  • Perform trend analysis and plotting to identify abnormalities and prevent failures
  • Prepare accurate Operation reports, records, and technical documentation

Mechanical System (HVAC, Cold room, Vacuum, Scrubber, Exhaust, and Cleanroom)

  • Oversee operation of HVAC systems, Cold Room, Vacuum, Scrubber, exhaust and cleanroom facilities and provide support on the maintenance activities
  • Coordinate with the engineer responsible for these systems to ensure all activities are properly controlled, monitored, and completed
  • Support maintenance activities related to cleanroom management, including HEPA filter integrity testing, calibration, and related works
  • Ensure system reliability, compliance, and continuity of operation
  • Oversee operation of Water, Wastewater & Gas System and provide support on the maintenance activities
  • Management of contract workers, contractors and vendors related to the system.
  • Coordinate with the engineer responsible for these systems to ensure all activities are properly controlled, monitored, and completed
  • Ensure system reliability, compliance, and continuity of operation

Water, Wastewater & Gas System (DIW, Wastewater, Recovery, SIVL, GN2, H2, Forming Gas, Cylinder Gas Management )

Projects, Improvements, and Support

  • Identify and implement improvement initiatives to enhance reliability, safety, and performance
  • Support hook-up work inside production areas
  • Support on the management of vendors and contractors to ensure work quality, schedule adherence, and compliance with company requirements
  • Coordinate closely with production, maintenance, engineering, EHS, and external service providers

Safety and Compliance

  • Ensure all activities are performed in accordance with company procedures, safety requirements, and applicable standards
  • Support safe work practices, risk control, and equipment reliability at all times

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Chemical) or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Facilities operation
  • Familiarity with FMCS, CMMS, troubleshooting, and trend monitoring
  • Strong knowledge of documentation, reporting, and maintenance record keeping
  • Experience in managing vendors and contractors
  • Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills

Key Competencies

  • Technical leadership
  • Facilities and utility systems knowledge
  • Vendor management
  • Documentation and reporting
  • Problem-solving and decision-making
  • Cross-functional coordination
  • Environmental, Safety & health awareness

ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised role: all successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
# Member of Technical Staff

## Company Overview

This is a pioneering company that supports teams in the fearless deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI). We are dedicated to advancing AI through rigorous, long-horizon simulation and programmatic verification, believing that true progress stems from innovative methodologies rather than merely scaling models.

## Job Summary

We are seeking a **Member of Technical Staff** to spearhead the architecture and hands-on development of our AI-native, agentic platform. In this senior individual contributor (IC) and tech-lead role, you will have ownership of critical systems from design through production scale, setting the technical direction for our team and making high-stakes technical decisions.

## Responsibilities

- Architect and build distributed, multi-tenant platforms with robust reliability, low latency, and fault tolerance.
- Design and deliver agentic / Large Language Model (LLM)-powered systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, tool-calling frameworks, agent orchestration, and evaluation/observability infrastructure.
- Lead integrations with third-party systems, including APIs, OAuth, permissioning, and secure application ecosystems.
- Establish and enforce engineering standards regarding code quality, testing, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), incident response, and on-call practices.
- Mentor and technically guide a team of engineers, conducting design reviews and removing obstacles to execution.
- Develop core platform services, primarily using Python or similar backend frameworks, with practical exposure to AI and LLM tooling and integration.

## Qualifications

- **Education:** Strong academic pedigree with a degree from a top-tier engineering institution (IIT/NIT-tier or equivalent).
- **Experience:** 7+ years of software engineering experience with significant involvement in startups, having built systems from 0 to 1 instead of just maintaining mature systems.
- **Seniority:** Prior experience as a tech lead or engineering lead, possessing ownership of architectural decisions and mentoring team members.
- **Expertise:** Deep hands-on knowledge in distributed systems, backend architecture, and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
- **AI Proficiency:** Practical experience with modern AI/LLM systems, including agent frameworks, RAG, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, and AI observability.
- **Track Record:** Proven history of shipping production systems at scale, particularly in high throughput, multi-tenant, or high-reliability environments.
- **Ownership Mentality:** Strong sense of ownership, comfortable with ambiguity, and adept at driving projects from concept to production.

## Preferred Skills

- Familiarity with advanced monitoring and observability tools.
- Experience with microservices architecture.
- Knowledge of security best practices in cloud and application development.

## Experience

- Minimum of 7 years in software engineering, with notable exposure to startup environments and hands-on experience in developing systems from scratch.

title: Data & Manchine Learing Engineers - Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description


Tieto Tech Consulting har lenge levert data- og AI-løsninger til virksomheter i Norge og internasjonalt, med et dataingeniørmiljø på over 80 fagpersoner. Nå bygger vi et nytt, spesialisert team innenfor dette miljøet, med mandat til å rette denne kompetansen målrettet mot mellomstore norske produksjonsbedrifter og industrivirksomheter, fra prognosemodeller og kvalitetskontroll med maskinsyn til prediktivt vedlikehold og produksjonsoptimalisering. Vi jobber tett med kunden fra første kartlegging til ferdig løsning, og vi eier leveransen og risikoen selv, ikke bare spesifikasjonen. Du blir med i et lite, flatt team i tidlig fase av denne satsningen, der du får eierskap til både teknisk retning og kunderelasjon. I perioder mellom prosjekter i dette teamet vil du jobbe som konsulent på andre oppdrag i Tieto Tech Consulting, på lik linje med øvrige konsulenter hos oss.

Vi ser etter deg som vil være med å bygge moderne dataplattformer, utvikle robuste datapipelines, og – der det er relevant – trene og sette maskinlæringsmodeller i produksjon, og omsette data til reell forretningsverdi for kunder i produksjonssektoren.

Som Data Engineer hos Tieto Tech Consulting vil du jobbe med

Plattform og infrastruktur:

Designe og implementere skalerbar dataplattform og -arkitektur, utover hyllevareløsninger, med vekt på gjenbrukbare løsninger (infrastruktur som kode, maler, blueprints) som kan videreutvikles fra prosjekt til prosjekt.

Datapipelines, modeller og bruk:

Utvikle og vedlikeholde datapipelines og datamodeller (daglig, månedlig eller ad-hoc), sikre korrekt datainntak og etterlevelse av datastyring, og – avhengig av bakgrunn og interesse – bidra til utvikling av prognose-, klassifiserings- eller maskinsyn-modeller for industrielle bruksområder.

Kundenær kartlegging og leveranse:

Delta direkte i kartleggingsfasen hos kunden – forstå datagrunnlag, forretningsmål og målarkitektur – og bidra til å definere konkrete leveranser som kunden faktisk kan ta i bruk.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert datautvikler som ønsker å jobbe med moderne dataplattformer og skape verdi gjennom data. Du kjenner deg gjerne igjen i flere av disse punktene:

  • Du har minst to års erfaring fra en tilsvarende rolle.
  • Du programmerer godt i Python og/eller SQL, og liker å jobbe med data.
  • Du har erfaring med dataintegrasjon og datapipelines, gjerne i teknologier som Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake eller tilsvarende skybaserte plattformer.
  • Du har jobbet med datamigrering, fra uthenting av data fra ulike kilder til utvikling, drift og overvåking av robuste datapipelines.
  • Har du erfaring med maskinlæring, som prognosemodeller, computer vision eller anomalideteksjon, er det et stort pluss – men ikke en forutsetning.
  • Du har høyere utdanning innen teknologi, matematikk, ingeniørfag eller andre relevante realfag. Mastergrad er en fordel.
  • Relevante sertifiseringer innen Azure, Microsoft Fabric eller Databricks er positivt, men vi verdsetter også praktisk erfaring.
  • Du kommuniserer flytende på engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Du behersker norsk godt, slik at du kan samarbeide og kommunisere direkte med kundene våre.

Som person tror vi du trives med bredt eierskap og liker å jobbe tett på kunden, ikke bare på koden. Du tar ansvar for å organisere eget arbeid, er en lagspiller som deler kunnskap med kolleger, og har nok forretningsforståelse til å omsette et kundebehov til noe konkret og leverbart. Du er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi, men enda viktigere: du er komfortabel i en tidlig fase der prosesser og ansvar ikke alltid er ferdig definert, og du bidrar selv til å forme dem.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr deg faglig utvikling, meningsfulle prosjekter, en åpen kultur og en fremragende balanse mellom jobb og fritid! Hos oss får du muligheten til å være med fra starten på en ny satsning i en voksende, viktig sektor – med kort vei fra idé til kundelevering. Vi legger vekt på faglig utvikling gjennom kurs, sertifiseringer og faggrupper, og du blir en del av et inkluderende og støttende miljø, både sosialt og profesjonelt. Vi tilbyr fleksibel hybrid arbeidsmodell, privat helseforsikring og gode treningsmuligheter, enten på vårt eget treningsrom på Fornebu eller gjennom støtte til eksternt treningssenter.

Hvis du har spørsmål om stillingen, ta kontakt med rekrutterende leder Eirik Lyngvi, eirik.lyngvi@tieto.com

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation.Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Client Solutions Associate (Singapore - February 2027)
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

Your Team's Impact

Looking for a fun and dynamic tech role, nestled deep in the finance industry?

The Client Solutions Associate role will offer you:

  • Training program spanning 6 months to get you ready for this client-facing FinTech role
  • Exposure to the largest domestic and global financial institutions across Investment Management and Investment Banking

  • Competitive starting salary with extra Perks not limited to; free lunch, a stocked fridge & pantry, private health care, Social Events

What You'll Do

Client Solutions Associates begin their careers through a comprehensive development program, followed by working with clients first over the phone. Throughout the program, Client Solutions Associates will develop a wide array of skills and provide value to our clients by:

  • Developing a deep knowledge base across our business, products, and clients
  • Communicating with impact in person and over the phone while mastering presentation and public speaking skills both internally and externally
  • Asking effective questions in various situations to gather information, uncover needs, and create solutions to foster a truly collaborative and consultative partnerships
  • Defining key industry terms and concepts important to FactSet’s clients to be an industry expert
  • Using advanced product knowledge and understanding of FactSet’s product suite to identify and implement solutions specific to client and user workflows including Excel modelling, company research, and portfolio analysis

Following the successful completion of the training program, you will quickly become an integral part of the team and start taking up responsibilities as a FactSet Consultant by:

  • Managing a group of accounts assigned to you, ensuring that the relationship is healthy and that the client is getting maximum value out of the FactSet software
  • Customizing solutions to fit with individual client workflows and ensuring that the client can make efficient and accurate decisions using FactSet data and tools
  • Effectively demonstrating the various product lines to clients and provide software training to individuals as well as small and large groups
  • Visiting clients on a regular basis to provide face-to-face support, training and build strong relationships
  • Working on longer term projects with clients to enable them to get value out of the FactSet product suite.
  • Being effective problem solvers and providing creative solutions to the many question’s clients have in and around the use of FactSet.
  • Answering day-to-day client queries and providing creative and complex solutions through our helpdesk.

What We're Looking For

The ideal Client Solutions Associate possesses the following qualifications:

  • You must be a Singaporean Citizen/PR
  • Fresh graduates or finance professionals with less than 3 years of working experience
  • A bachelor's degree (Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Accounting, MIS, Computer Science majors are preferred, but all majors will be considered)
  • Background or strong interest in a Finance or FinTech industry
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and ability to come up with creative solutions
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal and client facing skills

What's In It For You

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

  • The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
  • Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
  • Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
  • A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
  • Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
  • Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

Learn more about our benefits here.

Company Overview:

FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Robot Learning Engineer
description:
About Origin

Origin is building physical AI for the built world. Our robots autonomously finish building interiors at production quality. OG-1 is deployed on live NYC commercial construction sites today. Backed by Accel.

Our system runs a Multi Agent Action Expert architecture: classical precision algorithms orchestrated alongside learned policies. The job is systematically expanding the learned components while keeping the system production-safe.

The Role

You own the full lifecycle of learned components on OG-1: from data collection and model training through edge deployment on Jetson AGX Orin. Every research project will have a deployment milestone. This is not a lab position.

What You Will Do

  • Train and deploy VLA models for contact-rich manipulation using our imitation learning infrastructure.
  • Build the data flywheel: teleoperation pipelines (GELLO, SpaceMouse, VR), DAgger-style online correction, demonstration curation.
  • Research and prototype world models for surface state prediction, spray dynamics, and anomaly detection.
  • Design offline evaluation metrics that predict real-world finishing quality before deployment.
  • Optimize models for edge: TensorRT compilation, latency profiling, memory budgeting on dual Jetson AGX Orin.
  • Hands-on experience with world models, including building or working with predictive or generative environment models (e.g., latent dynamics, video prediction, or planning-oriented models)
  • Design the interface where learned policies propose actions and deterministic safety layers enforce constraints.

Requirements

  • BS/MS/PhD in CS, Robotics, ML, or equivalent experience shipping learned systems on physical robots.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch; comfort modifying research codebases (you'll work directly with open-source VLA implementations).
  • Experience in at least two of: imitation learning, RL, vision-language models, robot learning from demonstration, sim-to-real.
  • Track record deploying ML on real hardware: not just training to convergence, but debugging why the policy fails on the actual robot.
  • Working knowledge of ROS2 or equivalent robotics middleware.
  • Experience working with Simulation Systems like Isaac Sim.

description:
What You Will Do:

At Independent Software, as a Systems Engineer Level 3, you will support the full engineering lifecycle of mission systems from integration and testing through deployment and operational support. You will work with a small, mission-focused team to integrate hardware, software, networking, and telecommunications infrastructure while interacting regularly with users and customers.

This is a hands-on engineering position that includes system deployments, server hardware, network equipment, fiber and CAT-5/6 cabling, testing, troubleshooting, and Quality Assurance activities to ensure systems are reliable, maintainable, and ready for mission use.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support systems throughout the engineering lifecycle from integration and testing through deployment

  • Terminate CAT-5/6 and fiber-optic cabling
  • Test and troubleshoot fiber using optical power meters, OTDRs, and related test equipment
  • Monitor and troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues
  • Perform Quality Assurance evaluations of system builds for quality, reliability, maintainability, and safety
  • Install, troubleshoot, repair, and replace components in Dell servers
  • Support networking and infrastructure hardware, including Dell, Arista, and Raritan equipment
  • Collaborate with users, customers, and engineering team members during system integration and deployment

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience with system hardware/software integration and system deployments
  • Hands-on experience installing and supporting network and telecommunications equipment
  • Experience installing and terminating CAT-5/6 and fiber-optic cabling
  • Experience using fiber-optic test equipment, including optical power meters and OTDRs
  • Strong hardware, software, and network troubleshooting skills
  • Experience installing, testing, maintaining, and decommissioning systems
  • Experience performing Quality Assurance evaluations of system builds
  • Experience repairing or replacing components in Dell servers
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with customers and technical teams

Preferred Qualifications:

Education and Experience:

Qualified or related disciplines include Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or a comparable technical field.

title: Νοσηλευτής/Νοσηλεύτρια Αποστείρωσης
description:
Με μια πορεία άνω των 40 ετών στο χώρο της Υγείας ο Όμιλος εταιρειών Βιοιατρική αποτελεί τον κορυφαίο πάροχο υπηρεσιών Πρωτοβάθμιας Φροντίδας στην Ελλάδα. Με δέσμευση στην ιατρική και στην ψηφιακή τεχνολογία, παραμένουμε αφοσιωμένοι στην προώθηση της υγείας και της επιστήμης, προσφέροντας ευκαιρίες απασχόλησης σε εξειδικευμένο εργατικό δυναμικό.

Στη Βιοιατρική, οι Άνθρωποί μας είναι η «καρδιά» του οργανισμού μας και υποστηρίζουν ενεργά το όραμά μας να φροντίζουμε τις ανάγκες υγείας κάθε ατόμου και να συμβάλουμε προς μια Καλύτερη Ποιότητα Ζωής για Όλους! Με όχημα τις αξίες μας, Ενσυναίσθηση, Αριστεία, Όραμα & Υπευθυνότητα, δημιουργούμε ένα περιβάλλον εργασίας που προάγει τη διαφορετικότητα και τη συμπερίληψη και αναπτύσσει τις δυνατότητες των ανθρώπων μας.

Την περίοδο αυτή αναζητούμε Νοσηλευτή/ Νοσηλεύτρια Αποστείρωσης για τη Βιοκλινική Αθηνών.

Σκοπός Θέσης

Η ορθή διαχείριση των διαδικασιών καθαρισμού, συσκευασίας και αποστείρωσης χειρουργικών εργαλείων και υλικών, με στόχο την ασφαλή και εύρυθμη λειτουργία του χειρουργείου και την τήρηση των πρωτοκόλλων υγιεινής και ασφάλειας.

Βασικές Αρμοδιότητες

  • Διαχείριση της διαδικασίας καθαρισμού, συσκευασίας και αποστείρωσης χειρουργικών εργαλείων, σετ και υλικών.
  • Έλεγχος της αποτελεσματικότητας των κλιβάνων αποστείρωσης και των πλυντηρίων μέσω χημικών και βιολογικών δεικτών.
  • Παρακολούθηση της σωστής λειτουργίας του ιατροτεχνολογικού εξοπλισμού και των μηχανημάτων του τμήματος.
  • Προγραμματισμός του κλιβανισμού εργαλείων και υλικών σύμφωνα με το χειρουργικό πρόγραμμα και τους προβλεπόμενους χρόνους.
  • Διασφάλιση της τήρησης των κανόνων απολύμανσης, άσηπτης τεχνικής και διαχείρισης μολυσματικών περιστατικών.

Απαραίτητα Προσόντα

  • Πτυχίο ΑΕΙ/ΤΕΙ/ΙΕΚ Νοσηλευτικής
  • Γνώση χειρουργικών εργαλείων, διαδικασιών αποστείρωσης και ιατροτεχνολογικού εξοπλισμού.
  • Γνώση τεχνικών απολύμανσης και διαχείρισης μολυσματικών εργαλείων.
  • Επιθυμητή προηγούμενη εργασιακή εμπειρία σε αντίστοιχη θέση (νοσοκομείο ή κλινική)
  • Δυνατότητα απασχόλησης σε ευέλικτα ωράρια/βάρδιες

Προφίλ Υποψηφίου

  • Ανθρωποκεντρική αντίληψη και προσήλωση στην παροχή υπηρεσιών υψηλής ποιότητας
  • Ευαισθησία, υπομονή και ιδιαίτερη ευγένεια
  • Μεθοδικότητα, οργάνωση και ομαδικό πνεύμα συνεργασίας

Παροχές

  • Ομαδική Ασφάλιση Ζωής και Νοσοκομειακής Περίθαλψης
  • Παροχές υγείας εργαζομένων και συγγενών α’ βαθμού
  • Συνεχής εκπαίδευση και απεριόριστη πρόσβαση στην ηλεκτρονική πλατφόρμα μάθησης του Ομίλου για την προσωπική και επαγγελματική σας ανάπτυξη
  • Προοπτικές εξέλιξης σε ένα σύγχρονο και αξιοκρατικό περιβάλλον

title: AI Engineer
description:

## Experience

- Experience working with **APIs, legacy systems**, and **multi-system integrations**.
- Proven ability to handle **complex failure scenarios** and improve **system robustness**.

title: Senior Developer - Information Technology
description:
