description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other lice applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Advogado Especialista
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Advogado Especialista based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to provide sophisticated legal advisory and litigation support across a broad range of business matters.
You will have a strong focus on commercial and rural credit recovery, developing assertive strategies to maximize successful outcomes.
The position combines legal analysis, litigation management, contract work, risk assessment, and preventive advisory.
You will work on complex cases involving asset investigation, judicial measures, enforcement, and innovative legal strategies.
The role requires autonomy, technical depth, and the ability to translate complex legal challenges into practical, results-oriented solutions.
You will interact closely with clients, helping them make critical decisions while mitigating legal and commercial risks.
This is an opportunity to contribute directly to high-impact legal matters within a collaborative and technically demanding environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Provide legal advisory and consulting services across civil, corporate, contractual, labor, administrative, and other relevant areas of law.
  • Manage and monitor portfolios of complex judicial and administrative proceedings, maintaining close alignment with clients and providing regular updates and reports.
  • Develop and review procedural documents, legal opinions, contracts, reports, and other legal instruments requiring a high degree of technical analysis and autonomy.
  • Lead strategies focused on commercial and rural credit recovery, identifying effective judicial and extrajudicial alternatives to maximize recovery outcomes.
  • Conduct or support specialized asset investigations and identify opportunities for asset seizure, enforcement, and expropriation.
  • Evaluate and apply appropriate judicial systems, procedural mechanisms, atypical measures, and other legal strategies to support credit recovery.
  • Analyze opportunities for filing Incidente de Desconsideração da Personalidade Jurídica (IDPJ) when legally appropriate.
  • Assess legal risks, conduct diagnoses, and recommend practical and strategic alternatives aligned with client objectives.
  • Research legislation, case law, legal doctrine, and emerging legal strategies to support complex matters and develop updated arguments.
  • Prepare legal studies and opinions involving civil, procedural, corporate, contractual, intellectual property, labor, social security, and other areas of law as required.
  • Support preventive legal initiatives, helping clients mitigate risks and maintain regulatory and contractual compliance.
  • Negotiate and advise on legal matters while preserving commercial relationships and seeking efficient dispute-resolution alternatives.
  • Manage deadlines, procedural activities, documentation, and case information with accuracy and strong attention to detail.
  • Develop customized legal solutions that add value to clients and contribute to positive outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree in Law, with an active registration with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB).
    • Postgraduate degree or specialization in Business Law, Contract Law, Civil Law, or a related area is preferred.
    • Additional postgraduate studies in Civil Procedure, Labor Procedure, or Labor Law are considered a plus.
    • At least 6 months of professional experience in general legal practice and credit recovery.
    • Solid knowledge of Civil Law, Contract Law, Corporate Law, and Civil Procedure.
    • Familiarity with Labor Procedure and Labor Law, with experience handling complex civil, labor, and administrative proceedings.
    • Demonstrated experience managing judicial proceedings, deadlines, procedural documentation, and client portfolios.
    • Strong legal research, analytical, and legal writing skills, including the preparation of sophisticated procedural documents and legal opinions.
    • Ability to independently analyze complex legal issues, identify risks, and recommend appropriate courses of action.
    • Strong negotiation, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
    • High degree of professional ethics, accountability, discretion, and attention to detail.
    • Ability to work autonomously while maintaining a strong client-focused and results-oriented approach.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on complex and high-impact legal matters across multiple areas of law.
      • Exposure to sophisticated commercial and rural credit recovery strategies.
      • Professional development through work involving complex litigation, legal advisory, contracts, and preventive law.
      • Opportunity to work with medium and large corporate clients across diverse industries.
      • Collaborative and technically oriented professional environment.
      • Exposure to multidisciplinary legal challenges and a broad range of judicial and administrative matters.
      • Career development opportunities within a structured legal practice.
      • Supportive infrastructure, technology, and organizational resources for legal work.

title: Αιμολήπτης/Αιμολήπτρια - Δυτικός Τομέας
description:
Με μια πορεία άνω των 40 ετών στο χώρο της Υγείας ο Όμιλος εταιρειών Βιοιατρική αποτελεί τον κορυφαίο πάροχο υπηρεσιών Πρωτοβάθμιας Φροντίδας στην Ελλάδα. Με δέσμευση στην ιατρική και στην ψηφιακή τεχνολογία, παραμένουμε αφοσιωμένοι στην προώθηση της υγείας και της επιστήμης, προσφέροντας ευκαιρίες απασχόλησης σε εξειδικευμένο εργατικό δυναμικό.

Στη Βιοιατρική, οι Άνθρωποι μας είναι η «καρδιά» του οργανισμού μας και υποστηρίζουν ενεργά το όραμά μας να φροντίζουμε τις ανάγκες υγείας κάθε ατόμου και να συμβάλουμε προς μια Καλύτερη Ποιότητα Ζωής για Όλους! Με όχημα τις αξίες μας, Ενσυναίσθηση, Αριστεία, Όραμα & Υπευθυνότητα, δημιουργούμε ένα περιβάλλον εργασίας που προάγει τη διαφορετικότητα και τη συμπερίληψη και αναπτύσσει τις δυνατότητες των ανθρώπων μας.

Την περίοδο αυτή αναζητούμε Αιμολήπτη/Αιμολήπτρια με έδρα τo Δυτικό Τομέα

Σκοπός Θέσης

  • Η ποιοτική εξυπηρέτηση εξεταζομένων μέσω της ασφαλούς και αποτελεσματικής συλλογής βιολογικού υλικού για διαγνωστικούς σκοπούς.

Βασικές Αρμοδιότητες

  • Δειγματοληψία βιολογικών υλικών σε εξεταζομένους
  • Επεξήγηση τρόπου διενέργειας των εξετάσεων στον εξεταζόμενο
  • Φυγοκέντρηση και διαχωρισμός δειγμάτων
  • Αγαστή συνεργασία με συναδέλφους και προϊσταμένους τμημάτων
  • Τήρηση των κανονισμών/διαδικασιών του τμήματος

Απαραίτητα Προσόντα

  • Πτυχίο ΑΕΙ/ΤΕΙ/ΙΕΚ Νοσηλευτικής/Ιατρικών Εργαστηρίων
  • Πιστοποίηση ΕΟΠΠΕΠ
  • Απαραίτητη εμπειρία στη λήψη αιμοληψιών
  • Δυνατότητα απασχόλησης σε ευέλικτα ωράρια/βάρδιες
  • Καλή γνώση της Αγγλικής γλώσσα & Η/Υ

Προφίλ Υποψηφίου

  • Ανθρωποκεντρική αντίληψη και προσήλωση στην παροχή υπηρεσιών υψηλής ποιότητας
  • Ευαισθησία, υπομονή και ιδιαίτερη ευγένεια
  • Μεθοδικότητα, οργάνωση και ομαδικό πνεύμα συνεργασίας

Παροχές

  • Ομαδική Ασφάλιση Ζωής και Νοσοκομειακής Περίθαλψης
  • Παροχές υγείας εργαζομένων και συγγενών α’ βαθμού
  • Συνεχής εκπαίδευση και απεριόριστη πρόσβαση στην ηλεκτρονική πλατφόρμα μάθησης του Ομίλου για την προσωπική και επαγγελματική σας ανάπτυξη
  • Προοπτικές εξέλιξης σε ένα σύγχρονο και αξιοκρατικό περιβάλλον

description:

Job Title: Engineering Leadership Development Program - Software Engineer

Job Code: 41831

Job Schedule: 9/80

Job Location: Various Locations

Job Description:

The Engineering Leadership Development Program (ELDP) is a challenging 3-year rotational program created to accelerate the development of highly qualified, motivated engineers by exposing them to different program types, business units, geographic locations and elements of the design life cycle. Participants are also paired with a mentor to guide their development through the program. Additionally, participants will have access to education assistance, robust training, and cross-functional engagement to accelerate their career growth.

Job Duties:

  • Apply computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis concepts and principles in the development of software for the target application
  • Work closely with cross functional members of the engineering organization to develop and evaluate interfaces between hardware and software, and operational performance requirements and design of the overall system
  • Support and participate in all phases of the software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, and test of embedded software for real-time control of advanced tactical radio equipment
  • Develop software test procedures, software programs, and related documentation
  • Utilize modeling tools and equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, and evaluate results
  • Participate in peer reviews, identify, track and repair defects
  • Utilize a variety of software languages (i.e., C++, C#, C, Java, Ruby, HTML5, XML, SQL, Perl, Python, Ajax, Qt) on Windows, Linux, mobile platforms, and embedded real time operating systems (VxWorks, Linux, QNX, Integrity, Windows CE, and others for Motorola, Intel, TI, and custom processor designs)

Qualifications:

  • To be eligible, applicants must be pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Materials Science Engineering or have completed their Bachelor’s degree within the last 12 months, regardless of age.
  • Ability to relocate every 12 months for the 3-year duration of the program.

Preferred Skills:

  • CAD or analysis (FEA) tools exposure, and/or experience in mechanical design or analysis of electronic systems, structures and mechanisms
  • Familiarity with transducer instrumentation, data collection and or automation and software programming for numerical analysis
  • Must be able to generate free body diagrams, determine reaction forces, calculate internal loads, and develop shear and moment diagrams
  • Working knowledge of one programming language

title: Lead AI Engineer & Technical Architect (Remote)
description:
About Bold Business

Bold Business is an AI-first U.S. based global workforce solutions company rebuilding how businesses operate in the AI era. We build AI-Amplified Talent™, custom AI agents, and automation systems for clients like AT&T, JP Morgan, and Verizon — and we back every engagement. If you want to build things that ship and matter, you'll fit right in.

The Role

You are the technical standard-setter and primary builder for how AI systems are designed, built, and shipped at Bold.

You will:

  • Architect systems
  • Build them yourself
  • Set the bar for everyone else

If you haven’t personally shipped production AI systems end-to-end, this role will not be a fit.

What You’ll Do

Build Real Systems

  • Design and ship production RAG pipelines (end-to-end)
  • Build multi-agent systems used by real clients
  • Integrate LLMs into production workflows (not prototypes)
  • Own backend systems (FastAPI, multi-tenant, secure)
  • Deploy with Docker + CI/CD + cloud
  • Measure and improve output quality before anything ships

Set the Standard

  • Define how AI systems are built at Bold
  • Establish architecture patterns, prompting standards, and data flows
  • Own code quality and reviews — nothing ships without your approval
  • Choose tools, frameworks, and infrastructure
  • Mentor engineers and raise the performance bar across the team

Non-Negotiable Requirements

English communication — non-negotiable

  • Advanced to fluent English — written and spoken

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
At Go1, we’re on a mission to help organizations deliver learning and development in more relevant, timely, and effective ways. From a small startup to now a global brand - we’ve grown by solving hard problems, embracing ambiguity, and never standing still.

If you thrive on change, get energy from big, complex challenges, and are excited to grow fast alongside smart, ambitious people, then Go1 might be exactly what you’re looking for. We offer autonomy with accountability, space to experiment, and the opportunity to shape solutions that impact millions of learners worldwide. We don’t have all the answers — and that’s the point. We figure it out together. Every line of code, every conversation, every bold idea helps move us closer to our mission: to enable individuals, organizations, and society to progress. There’s still so much to build — and even more to discover. Go there with us...

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to turn complex product and business questions into clear, decision-ready evidence.

This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role for someone who combines technical depth with strong judgement: defining what matters, making the evidence reliable and helping teams act on it. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer, Marketing and commercial partners to understand what is happening, why it matters and what should happen next.

Go1 is investing in product-led growth and new product experiences, including Morgan by Go1—our workforce-enablement product that helps organisations turn learning signals into practical follow-through. To learn quickly from that work, we need clear measurement, well-designed instrumentation and confidence in the metrics that guide our choices. You’ll help create that clarity. Your work will improve the quality of product and business decisions, strengthen the analytical products people rely on and lift capability across the analyst cohort.

How you'll fit into our team:

You will join Go1’s Data Intelligence team: a cross-functional group of Data Analysts, Business Analysts, Data Engineers and Data Scientists working alongside teams across the business. Initially, your focus will be product-led growth and new product experiences. You will work beyond reporting...starting with the decision that matters, identifying what needs to be measured, designing a proportionate analytical approach and helping partners use the evidence.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will lead complex domain analytics while being a generous technical peer. You will help other analysts develop stronger judgement through solution design, peer review and practical problem-solving, while drawing on Data Engineering and Data Science expertise when a question needs deeper specialist support. This role suits someone who enjoys ambiguity, asks sharp questions and can balance pace with rigour. You will not own business decisions or operational change, but your work will make the trade-offs, evidence and implications much clearer for the people who do.

Where you'll make an impact:

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous goals into meaningful decisions, measurable questions and practical analytical approaches.
  • Lead analysis, metric models, dashboards and reports that improve product, customer and commercial decisions.
  • Define success measures for new initiatives and product experiences; identify gaps in event tracking, instrumentation, data quality or availability; and work with engineering partners to resolve them.
  • Frame domain opportunities, compare options and make trade-offs in confidence, pace, usability and reuse visible.
  • Build and own SQL-based analytical products—from metric definition, documentation and validation through to monitoring use, improving what matters and consolidating or retiring products that no longer support a meaningful decision.
  • Communicate rigorous, accessible evidence to technical and non-technical audiences, including the recommendation, confidence level, limitations and action or decision that follows.
  • Influence senior functional partners through clear evidence and constructive challenge.
  • Guide and mentor analysts through solution design, peer review and technical problem-solving, creating reusable patterns that improve quality and confidence across the team.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve analytical effectiveness, while applying independent judgement, validating material outputs and protecting sensitive information.

In your first three months, you will:

  • Build strong working relationships with priority Product, Engineering and business partners.
  • Understand the most important domain decisions, existing analytical products, core metrics and material data gaps.
  • Deliver early value on a defined analytical problem, with clear assumptions, evidence and next actions.
  • Develop a practical view of where better measurement, instrumentation or analytical practice will have the greatest impact.

By six to twelve months, you will:

  • Lead high-impact analytical work from problem definition through to recommendation, adoption and review.
  • Improve the reliability and usefulness of measurement for priority initiatives, with clearer ownership and quality mechanisms.
  • Make the adoption and decision-use of priority analytical products visible, using that evidence to improve or simplify the analytical estate.
  • Be recognised as a trusted analytical and technical guide for partners and peers, improving practice beyond your own delivery.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • Strong SQL capability and confidence working with complex, imperfect and evolving data.
  • Experience building and maintaining analytical solutions in a modern data warehouse and BI environment. We are open to your platform background; transferable judgement matters more than one specific tool.
  • Demonstrated experience taking a stakeholder problem from discovery through to insight, recommendation and decision support.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering on metrics, event tracking, data availability, instrumentation or implementation quality.
  • Strong analytical judgement, including the ability to apply and interpret appropriate statistical methods and communicate limitations clearly.
  • Experience creating metric models, analyses, dashboards or reports with clear definitions, validation, documentation and ownership.
  • Evidence of senior-level contribution through mentoring, quality assurance, reusable standards or technical leadership.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A practical, curious approach to solving problems: able to move work forward with imperfect information while maintaining a high bar for evidence and impact.

Nice to have:

  • Python experience for analysis, automation or modelling.
  • Product analytics, product-led growth, experimentation, engagement measurement or B2B SaaS experience.
  • Exposure to data science methods and sound judgement about when specialist support is needed.
  • Experience with Databricks or comparable modern data-platform tooling.
  • Experience working in a fast-moving, remote-first and cross-functional environment.

What the role is not:

This is not a people-management role or a role focused solely on dashboard production. It is for someone who can pair hands-on analytical craft with product judgement, senior partnership and a genuine instinct to lift the capability around them.

#LI-REMOTE #LI-AE1

Benefits:

At Go1, our employee benefits extend far beyond a pay cheque, ensuring our team feels supported, valued, and empowered to bring their best selves to work each day, driving our mission to unlock positive potential through a love of learning.

  • In addition to your base salary: Annual bonus or commission plan.
  • Employee Stock Option Plan: Opportunity to share directly in our success through stock options.
  • Public Holiday Swap: Swap a public holiday for another preferred day.
  • Flexible Working: We are a fully remote organisation with team events and travel throughout the year.
  • Wellbeing & Learning Days: An additional five days of paid leave per year.
  • Learning Budget: $500 USD per financial year, plus access to additional Career Growth Budget.
  • WFH/Transport Budget: Monthly allowance for internet/phone expenses or public transport.
  • Home Office Setup Budget: One-off allowance for desk, chair and/or monitor.
  • Parental Leave: Minimum of 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers + 6 weeks paid parental leave for secondary carers.
  • Wellbeing Support: Access to counselling and wellbeing initiatives

Check out Life at Go1: LET'S GO!

title: Design Project Coordinator – Commercial Interiors
description:
Role Summary

We’re looking for an experienced Commercial Furniture Project Coordinator to keep complex projects moving from order through installation and closeout.

You’ll be the operational hub connecting sales, design, manufacturers, logistics, installation teams, and clients—tracking details, resolving issues, and making sure orders, schedules, and project information stay accurate.

The ideal candidate has worked in a commercial furniture dealership or manufacturer environment, understands the furniture project lifecycle, and is comfortable managing multiple projects at once. Experience with dealership ERP systems and familiarity with CET/Configura is a strong plus.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate commercial furniture projects from internal handoff through delivery, installation, punch, and closeout.
  • Enter and maintain quotes, sales orders, purchase orders, change orders, and project information within dealership ERP or project systems.
  • Review orders, specifications, drawings, finishes, quantities, pricing, and project documentation for accuracy.
  • Review manufacturer acknowledgements and resolve discrepancies before they affect delivery or installation.
  • Track lead times, ship dates, backorders, substitutions, and other issues that could impact project schedules.
  • Keep sales, design, manufacturers, operations, installation, accounting, and other stakeholders aligned on project status and next steps.
  • Coordinate changes and revisions, ensuring pricing, orders, schedules, and internal systems remain accurate.
  • Support delivery and installation readiness, including site access, logistics, scheduling, and field requirements.
  • Assist with punch-list items, replacement orders, warranty issues, invoicing, and project closeout.
  • Proactively identify missing information, potential errors, and schedule risks—and follow them through to resolution.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in commercial furniture project coordination, dealer operations, order management, sales support, or a closely related role.
  • Experience working for a commercial furniture dealership, contract furniture manufacturer, or workplace interiors company strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with manufacturers such as Steelcase, Haworth, MillerKnoll, Teknion, Kimball, Allsteel, HON, Humanscale, or similar brands.
  • Strong understanding of the commercial furniture project lifecycle, including order processing, acknowledgements, lead times, delivery, installation, changes, punch, and closeout.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch discrepancies before they become costly problems.
  • Ability to manage multiple active projects, deadlines, and priorities at the same time.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.


Systems & Software

Experience with commercial furniture ERP, dealership, order-management, or project systems is preferred, including platforms such as:

  • Hedberg
  • Khameleon
  • NetSuite
  • ProjectSpec
  • Other dealership-specific ERP or order-management systems

Experience with CET/Configura is preferred. Familiarity with AutoCAD, CAP, 2020, ProjectMatrix, or similar specification tools is also valuable.

We care more about your commercial furniture workflow experience and what you have done within these systems than experience with one specific platform.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Remote work with an established U.S. commercial furniture organization.
  • Exposure to complex, high-profile commercial interiors projects.
  • A collaborative team environment where your work directly impacts project success.
  • Opportunities to expand your knowledge of commercial furniture systems, manufacturers, and project delivery.

title: Senior ML/AI Engineer
description:
About HEADBORNE.AI

Safe, mission-based AI solutions for first responders and defense.

HEADBORNE's long-term mission is to defend free democracies of the world with ethical, interoperable, mission-based safe AI solutions for first responders, defense forces, and decision makers. We build a secure, AI-driven Cloud/OS platform integrated in the next generations of AR smart glasses, helmets, drones, robots, and training systems. We seamlessly connect them across air, land, sea, space, and cyberspace, delivering complete situational awareness, control, and command.

About the Role

HEADBORNE seeks a Senior Machine Learning/AI Engineer to join our rapidly growing core systems team. You will develop machine learning solutions for advanced sensor technology from concept through deployment—optimizing object detection algorithms and pioneering ML-based image enhancement techniques that push the boundaries of what our sensors can achieve. This is a hands-on, high-impact role spanning model architecture, data pipeline development, embedded deployment, and system-level performance optimization. Working closely with hardware and systems engineers, you’ll translate sensor capabilities into robust ML models that perform reliably in real-world conditions. We’re looking for a brilliant, motivated engineer to join TEAM HEADBORNE—delivering mission-based, safe AI solutions that matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own and lead the development of ML models for object detection, tracking, and image enhancement on embedded platforms.

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for sensor data ingestion, training, and evaluation.

  • Optimize inference performance for low-latency, low-power edge compute (GPU/CPU/NPU) environments.

  • Integrate ML models into mission-critical systems for AR helmets, drones, and robotic platforms.

  • Conduct experiments and benchmarking across diverse imaging conditions and sensor types.

  • Collaborate with software and hardware teams to align ML architecture with embedded system constraints.

  • Contribute to codebase quality, model reproducibility, and CI/CD workflows for ML pipelines.

  • Explore and prototype new ML applications aligned with HEADBORNE’s mission.

Required Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.

  • 2+ years of experience shipping production-grade ML systems.

  • Deep expertise in machine learning algorithms and applied computer vision (classical and deep learning).

  • Expert-level Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or equivalent frameworks).

  • Proven experience across the full ML lifecycle: data curation, training, evaluation, deployment.

  • Demonstrated ability to optimize models for real-time performance and deployment on edge platforms.

  • Proficiency in English.

  • Able to work extended hours as required.

  • Right to work in the United States, without sponsorship.

  • Must be a U.S. citizen eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance (eligibility for Secret or Top Secret clearance, depending on project needs).

  • Self-motivated, organized, and collaborative.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying real-time ML systems using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, and the NVIDIA edge stack (quantization, pruning, etc.)

  • Proficiency in C++ for high-performance or low-latency systems.

  • Familiarity with modern ML Ops tools: experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience designing and scaling data ingestion and processing pipelines.

  • Background in advanced computer vision tasks such as object detection, super-resolution, denoising, or image enhancement.

Location

This in-person role is based in Columbus, GA. Candidates are expected to be located in the Columbus, GA area or willing to relocate.

What We Offer

  • Defend free democracies through mission-based, safe AI solutions
  • Closely collaborate with a small, international team of world-leading experts on cutting-edge AI-driven AR systems
  • Earn a competitive salary
  • Receive highly competitive stock options

title: Product Experience Designer - Lead - AI
description:
Landytech is on a mission to revolutionise the way that investment managers, asset owners and their advisors access asset information. Powered by Sesame, an industry-leading investment reporting platform, we are helping clients in over 15 countries make informed investment decisions and deliver insights faster.

The company is growing rapidly and it’s an exciting time to join, having secured $12M in Series B funding in January 2023. In just four years, it has gone from two co-founders to a team of 80+ staff, with offices in London and Paris. At Landytech, we see diversity as our strength with a team from over 15 countries and 14 languages spoken.

The role

AI has made producing screens easy. It has not made products coherent. We are looking for someone to own the experience of Sesame end to end — the client journey, the interaction logic, the look and feel, and the consistency of all of it.

We have posted this role under two titles — Product Experience Designer and Design Engineer — to reach both backgrounds. Same role, same team. Apply once, to whichever fits you better.

How we work

We have rebuilt our product process around AI rather than bolting it on:

  • AI is used heavily at every stage of both design and engineering, not just at the production end
  • Our design system lives in code, used by engineers and AI tooling alike
  • Tooling changes every few months and we expect it to
  • You will have real scope to shape how we work, and to help build the parts that do not exist yet.

What you will shape

How much of this you lead outright will depend on your experience and on how it fits with the team already in place. There is room to take on more over time.

  • Client journey. The journey for investment professionals, family offices and their advisors — grounded in time spent with them, not personas
  • The experience model. How portfolios, positions, transactions and valuations are represented, related and navigated across the platform — and a strong voice when teams disagree
  • Look, feel and consistency. The product should feel like one thing, and you will help define what that one thing is
  • The design system. A living implementation in code, developed with our front-end engineers rather than a Figma library that drifts from production
  • Craft in dense financial interfaces. Tables that stay legible at scale, numbers at the right precision, drill-downs that survive a messy real portfolio

The must-have: setting the standard AI works to

AI is very good at producing attractive interfaces. Given a design system, almost anyone can now generate a credible screen.

The harder problem, and the one this role exists to solve, is making sure what we build expresses the product’s logic, density and intent rather than simply reusing its components. That means defining the standards and instructions our tools work to, reading the output critically enough to see why something is subtly wrong, and tightening the rules so it does not recur.

Using AI to produce interfaces is not the skill we are looking for. Directing it to our standard, consistently and at depth, is.

Strongly valued: front-end engineering experience

Designing the experience is half of it. Delivering it is the other half.

  • Build and ship, rather than only specify
  • Drive the design system with engineers as a shared artefact in code
  • Design for real production constraints: scale, loading and error states, ugly data

You do not need to be a full-time engineer. Comfort reading a component, working in a library such as shadcn/ui and reviewing a front-end PR goes a long way.

Also valued: product management instincts

If you have talked to clients directly, decided what not to build, and owned an outcome rather than a deliverable, we will weight it heavily.

What we are looking for

We do not expect anyone to have everything below — we would rather meet someone exceptional in two areas than adequate in all three.

  • 5+ years designing B2B, analytics or data-heavy products, with deep UX expertise in complex domains
  • Systems thinking — you think in objects, relationships and states before screens
  • Real craft in dense data interfaces: tables, grids, charts, hierarchy, typography, restraint
  • Fluency with AI-assisted design as a working method, and the specification skill described above
  • First-hand user research — you get past what users say they do to what they actually do
  • Comfortable as an editor and enabler: reviewing others’ work, teaching, holding a line
  • Genuine curiosity about finance. You need not arrive knowing what a capital call is

Our process

Our interview process is likely to include a portfolio or work conversation, a short practical exercise based on a real Sesame flow, and a working session with a product manager and an engineer. We adapt the steps to the candidate and will always tell you what to expect in advance.

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Hybrid working
  • Private medical insurance with Bupa for you and your family
  • Death in service insurance option
  • Pension plan with NEST
  • Cycle to Work scheme and gym allowance
  • Office food and drinks, regular socials

Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);

title: Supervisor(a) de Qualidade
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supervisor(a) de Qualidade based in Brazil.

This role leads quality activities across industrial installation and commissioning projects, with a strong focus on hydroelectric plants and PCHs.
You will coordinate teams and activities alongside Site and Construction management to ensure efficient execution, timely delivery, and contractual compliance.
The position provides technical authority over electromechanical assemblies and installations, ensuring alignment with engineering designs, standards, and specifications.
You will also play a key role in maintaining high HSE standards and protecting the integrity of equipment, materials, and project assets.
The role requires specialized knowledge of hydromechanical equipment, lifting systems, quality controls, and non-conformity management.
You will work closely with subcontractors, engineering teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues and strengthen project execution.
Frequent travel to national and international project sites makes this an impactful opportunity for a quality professional seeking a dynamic, field-oriented environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Team Leadership and Planning: Lead the quality team and plan execution activities in collaboration with Site and Construction management, ensuring efficient operations, adherence to schedules, resource availability, and compliance with contractual requirements.
  • Subcontractor and Asset Quality: Monitor the technical performance of subcontractors, assess their capabilities and deliverables, and ensure that material and equipment receiving and handling processes preserve asset integrity.
  • Technical Quality Assurance: Provide technical authority for the validation of electromechanical assemblies and installations, ensuring strict compliance with engineering designs, applicable standards, and contractual specifications.
  • HSE Compliance: Act as a quality and safety advocate by ensuring that assembly and commissioning activities follow internal requirements, local regulations, and applicable legislation.
  • Hydromechanical Expertise: Apply specialized knowledge of hydromechanical equipment and lifting systems to support accurate and technically sound installation activities across hydroelectric and PCH projects.
  • Non-Conformity and Documentation Management: Manage the full lifecycle of non-conformance reports (NCRs) and quality records, maintaining accurate documentation and collaborating with engineering teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Technical Support and Continuous Improvement: Provide ongoing technical support to customers and internal teams while using operational feedback and lessons learned to improve processes and strengthen future project execution.

    • Requirements

    • Technical Education: Completed technical education in Mechanical, Electrical, Electrotechnical Engineering, or a related field is required, while a specialization in Quality Inspection is considered an advantage.
    • Relevant Experience: Previous experience in quality control involving industrial equipment for hydroelectric power plants is required, with practical knowledge of quality processes in complex project environments.
    • Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of electromechanical installations, hydromechanical equipment, lifting systems, engineering standards, quality documentation, and non-conformity processes is highly valued.
    • Languages: Intermediate Spanish is required, while intermediate English is considered an advantage for working in international project environments.
    • Mobility: Availability for frequent domestic and international travel and relocation to project sites is required.
    • Collaboration and Leadership: The role requires strong coordination, technical judgment, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills to work effectively with subcontractors, engineering teams, customers, and site leadership.

      • Benefits

      • Remote Work: The position is offered as a remote opportunity, providing flexibility in where work is performed between project assignments.
      • Project Exposure: Opportunity to work on technically complex hydroelectric and PCH projects involving electromechanical installations, quality assurance, and commissioning activities.
      • International Environment: Exposure to national and international project sites and collaboration with diverse technical and operational teams.
      • Professional Development: The role offers opportunities to strengthen expertise in industrial quality, hydromechanical systems, project execution, and continuous improvement.
      • Compensation and Additional Benefits: Specific salary and additional benefits were not provided in the job description.
      • Relocation: Relocation assistance is not provided.

About LondonEnergy

At LondonEnergy, we’re proud of our vital role in managing North London’s waste and protecting the environment. As part of the team, you’ll already know that we handle and process 750,000 tonnes of waste each year, making us the second largest waste contract in the UK.

Together, we generate enough energy from waste to power around 80,000 homes annually and recycle 70% of items through our Reuse and Recycling Centres. This is only possible thanks to the dedication of our people, who make a real difference every day.

About the role

As the E&I Technician you will be responsible for the maintenance of the electrical and instrumentation equipment at our various sites across North London, for minimal downtime and to minimise machine breakdowns by ensuring an affect PPM process is in place on all associated electrical and instrumentation machinery and equipment.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide an efficient breakdown repair service. Diagnosing running faults and ensuring effective repairs and improvements are conducted within minimum time scale.
  • To implement PPM on Electrical and Instrumentation equipment, minimize machine breakdowns and reduce lead times.
  • Carrying out installation work to the required standards.
  • Completing routine inspection and undertake preventative maintenance work as part of preventative maintenance management, to ensure equipment is consistently in good condition.
  • To liaise with the outside contractors on specific repairs / maintenance work.
  • To ensure that all statutory obligations are continuously met.
  • You will be part of the team shift patterns:- including nights and days.
  • You may be put 'on call' to deal with any operational emergencies.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:

  • NVQ level 3 or Trade certificate
  • Electrical experience in a heavy-duty industrial environment e.g. power station or equivalent
  • Be a highly skilled candidate who has worked on a large-scale installation and PPM work
  • Experience in analysis and repair of pneumatic systems
  • Experience in PLC controlled equipment (ideally Allen Bradley)
  • Experience in variable speed drives
  • The ability to demonstrate a logical and systematic approach to fault-finding with relevant technical experience in repair, installation and PPM work in heavy process industry, this may constitute working through electrical drawings to rectify problems

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer based in Canada.

This is a strategic technology leadership role responsible for shaping and executing a long-term technology vision aligned with business priorities.
You will lead engineering, architecture, DevOps, infrastructure, QA, and technology modernization initiatives across the organization.
The role combines executive leadership with deep technical oversight, driving scalable, secure, and high-performing SaaS platforms.
You will champion AI, automation, and emerging technologies to create meaningful product innovation and competitive advantage.
Working closely with Product, Customer Success, Professional Services, Sales, and executive leadership, you will ensure technology investments deliver measurable business and customer value.
You will also strengthen engineering culture, improve delivery predictability, reduce technical debt, and build high-performing technical teams.
Success will be measured through stronger innovation, platform reliability, engineering effectiveness, security, and cross-functional alignment.

Accountabilities:

  • Technology Strategy: Develop and execute a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with business strategy, establish technology standards and governance, and lead modernization across cloud architecture, scalability, performance, security, and engineering practices.
  • Engineering Leadership: Lead and mentor Software Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Architecture teams while building a culture centered on accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and high performance.
  • Talent & Organizational Development: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain top technical talent, establish engineering KPIs, and strengthen leadership capabilities across the technology organization.
  • Product Innovation: Partner with Product Management to define technical direction, deliver scalable SaaS solutions, champion customer-focused innovation, and balance technical debt reduction with new product development.
  • AI & Automation: Define the organization’s AI strategy and identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into products and workflows, including technologies such as Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, intelligent automation, and predictive analytics.
  • Infrastructure, Security & Operations: Ensure platform reliability, uptime, disaster recovery, business continuity, cybersecurity, compliance, monitoring, observability, and effective incident response while overseeing cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, and executive leadership to align technology investments with strategic priorities, while participating in customer meetings, executive presentations, and strategic planning.
  • Operational Excellence: Improve software delivery speed and predictability while maintaining quality, reduce technical debt through disciplined modernization, and establish metrics covering deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, platform availability, MTTR, and customer defect rates.
  • First-Year Impact: Establish a multi-year technology roadmap, advance cloud modernization, introduce meaningful AI-enabled capabilities, improve quality and reliability, strengthen security, accelerate innovation, develop engineering leadership, retain key talent, and build stronger alignment across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

    • Requirements

    • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of progressive software engineering experience and at least 3 years of experience leading engineering organizations.
    • SaaS & Modernization: Proven experience delivering enterprise SaaS platforms and leading cloud migration, modernization, and large-scale technology transformation initiatives.
    • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure, cloud architecture, APIs, microservices, CI/CD, DevOps, cybersecurity, and scalable system design.
    • Technology Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing engineering budgets, developing technology roadmaps, establishing engineering standards, and translating technical strategy into measurable business outcomes.
    • AI & Emerging Technology: Experience integrating AI and machine learning into commercial software products is preferred, along with familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and modern AI development frameworks.
    • Leadership Skills: Strong strategic thinking, business acumen, executive communication, organizational leadership, change management, coaching, mentoring, ownership, accountability, and data-driven decision-making abilities.
    • Customer Focus: Ability to make customer-first technology decisions and collaborate effectively with Product, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, and executive stakeholders.
    • Preferred Background: Experience in ERP, logistics, transportation, moving and storage, or field service software is an asset, as is experience within a private equity or software portfolio environment.
    • Additional Qualifications: An MBA or Master’s degree is considered an asset, alongside a strong continuous-improvement mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment.

      • Benefits

      • Work Schedule: Full-time professional position with a scheduled workload of 40 hours per week.
      • Career Impact: Opportunity to shape a multi-year technology strategy, influence product innovation, modernize cloud infrastructure, and lead organization-wide AI adoption.
      • Leadership Scope: High-impact executive leadership opportunity spanning engineering, architecture, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, security, and technology operations.

title: Director, Capital Markets Product Control
description:
Application Deadline:

10/02/2026

Address:

100 King Street West

Job Family Group:

Customer Shared Services

Reporting to the Managing Director of Enterprise Product Control, the Director of Capital Markets Product Control (CM PC) leads one or more of the focus areas (defined below) within the group responsible for the specialized accounting processes and related control environment supporting Capital Market activities.

The Capital Markets Product Control Group includes the following focus areas:

Derivative and Nesbitt Burns Product (BMO’s Canadian broker/dealer subsidiary BMO Nesbitt Burns Inc). Fixed Income, Equities and Capital Markets Corporation Product Control (BMO’s US broker/dealer subsidiary BMO Capital Markets Corporation (“CMC”)) Investment & Commercial Banking (“I&CB”) Product Control

The teams within Capital Markets Product Control are organized to support aligned functions and lines of business. Each group is led by at least one of the following; Director, Associate Director or Manager who provide direct oversight of control execution, under the strategic leadership of the Managing Director.

The CM Product Control team is responsible for;

  • Responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of the P&L and PAA process
  • Responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of the general ledger including initiating or reviewing accounting entries, completing reconciliations and providing financial attestations.
  • Ensuring appropriate accounting policies and best practices are followed
  • Performing complex analysis and investigations
  • Leading the identification and implementation of process and control improvements
  • Ensuring the readiness of operational accounting for new product initiatives, accounting changes and system implementations or upgrades
  • Participating in change initiatives performing requirements gathering, process design, system testing and post-implementation reviews
  • Partnering with Front Office, Finance, Risk and Controls, Trade Support, Project Delivery, Technology and Operations to enhance end-to-end process and controls
  • Leveraging AI to improve processes and drive efficiencies

The Director, CM PC leads a critical function in supporting Capital Markets and is required to be an expert in P&L reconciliations, securities accounting, capital markets products, processes and systems. This leader delivers senior business knowledge, specialized technical expertise, and well-established management skills to ensure that financial accounting processes are developed, implemented and reviewed in alignment with the bank’s financial, regulatory and audit standards.

This role is critical to both the operational excellence and the successful completion of change programs aimed at transforming existing Capital Markets transactional reporting, risk and governance processes while ensuring the maintenance of a robust and comprehensive technology infrastructure. This leader will effectively collaborate, often with little reliance on formal authority, with senior partners in the Front Office, Finance, Securities Operations, Risk and Technology to innovate and implement effective change to support those processes and to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the financial processes within BMO.

This role is accountable for Technical Excellence, Team Management, Operational Effectiveness, Risk Management and Control, Change Management, and Relationship Management by creating and maintaining a proactive service environment that maximizes employee productivity and customer service effectiveness.

Key Accountabilities:

The incumbent is accountable for:

1. Capital Markets Product Control (Technical Excellence)

  • Deliver an effective control environment for Capital Markets financial reporting and ensures any notified changes in the external environment (regulatory, tax, policy) are reviewed and implemented
  • Lead the adoption of AI in daily and monthly processes
  • Maintain an effective SOX environment
  • Leads the daily reconcilement and reporting of Trader P&L’s and PAA
  • Leads end-to-end accounting support from the source sub-ledgers to the entity general ledgers, for Capital Markets
  • Ensures the integrity and accuracy of the daily P&L, entity general ledger by initiating accounting entries, completing reconciliations and providing financial attestations which includes;
  • Leads the accurate and timely reconciliation of daily P&L (daily Financial Estimate) and obtaining Trader Signoffs
  • Leads the accurate and timely reconciliation of the monthly P&L (Monthly Financial Actual) and obtaining Trader Signoffs.
    • Leads the accurate and timely preparation of month-end and quarterly reconciliations from source system to general ledger
  • Leads the monthly attestation process for all CM Product Operations Accounting accounts
  • Leads end-to-end accounting support from the source sub-ledgers to the entity general ledgers, for Capital Markets

2. Team Management

  • Leads and manages a highly specialized team by setting context and direction aligned to organizational goals, defining accountabilities, identifying learning and training requirements for the team
  • Creates a learning environment aimed at continuously developing staff skills by identifying learning needs, providing regular feedback and motivating staff to achieve development goals
  • Manages staff performance including identifying and managing staff with high performance and those with performance issues and effectively acting when appropriate
  • Manages diverse talent to identify key talent and provide further growth opportunities both for key talent individuals and for other talent who show potential
  • Engages in personal development to enhance skills and knowledge that will keep pace with changing business needs and allow technical and product knowledge to be kept current
  • Attracts top talent into BMO

3. Operational Effectiveness

  • Improve data lineage and operational process
  • Investigates and reviews operational processes and accountabilities in order to improve efficiencies, reduce risk to the organization

4. Risk Management and Control

  • Leads the development, implementation, assessment and maintenance of appropriate standards of service for this complex business unit that is highly regulated and must adhere to strict deadlines

Business supported: Capital Markets

Regions Supported: Canada, US, London, Ireland, Asia.

Legal entities supported: Multiple in Canada, US, Europe, Asia.

Complexity of activity: highly complex – specialized accounting.

Knowledge and Skills:

Knowledge:

  • University degree with a minimum 5-10 years of experience in the financial services sector with a focus on capital markets, product control and related regulatory, control and operating environment

  • Knowledge of US and IFRS accounting standards, including audit practices, financial reporting processes and industry standards
  • In depth knowledge in Capital Markets Products and Services (subject matter expert in capital markets products and operations).
  • General working knowledge of both Capital Market Product and Financial Reporting systems
  • Solid knowledge and understanding of Capital Markets Product Operations business, services and organization
  • Systems knowledge of the following: Imagine, ADP (BPS), ICI (Impact), Calypso, SwapOne, Global One, Essbase/Smartview, S4 Hanna GL would be an asset.

Skills:

  • Team Leadership
  • In depth Business Acumen
  • Technical Excellence
  • AI
  • Strong Computer skills, including strong knowledge of Excel and VBA
  • Operational Excellence
  • Communication
  • Relationship Management (internal and external)
  • Change Management
  • Influence and Negotiation
  • People management (diverse talent management)

Salary:

$120,000.00 - $215,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit:

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

To find out more visit us at .
